dkar chagalnga ga ma'i cesam yul khyad par can la phyag 'tshal ba bsod nams dbyar gyi gaṅga'i klung rgyun zhes bya ba/ 1thod gangs can gyi btsan khyodal ba gatho gzhung dmangs gsum gyi byas rjes bzang po rang gi blo tshod kyis mthong ba'i don la gnas pa'i yon tan brtsod pa las/ gtso bo 7skyabs mgon rgyal ba'i dbang wa'i yon tan brjod pa tshe rabs rjes 'dzin gyi dad pa'i4 'o/nga zhes bya ba bzhugs sku // 18bod gangs can gyi btsan byol ba gtso gzhung dmangs gsum gyi byas rjes bzang po rang gi blo tshod kyis mthong ba'i don la gnas pa'i yon tan brjod pa las/gzhung dga' ldan pho brang phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi yon tan brjod pa gangs ljongs 〉〉sa srid kyi gzhung shing zhes bya ba bzhugs sku // 54 bod gangs can gyi btsan byol ba gtso gzhung dmangs gsum gyi byas rjes bzang po rang gi blo tshod kyis mthong ba'i don la gnas pa'i yon tan brjod pa las/dmangs lhag bsam can chodal gsum ser skya mo ngas kyi skusten tan brjod pa chig sgril rdo rje'i gong byazhes bya ba bzhugs so// 87mdo smad bshad sgrub bstan pa'i 'byung gnas bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i chodas grwa chen wa'i don gnas kyi yon tan rang gi blo tshod kyis mthong ba brjod pa bkra

shis 11 bdun pa zhes bya ba/ 106'phags yul dha ram sa la'i stod bcud kyi sku na tan mdod tsam brjod pa snyigs lnga'i rgud mun sel ba'i 'od snang zhes bya ba/ 118gnam lo gsar ba'i shis brjod tshe srung lda je'i gur khyim zhes bya ba/ 131yul khyad 'phags sa dge bka' rnying g.yung drung ngon dang bcas pa'i dus gsum dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi spyan sngar gangs ljongs chol gsum skyob pa'i phur tshugs gsol 'debs nying 'dzin skul ba'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba/ 140sems kyi dga' sdug 'phel 'grib kyi ri snub sgos bya ba/ 146sems kyi chod 'phrul rnam shodag khyodag zhags 'khyug pa'i rlabs ris zhes bya ba/ 155byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i sa bcad rags pa tshigs su bcad pa dpal ldan bla ma'i ljags kyi bdud rtsizhes bya ba/ 177lo gzhon mkhas sar gyi smod rtsom chu log 'gog pa'i lcags rags zhes bya ba/ 199las dkar nag gi rnam gzhag bshad pa theg pa sku ngas kyi gzhung lam du babo da lugs gcig pa'i bo ma 'acadas zhes bya ba/ 206dus rabs gsar ba'i skong rdzas 'bul tshul lha brgya bzhad pa'i chod ga zhes bya ba/ 228

dad ldan 'das gson gyi gces nor longs su spyad pa'i dkor lan bun bsags la dngangs pa'i snying gi 'phar lding zhes bya ba/ 248byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i dmigs skor gyi mgur dbyangs sngon byon dam pa'i lad mo dgos bya ba/ 255rang gi gnyen la gdams pa'i bslab bya tshigs su bcad pa ya rabs babo da pa'i gyen lam dkar po shes bya ba/ 264thod chen ngo'i mi rigs dang rgyal rabs rig gzhung dang 'brel ba'i lhun lam spun zla ngo sprod kyi mdzub ston zhes bya ba/ 279phyogs ris med pa'i skyes chen rnams la ched du brjod pa byams brtsogangs ljongs kun khyab ces bya ba/ 287bod kyi stod bcud ma mthong ba'i byes 'khrungs gzhon nu rnams la gangs ljongs ngo sprod gangs dkar 'phreng mdzes zhes bya ba/ 300cesal gsum mnyam gzhas/ 315rang gi lo rgyus myong tshor sems kyi ri mo zhes bya ba/ 317mjug rtsom/ 358

thog ma'i gleng brjod/deng skabs rang re'i rtsom wa bo su zhig yin na'ang deb kyi thog mtha' gnyis su gleng brtsod dang mjug rtsom zhes sde tshan re 'bri srol yod pa bzhin/ngas kyang byi las stag la 'gran pa bzhin rang nyid rtsome pa thorwa nig yin pa'i khul byas nas gling bswādzid masnga tsam zhig 'bri rgyu yin lags/ de yang deb chung 'di ni mchod rim nas bka' bskul gnang ba dang dmang rim nas re bskul zhus pa lta bu ga la yin/ 'o na 'di 'dra zhig 'bri ba'i dgos pa dang 'dun pa ci yin zhe na/ bshad par byacod// nga rang thodad nas lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis la ma bslebs bar du bod yig slob gnyer gyi go skabs thob med/ rang lo nyer gnyis josnag tu thod yig gi lnga ga ma dbyangs gsal nas 'thodzi 'dzugs kyis rim bzhin dbu phar gyi bar du bla brang bkra shis 'khyil nas zur khrid byas/ rang lo so gnyis thog rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du 'byor te sku sger yig tshang gi mtshams pa'i khongs su zhugs nas da lta rang lo bzhi bcu zhe drug gi bar du sngar sbyangs yi ge rnams brjed du dogs nas khom skabs nyi ma re rer tshigs bcad re zung bris pa yin/ de bas le tshan nyi shu rtsagacig dang tshigs bcad

thog ma'i gleng brjod/deng skabs rang re'i rtsom wa bo su zhig yin na'ang deb kyi thog mtha' gnyis su gleng brtsod dang mjug rtsom zhes sde tshan re 'bri srol yod pa bzhin/ngas kyang byi las stag la 'gran pa bzhin rang nyid rtsome pa thorwa nig yin pa'i khul byas nas gling bswādzid masnga tsam zhig 'bri rgyu yin lags/ de yang deb chung 'di ni mchod rim nas bka' bskul gnang ba dang dmang rim nas re bskul zhus pa lta bu ga la yin/ 'o na 'di 'dra zhig 'bri ba'i dgos pa dang 'dun pa ci yin zhe na/ bshad par byacod// nga rang thodad nas lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis la ma bslebs bar du bod yig slob gnyer gyi go skabs thob med/ rang lo nyer gnyis josnag tu thod yig gi lnga ga ma dbyangs gsal nas 'thodzi 'dzugs kyis rim bzhin dbu phar gyi bar du bla brang bkra shis 'khyil nas zur khrid byas/ rang lo so gnyis thog rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du 'byor te sku sger yig tshang gi mtshams pa'i khongs su zhugs nas da lta rang lo bzhi bcu zhe drug gi bar du sngar sbyangs yi ge rnams brjed du dogs nas khom skabs nyi ma re rer tshigs bcad re zung bris pa yin/ de bas le tshan nyi shu rtsagacig dang tshigs bcad

dgu brgya tsam 'dug 'di dang wa dpar skrun bya ba'i bsam pa de 'dra gtan nas med 31da/ 〉(na kyang bkra shis 'khyil gyi rtsis rams pa bsam 'grub rgya mchod 'di gar phebs skabs spyan 'bul zhus pa naphag lags tsa yus bstan 'dzin dpal 'bar dang rnam pa gnyis gas bsngags brtsod gang 'tsham gnang sku/nga / rtsis rams pa'i zhal nas/ nged gnyis la lam bo1na tsam ma gdodags mi 'dug de min dpar du skrun thub na legs zhes gsungs/ a lags tsa yus zhal nas/ de ga la dathodas/ 'di rjes nas wa da gzhung shes rig las khungs la snyan zhu phul na thebs mganang nges sku zhes gsungs/ de nas rtsis rams pa phyir ngo da la phebs/ a lags tsa yus dbo ngas pa rtsodags te dpar skrun bya ba'i go skabs yal lo/ nga rang gi sems la 'di rjes nas dpar skrun bya thub na btsan ༷rtol ba'i khod kyi mkhas pa rgan gcan rnams kyi spyan sngar bkram yang khrel dgod dang 'phya smod gnang sa ma red dran byung / de nas da lo phyi 'o/ 2003 phyi zla 9 ba'i tshes 1 nyin 7skyabs mabo na rgyal ba rin wa che'i spyan sngar nyam chung bdag la mtho rim mi sna lta bu zhig gi mjal kha thob/ de'i skabs su yang spyan 'bul zhusapa yin/ khe nga gi thugs mnyes pa'i mchod sprin gyi dum bu zhig tu gyur pas nga rang sems la dga' chosar chen 1/ dang rgya gar du yong ba don go chod song snyam pa byung ngo // khong gis rtsom kha shas ljags

klog gnang skabs zhal nas/ khyed rang srid zhen chen wa red ces bka' gnang byung / de ni spyir rang cag gangs can pa rnams dus rabs 'di la srid snga na gyi dka' ngal chen po zhig la thug yod pa dang / khyad par du nga rang sdod yul btsan cadal srid gzhung gi lte gnas yin pas srid yig srid gtam rgyun ldan du mthong thos su sku da pa dang / yang cadas sngo da mi dmangs rnams yun ring du gnas mi gnas dang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin 1stu 'i dar mi dar thod rang dbang thob ma thob kyi rjes su 'gro ldog nges pas/ nga rang gis de la sems khral byas pa'i rnam 'gyur phyi 'o/gas su macadan pa zhig red/ 'di la chos pa kha shas kyi thugs la ma babs nas mtshams pas cesas mi sgrub par srid sngaṭan la mabo 'a〈snar zhes bka' khyodan yang gnang srid/ nga'i tshigs bcad rnams snyan ngag pa gachogan skyes dag gi ce ma nang bzhin snyan zhing 'jibs pa de 'dra med la/ de ni nga rang chung ngu'i dus su slob grwar 'gro myong med pa dang chen wa'i skabs su snyan ngag ched rjodanga'adzin grwar yang 'bo ma snu nga zhing bkra shis 'khyil du zur khrid tsam gyis 'grig par byas/ yang gdan sa'i dge bshes rnams kyi ljags rtsom nang bzhin zab cing rnyings pa de 'dra yang med la/ de ni nga rang gzhung chen lnga dang rgyud sne bzhi'i slob gnyer mtha' 'khyongs pa med pa'i lan no// 'o na 'di la sus blta/ gong du bshad pa'i bsngags brjod

gnang dgos don ci yin zhe na/ deb chung 'di ni snyan ngag pa dang dge bshes rnams kyis gzigs na snyan pa dang zab pa'i 11 ba ma mastsal kyang brda zhing mngon brtsod dpe gzugs sogs kyis ma bcings par spyi khyod yi ge 'ba' zhig bed spyod btang yod stabs/ snyan sum dang gzhung che ba la ma bltas shing bod yig sbyor klog la byang ba rnamarme kyis blta bar nges so snyam/ nga la bsngags bcadad gnang dbostos ro/na ni mkhas pa kun gyis ma brtsams pa'i legs bshad cig brtsams 'dug sho shes bsngags brtsod gnang ba ma red/'o na ci la gnang zhe na/ nga la slob gnyer gyi mthun rkyen ma tshang bzhin du thod rang gi rig gzhung lasngas tshugs byas nas sbyangs pa de la bsngags brtsod gnang ba yin no/ mthun rkyen ma tshang ba ni/ rang lo nyer gnyis thog bod yig slob 'go btsugs pas slob sbyong skabs kyi giser lta bu'i dus tshod bzang po yol tshar ba dang gcigamig shin tu skyo zhing long 'khrid ma dgos tsam yin pas slob gnyer gyi sgo 'gag pa dang gnyis/ rang gi skyes khyim dang sring mos 'tsho ba mu mthud du sgrub kyang 'gro dngul dgos skabs grong chog tu song bas dus tshod bzang bo chud zos btang ba dang gsum/ yang / nyin mtshan du bsnyungan 'grus byas kyang besgong na dga' rtags sprod mkhan med pa dang / lhod g.yengadu btang yang gnon shugs rjod mkhan med pas slob sbyong 'thug shor song ba dang bzhi'o// bshad ma thag

pa'i rgyu mtshan 'dis rang gi 'asnga da ho khengasdo pa dang gzhan la phan pa sgrub pa'i rā ba gnyer gnad thig pa zhig byed ma thub lags/ cadan kyang skye ba phyi ma rnams su dbang bo'i sgo lnga la skyon med pa'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus 'thob pa dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'phrad pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal te bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgya chen po 'grub pa'i smon lam dang bcas te shar mdzod dge ba ye shes rgya masnu sa phyi 'o/ 2003 phyi zla11 tshes 20 nyin bris/dge'o// //

pa'i rgyu mtshan 'dis rang gi 'asnga da ho khengasdo pa dang gzhan la phan pa sgrub pa'i rā ba gnyer gnad thig pa zhig byed ma thub lags/ cadan kyang skye ba phyi ma rnams su dbang bo'i sgo lnga la skyon med pa'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus 'thob pa dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'phrad pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal te bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgya chen po 'grub pa'i smon lam dang bcas te shar mdzod dge ba ye shes rgya masnu sa phyi 'o/ 2003 phyi zla11 tshes 20 nyin bris/dge'o// //

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/༄༅༅/ / thog ma'i rtsom yul khyad par can la phyag 'tshal ba bsku da nams dbyar gyi gaṅga'i klung rgyun zhes bya ba/rdi je'i sku la ngur smrig gos bzang gis/ /bklub par nus mo da kun khyab 'phrin las rlabs/ /srid zhi'i khor yug khyon las brgal gyur pa'i/ /'dren macesag gangs can mabo na wa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /dmar khyedags srid lugs gnyan wa'i khrims cosag tu//phyag zung lcags sgrog dam pos rgyas btab kyang //gangs ljongs bstan 'gro'i phugs don 'ba' zhig la//rtag gzigs paṇa chen bcu ba'i zhabs la 'dud//gangs dkar 'khrigs pa'i ljongs kyi rig gnas spyi/ /khyad par theg gsum sngags kyi thos bsam snyadam/ /1

khrims gtsang lcags ri gcig gi khyon tsam du/ /'jug pa'i kun mkhyen yab sras bcas la 'dud/ / dmu rgod gtum spyod rgya dang kha che'i sder/ /nye yang thos bsam sgom pa'i dga' ston dpal/ /ring du gnas pa'i dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil/ /der bzhugs mkhas grub sku ngas la gus pas 'dud/ /khyad par bod rgya'i chos rig gzhung brgya'i bcud/ /thugs kyi dpal be'u'i khyim du bkug pa'i mthus/ /grags snyan 'dzam gling 'dzin ma yangs pa'i khyon/ /'gongs pa'i bshes gnyen bsam gtan rgya masnumar 'dud/ /sko rab 'byams gzhung lugs tshig don thogs med du/ /ljags kyi klong nas gdul bya'idabang po khams/ /bsam pa ji bzhin 'chad pa'i brtse ldan pa/ / bshes gnyen 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho'i zhabs la 'dud/ /2

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/gzhung lugs kun chub khyad par grangs gzhal ba'i/ /gtsug lag rtsis kyi gzhung mang byang ba'i gzis/ /rgya rigs rtsis pa'i spobs pa snub byed pa'i/ /nges snga na bya bral bsam grub rgya mchosar 'dud/ /'phral bde'i phun tshogs skal ba ring du dor/ /bstan pa'i yang snying thugs dam mthil du 'dzin/ /phyi nang 'du 'dzi spangs pa'i bya bral ba/ /ye shes lhasnebs ldan zhabs la gus pas 'dud/ /'dzam gling shar nub gdul bya bye ba'i mgon/ /pod lnga rgyud bzhi rig pa'i gnas kyi mdzod//mdo sngags bstan pa'i gsal byed kirti rje'i//mtshan nyid bo/gas mdzad bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud//gzhung chen bka' pod lnga yi 'chad rtsod dang //gsang sngags rgyud bzhi'i thugs dam gcatel ba'i mthus//3

dpag med gdul byas rtag tu bkur ba'i zhing //masnu ga sprul 11 chodas bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud//nam zhig 11 11 yang dag rig pa bzhi//1(ba tshe bag chags zab ces sad pa'i thabs//brgyud ldan bka' 'gyur lung gis smin mdzad pa//chos rje ri rdzong bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud//maro/ra na rab byung mkhan khrod la sku gas pa'i / /yul mchog skyes bu du mas chos sbyin las/ /snyigs lnga bdo yang rang sems bde dga'i dpal/ /rol ba'i skal ba byin pa dran te 'dud/ /g.yang dag ston gyi mkha' la bathod lnga'i zla/ /ji bzhin dkar gsal mdangs kyi gzi 'bar ma /mtshan tsam ba༄thod pas 'chi bdag 'jigs kun las/ /skyob mdzad yid bzhin 'khor le'i zhabs la 'dud / /4

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/ tshe sbyin bdud rtsi'i gter gyur bcom ldan ma/ /gang gi mtshan tsam brtsode pa'i lha dang mi/ /ring du 'tsho ba'i skal ba stsol ba'i lha/ /rnam rgyal lha dgu'i chosags la gus pas 'dud/ /rab dmar gzi 'od rlabs kyis 'jig rten kun/ /snang zhing tshe zad lo brgya 'tsho ba'i tshe/ /sbyin mdzad bder gshegs tshe dpag med mthodan zhes/ /sku na tan dpag med zhing gi dpal la 'dud/ /shes bya'i gnas la kun tu sna/ngas pa'i yid/ /gang la gang gis rjes su brtse ba na/ /sdud 〈snas yangs shing mkhas dgu'i spyi gtsug tu/ / skyodan mdzad brtan pa'i 'kho ra lo'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rgyal kun srid zhi'i khams las macadan bo1la yang / /skye 'gro mi bslu brtsechen lha'i rnam rol/ /5

snang ba'i spyan ras gzigs dbang 'ar+sha ba'i mthosnen/ /khyad par gangs ri'i dpal gyur khyed la 'dud/ /spa khyodan sa 'dzin che la bskal ba'i me/ /drag tu 'khyud 'dra phas kyi the la ba yis/ /malnga nga tshe masnuman cha 'chotsher zhing 'a11sa 'gyur bas/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug gsang ba'i bdag por 'dud/ /gang gi gtsug tu pad zla'i gdan steng du/ /rab dkar sku las 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /babs pas nyes ltung 'dag pa'i byed las can/ /bcom ldan rdor sems yum dang bcas la 'dud/ /drag wa'i /sgras sa gsum 'dar byed cing / /me dpung tsha tsha 'phro ba'i bstan 'gro'i dgra/ /zhing bcu tshang ba ma lus sreg byed pa'i/ /sdang ba'i rnam can kho rgyal bcu la 'dud/ /6

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/phra ba gnyug sems rnal 'acadar bo/mas lha bas kyis / /mi zad bde lha nga sngagal ba srid mtha'i bar /'grib pa med pa'i gdams pa sku ngas kyi ma〉dud/ /bla ma 'khor lo sdom pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /gang la brten na phra ba gnyug sems kyi/ /bachodan par gyur ba'i phra rlung rten brten pa'i/ /dkyil 'kho ra bsgyur ba'i man ngag kun gyi gnyer/ /bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /stod ldan skyes bu gang gi 'dod pa'i don/ /ngo mtshar 'od gsal sgyu lus zung 'jug gi/man ngag gnad kun spungs pa'i bdag po mchog/bla ma gshin rje'i gshed po skyed la 'dud/ / masnga ra na khyodags bcu dus gsum rgyal kun gyis/ /gdul dka' dpag med 'dul phyir 'phrin las bzhi'i/ /7

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/phra ba gnyug sems rnal 'acadar bo/mas lha bas kyis / /mi zad bde lha nga sngagal ba srid mtha'i bar /'grib pa med pa'i gdams pa sku ngas kyi ma〉dud/ /bla ma 'khor lo sdom pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /gang la brten na phra ba gnyug sems kyi/ /bachodan par gyur ba'i phra rlung rten brten pa'i/ /dkyil 'kho ra bsgyur ba'i man ngag kun gyi gnyer/ /bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /stod ldan skyes bu gang gi 'dod pa'i don/ /ngo mtshar 'od gsal sgyu lus zung 'jug gi/man ngag gnad kun spungs pa'i bdag po mchog/bla ma gshin rje'i gshed po skyed la 'dud/ / masnga ra na khyodags bcu dus gsum rgyal kun gyis/ /gdul dka' dpag med 'dul phyir 'phrin las bzhi'i/ /7

lha tshogs spro bsdu gdul bya'i zhing khams kun / /khyab mdzad yi dam lha tshogs rnams la 'dud/ /rab 'byams 'a〈snar 'das yul gyi shes bya kun/ /sgrib bral mkhyen pa'i ye shes gter chen gyis/ /macadan sum gsal gzigs dus gsum sangs rgyas zhes/ /thogs med mkhyen pa'i gter chen rnams la 'dud/ /mtha' yas 'bos bas khyab pa'i yul kun tu/ / rlabs chen brtse bas zin pa'i bcom ldan 'das/ /mi bslu skyabs kyi mthar thug khyed lta bu/ /gzhan na med pa'i thugs rje'i gter la 'dud/ /bdud dmag bye bas sna tshogs mtshon cha'i char/ /drag tu phab kyang yid 'ong me tog gi/char du bsgyur te sa gzhi mdzes byed du/ /byin gyi brlabs pa'i nus ldan yongs la 'dud/ /8

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/rang don chos sku'i dbyings las gzhan don du/ /gzugs sku'i lha sa pa mtha' yas gdul bya'i khams/ /kun tu khyab kyang rtsol sgrub rab zhi bas/ /'phrin las lhun gyis grub pa rnams la 'dud/ /rgyal kun gsang gsum sngos mtshar mtha' yas kyis/ /dpag med gdul bya'i 'phral phyags bde dga'i dpal/ /bsgrub phyir mdzad bzang srid mtha'i bar du yang / /rgyun mi 'chad pa'i 'phrin las can la 'dud/ /rang nyid 'jigs pa kun las rnam grol zhing / /gzhan rnams phra rags 'jigs las bsgral mkhas pas/ /skyabs su 'os so phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs/ /zla med mgon po rnams la gus pas 'dud/ /brtse bas nye ring gdul bya mtha' dag gi/don la 'jug cing phan btags ma btags kun/ /9

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/rang don chos sku'i dbyings las gzhan don du/ /gzugs sku'i lha sa pa mtha' yas gdul bya'i khams/ /kun tu khyab kyang rtsol sgrub rab zhi bas/ /'phrin las lhun gyis grub pa rnams la 'dud/ /rgyal kun gsang gsum sngos mtshar mtha' yas kyis/ /dpag med gdul bya'i 'phral phyags bde dga'i dpal/ /bsgrub phyir mdzad bzang srid mtha'i bar du yang / /rgyun mi 'chad pa'i 'phrin las can la 'dud/ /rang nyid 'jigs pa kun las rnam grol zhing / /gzhan rnams phra rags 'jigs las bsgral mkhas pas/ /skyabs su 'os so phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs/ /zla med mgon po rnams la gus pas 'dud/ /brtse bas nye ring gdul bya mtha' dag gi/don la 'jug cing phan btags ma btags kun/ /9

khyad med bde sgrub sdug bsngal sel ba'i phyir/ /skyabs su cadas sku rgyal ba kun la 'dud/ /mtherdzor na khyedags dus kun tu bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang khyad par bskal bzang 'di'i/ /bde gshegs stong dang bshags lha so lnga dang / /shākya seng ge bcas la yang yang 'dud/ /gtsang ma'i tshul khrims dri ngad 17gas kun khyab//bying rgod g.yeng ba bral ba'i ting 'dzin gsal//ngar ldan shes rab rnon pos 'khor rtsa gcod//bslab pa gsum ldan dge 'dun sde la 'dud//ma rig sgo nga'i sbubs rgya ma grol yang / /gzhan phan sgra dbyangs snyan mo sa skye cad kun/ /ngo mtshar skyed pa'i ka la thing ka bzhin/ /rgyal sras dang 11 rnams la gus pas 'dud/ /10

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/tshul khrims ting 'dzin macor+shag gi lus 41bas rgyas/ /thabs dang shes rab zab mo'i 'dab gasna ga ring / /kun lhan lag 'gro 'thag pa'i mchu sder sgo/ /sar gnas rgyal sras mkha' lding dbang por 'dud/ /sgyu na byung rgyal ba rnams kyi sras kyi gatheto/ /phyis 'byung bde bar gshegs pa kun gyi yab/ / khyodags bcu'i sems can sku ngas kyi gnyen gcig pu / /rgyal sras dpa' ngo rnams la rtag tu 'dud/ /sems can gcig gi bde ba bsgrub pa dang / /sdug bsngal bsal phyir rang gi mgo bo sogs/ /phangs med sbyin par phod pa'i snying stobs can/ /rgyal sras dpa' thod rnams la rtag tu 'dud/ /rab mdzes yid 'ong sgeg mos rjes chags kyi/ /dkar 'jam sor bcus mgul du 'khyud na yang / /11

ba spu'i rtse tsam mi ga5te tshul khrims can/ /rgyal sras dpa' wosto rnams la rtag tu 'dud/ / gtum khyodad ngan pa'i mi yis dus rtag tu/ /tshig rtsub ba༄dud cing masnuman gyis btab na yang / /gcathod lan phan pa sgrub pa'i bahwa da pa can/ / lkurgyal sras dpa' 1te rnams la rtag tu 'dud/ /lus can don du rang nyid yon tan gter/ /bsgrub phyir sku1na tan re la ngal brgya yis/ /mnar yang 〈sna bzhin 'jug pa'i bcadan 'grus can/ /rgyal sras dpa' thosgo rnams la rtag tu 'dud/ /sems can don du rang nyid 'dod yon lnga'i/ /dga' bde'i rol ba gtan du spong nas ni/ /ting 'dzin 〈sna brgya 'byed pa'i bsam gtan can / /rgyal sras dpa' 21 rnams la rtag tu 'dud/ /12

ba spu'i rtse tsam mi ga5te tshul khrims can/ /rgyal sras dpa' wosto rnams la rtag tu 'dud/ / gtum khyodad ngan pa'i mi yis dus rtag tu/ /tshig rtsub ba༄dud cing masnuman gyis btab na yang / /gcathod lan phan pa sgrub pa'i bahwa da pa can/ / lkurgyal sras dpa' 1te rnams la rtag tu 'dud/ /lus can don du rang nyid yon tan gter/ /bsgrub phyir sku1na tan re la ngal brgya yis/ /mnar yang 〈sna bzhin 'jug pa'i bcadan 'grus can/ /rgyal sras dpa' thosgo rnams la rtag tu 'dud/ /sems can don du rang nyid 'dod yon lnga'i/ /dga' bde'i rol ba gtan du spong nas ni/ /ting 'dzin 〈sna brgya 'byed pa'i bsam gtan can / /rgyal sras dpa' 21 rnams la rtag tu 'dud/ /12

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/skal ldan rnams la blang dor lam bzang por/ /lta ba'i mig ni shes rab nyid yin phyir/ /zab gsal myur sku/gas shes rab gter 'dzin pa'i/ /rgyal sras dpa' ྅/ rnams la rtag tu 'dud/ / skabs 'gar sa skyodang tshul gyis yul gru kun/ /bde la sbyor phyir sdig can rgyal bo srid/ /btsan gyis 'phrog cing dbang du sdud byed pa'i/ /rgyal sras dpa' tho/ rnams la rtag tu 'dud/ /re 'ga' yid 'ong btsun mo stong phrag dang / /spyang grung 'askru/mas pa'i sras dang sras sdu'i ce gas/ /lhan du 'gro mang bde la sbyor ba'i gnyen/ /rgyal sras dpa' the/ rnams la rtag tu 'dud/ /bstan pa snub cing 'acad la 'tshe ba yi/ /sdig pa can la bu bzhin lhag par du/ /13

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/skal ldan rnams la blang dor lam bzang por/ /lta ba'i mig ni shes rab nyid yin phyir/ /zab gsal myur sku/gas shes rab gter 'dzin pa'i/ /rgyal sras dpa' ྅/ rnams la rtag tu 'dud/ / skabs 'gar sa skyodang tshul gyis yul gru kun/ /bde la sbyor phyir sdig can rgyal bo srid/ /btsan gyis 'phrog cing dbang du sdud byed pa'i/ /rgyal sras dpa' tho/ rnams la rtag tu 'dud/ /re 'ga' yid 'ong btsun mo stong phrag dang / /spyang grung 'askru/mas pa'i sras dang sras sdu'i ce gas/ /lhan du 'gro mang bde la sbyor ba'i gnyen/ /rgyal sras dpa' the/ rnams la rtag tu 'dud/ /bstan pa snub cing 'acad la 'tshe ba yi/ /sdig pa can la bu bzhin lhag par du/ /13

brtse bas nan tur sku gas la rjordzor ba yi/ /rgyal sras dpa' tho/ rnams la rtag tu 'dud/ /gang du theg chen bstan pa 'dzin nus pa'i/ /stod rung gdul bya'i gam du snying rje dang / /smon lam dbang gis skye ba 'dzin pa yi/ /rgyal sras dpa' ngo rnams la rtag tu 'dud/ /btsun pas mkhas pa'i sku(na tan ma bathesgrom zhing / /mkhas pas btsun pa ma bather+sham rgyal bcin bstan/ /sku ngas ljangags 'dzin pa'i dpal ldan bla ma'i tshul/ /rgyal sras dpa' thod rnams la rtag tu 'dud/ /phyi mdzes 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i spyod lam gtsang / /nang du byang sngags nyams bzhes nyin mtshan 'astudal/ /dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i brtul zhugs can/ /rgyal sras dpa' snga/ rnams la rtag tu 'dud/ /14

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/sems can sngasan du rgyal sras dpa' 11 rnams/ /rab byung tshul dang rgyal sdudan khyim bdag sku gas/ /sna tshogs skye ba bzung ste rlabs chen gyi/ /spyod pas 'gro don mdzad la ci'i mi 'dud/ /'gro ba'i don du 'gyur na sems dpa' che/ /bya dang ri dwags sogs kyi gzugs bzung ste/ /nyam chung brtse bas skyong ba'i skyes bu la/ / bdag blo dad pas gang ste yang yang 'dud/ /ji srid nam mkha' gnas pa'i sems can khams/ /rgyal sras chen wa'i brtse bas de srid du/ /ma lus khyab pa'i blo na lam rlabs the che/ /thos pa'i mod la spro dga'i yid kyis 'dud/ /rgyal sras dpa' ro/ skrun byed theg chen chodas/ /bsil ldan zhing gi gsar rnying bstan pa rnams/ /15

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/sems can sngasan du rgyal sras dpa' 11 rnams/ /rab byung tshul dang rgyal sdudan khyim bdag sku gas/ /sna tshogs skye ba bzung ste rlabs chen gyi/ /spyod pas 'gro don mdzad la ci'i mi 'dud/ /'gro ba'i don du 'gyur na sems dpa' che/ /bya dang ri dwags sogs kyi gzugs bzung ste/ /nyam chung brtse bas skyong ba'i skyes bu la/ / bdag blo dad pas gang ste yang yang 'dud/ /ji srid nam mkha' gnas pa'i sems can khams/ /rgyal sras chen wa'i brtse bas de srid du/ /ma lus khyab pa'i blo na lam rlabs the che/ /thos pa'i mod la spro dga'i yid kyis 'dud/ /rgyal sras dpa' ro/ skrun byed theg chen chodas/ /bsil ldan zhing gi gsar rnying bstan pa rnams/ /15

'dzin skyong spel la brtson pa'i tshad ldan gyi/ /bla ma dge ba'i bshes la snying nas 'dud/ /rla 7dor na na kha' khyab 'alha lha phan bsheg rdo 'i/ /brtse ba bskyed ma thag pa'i rgyal sras nas/ /sa bcu'i rgyun mtha'i bar gyi sems dpa' che/ /gang na su bzhugs kun la gus pas 'dud/ /'dzam gling grub pa'i gnas mace ga nyer bzhi na/ /zag med bde stong rol ba'i dga' ston can/ /dam ldan sgrub pa bo la g.yel med grogs/ /mdzad pa'i dpa' thod dpa' sdud rnams la 'dud/ /lda je 'chang dang dpal ldan bla ma yi/ /spyan sngar bstan dang bstan 'dzin g.yel med du/ /྅rtong ba'i tha tshig gnyan wa'i g.yar dam can/ /mthu ldan bstan srung rgya mtsho'i chosags la 'dud/ /16

'dzin skyong spel la brtson pa'i tshad ldan gyi/ /bla ma dge ba'i bshes la snying nas 'dud/ /rla 7dor na na kha' khyab 'alha lha phan bsheg rdo 'i/ /brtse ba bskyed ma thag pa'i rgyal sras nas/ /sa bcu'i rgyun mtha'i bar gyi sems dpa' che/ /gang na su bzhugs kun la gus pas 'dud/ /'dzam gling grub pa'i gnas mace ga nyer bzhi na/ /zag med bde stong rol ba'i dga' ston can/ /dam ldan sgrub pa bo la g.yel med grogs/ /mdzad pa'i dpa' thod dpa' sdud rnams la 'dud/ /lda je 'chang dang dpal ldan bla ma yi/ /spyan sngar bstan dang bstan 'dzin g.yel med du/ /྅rtong ba'i tha tshig gnyan wa'i g.yar dam can/ /mthu ldan bstan srung rgya mtsho'i chosags la 'dud/ /16

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/de ltar 'dud pas skyabs yul bla ma dang / /yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' 11 dang / /mkha' 'gro'i snu'ogs dang mthu ldan bstan srung gis/ /tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med rjes 'dzin thegeg/rgya nag yul nas bskrad pa ma yin zhing / /rgya gar gzhung gis 11sa pa ma yin par/ /skyabs mgon rgyal dbang tshe 'dir mjal 'dod kyi/ /'dun pas dbang bsgyur ye shes rgya mthongs bris/ /zhes pa 'di ni snangangs pa'i rgya las ma bo la ba bdag gis gzhung che ba'i ming tshig gzi brjid can rnams swādu chag btsan bsgrigs byas nas tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag mkhas pa mgu ba skyed pa'i legs bshad kyi grangs su tshud pa'i re 'dun ma mchis shing cung zad bslabs pa mi brjed cing brtan pa'i slad du bgyis pa lags 11//phyi 21 1993 56) zla 1 tshes 15 la bris/17

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/de ltar 'dud pas skyabs yul bla ma dang / /yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' 11 dang / /mkha' 'gro'i snu'ogs dang mthu ldan bstan srung gis/ /tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med rjes 'dzin thegeg/rgya nag yul nas bskrad pa ma yin zhing / /rgya gar gzhung gis 11sa pa ma yin par/ /skyabs mgon rgyal dbang tshe 'dir mjal 'dod kyi/ /'dun pas dbang bsgyur ye shes rgya mthongs bris/ /zhes pa 'di ni snangangs pa'i rgya las ma bo la ba bdag gis gzhung che ba'i ming tshig gzi brjid can rnams swādu chag btsan bsgrigs byas nas tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag mkhas pa mgu ba skyed pa'i legs bshad kyi grangs su tshud pa'i re 'dun ma mchis shing cung zad bslabs pa mi brjed cing brtan pa'i slad du bgyis pa lags 11//phyi 21 1993 56) zla 1 tshes 15 la bris/17

༄༅༅// bod gangs can gyi btsan byol ba gtso gzhung dmangs gsum gyi byas rjes bzang po rang gi blo tshod kyis mthong ba'i sngo na la gnas pa'i yon tan brtsodad pa las/ gatho bo 7skyabs mthodan rgyal ba'i dbang wa'i sku na tan brjod pa tshe rabs rjes 'dzin gyi dad pa'i a sku1nga zhes bya ba bzhugs 11//rmad byung 'phrin las kun tu khyab pa'i rlabs//srid gsum sdudan las brgal kyang dad ldan gyi//snying ga'i pakhra'i ze'u 'brur bag yangs su//'a〈snad pa'i gangs can mthosnen 1rdzo dus kun rgyal// blang snga ra gnas la kun tu ltosangs pa'i mun//'thibs pa'i gangs ri'i ljongs kyi shar mtha' ru//thub bstan nyi ma'i snang ba 'dren mdzad pa//kun mkhyen yab sras brgyud par bcas la 'dud//18

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/de la 'dir thod kha ba gangs can gyi skye 'acad sku ngas kyi bsod nams masngo/na par ma༄te ba'i lha bas kyis 'phags macor+shag 'jig rten dbang phyug rang cag kha ba tsan gyi mi'i rigs kyi tshul bzung ste/ skad dang yi ge dang khyad par du dge slong lda je 'dzin pa'i brtul zhugs 'chang ste/ chos lugs ris med kyi mkhas grub rnams las gdams ngag gsan te nyams su bzhes pa dang gzhan la bstan pa'i 〈sna nas cesas phudags kyi 'phrin las med du byung ba'i sku1na tan dang / bod chol kha gsum gyi skye 'gro rnams kyi bde ba sgrub pa dang sdug bsngal sel ba'i 'phrin las kyi rlabs 'phreng rgyas par ma zad/ tha mal ba bdag 'dra bas dgrar mthong ba dang gang gis bzod pa'i slob dpon du 'dzin pa'i gung khran tang gi gtso 'khor dmangs dang bcas pa'i bde ba sgrub pa dang sdug bsngal sel ba'i thugs bskyed 'bur du thon pa'i yon tan rang gi cho ngor shar ba tsam tshigs su bcad de bcadad par byacad//rgyal kun gsang gsum kun 'dus gangs ri'i mabosan//mdzad bzang sku na tan re la bskal ba brgyar//mkhas dgus brjod kyang rtsodags par dka' na yang //rang blor gang shar mdo tsam 'chad kyis nyon//19

yid 'phrog brjid pa'i gangs kyi ris//bstor ba'i zhing gi gdul bya rnams//brtse bas rjes 'dzin spyan ras gzigs//rim 〈snan rgyal ba'i zhabs la 'dud//bod yul gtsang gi yul ljongs su//bltams pa'i phyag na pad+mo dngos//rgyal ba'i dbang bo paṇa ṭi ta//dge 'dun grub ba'i zhabs la 'dud//gtsang gi rta nag rdor gdan du//yang srid nyi ma gzhon nu'i 'dzum//bzhad pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan pa'i//dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i zhabs la 'dud//mkhas btsun bzang gi mthu 41bas kyis//chen sngo rtor gyi yul khams kun//20

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/bshad sgrub bstan pa spel nus pa'i//ba11da nams rgya masnu'i zhabs la 'dud//mthu stobs dpung gis shar gling kun//bka' khrims lci mos mnga' 'bangs su//bsgyur ba'i hor rgyal gdung gi sras//sku(na tan rgya mtsho'i zhabs la 'dud//gangs ljongs spyi yi rgyal wa'i khab/ /lha ldan gnas nas lugs gnyis kyi//srol bzang rgyal dar slong ba bo//blo bzang rgya mtsho'i zhabs la 'dud//tsan+dan ljon pa'i tshang tshing nags//'khrigs pa'i bho mon la 'og tu//mtshan dpe bzhad pa'i gangs can mabe|na//tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i zhabs la 'dud//21

g.yu mdangs 'dzin pa'i 'khor yug kun//mdzes pa'i mdo khams li thang yul//nyer 'khrungs yon tan kun gyi gter/ /bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i zhabs la 'dud// gangs ljongs lugs gnyis khri 'phang du//mi 'jigs zhabs zung 'khod pa'i mgon//spyan ras gzigs dbang mi'i rnam can/ /'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i zhabs la 'dud//gang sku gtsug tu bkur ba yi//ba11da nams 11da kyis bsgrubs min pas//gzhon sku'i 'ja' ris myur yal ba'i//lung rtogs rgya mtsho'i zhabs la 'dud//dge bcu'i dpal yon dbyar mtsho ltar//rgyas pa'i martsosgo khams li thang du/ /22

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/nyer 'khrungs snying rje'i gter gyi lha//tshul khrims rgya mcho'i zhabs la 'dud// mi nyag yul gyi mgar thang du//yang srid nyi ma 'od po che//gdul bya'i pad+mo bzhad pa'i gnyen//mkhas grub rgya mcho'i la zhabs 'dud//lha ldan yul gyi rdzing phyis su//nyer 'khrungs gangs ljongs 'gro ba'i mgon//lha gcig shel 'phreng pad dkar can//'phrin las rgya mtsho'i zhabs la 'dud// dbus yul dwags wa'i glang mdun du//nyi gzhon cad kyis gangs ljongs spyi'i//stod bcud phyag rgyas btab pa yi//thub bstan rgya masnu'i zhabs la 'dud//23

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/nyer 'khrungs snying rje'i gter gyi lha//tshul khrims rgya mcho'i zhabs la 'dud// mi nyag yul gyi mgar thang du//yang srid nyi ma 'od po che//gdul bya'i pad+mo bzhad pa'i gnyen//mkhas grub rgya mcho'i la zhabs 'dud//lha ldan yul gyi rdzing phyis su//nyer 'khrungs gangs ljongs 'gro ba'i mgon//lha gcig shel 'phreng pad dkar can//'phrin las rgya mtsho'i zhabs la 'dud// dbus yul dwags wa'i glang mdun du//nyi gzhon cad kyis gangs ljongs spyi'i//stod bcud phyag rgyas btab pa yi//thub bstan rgya masnu'i zhabs la 'dud//23

brtse chen 'phrul zhags 'ba' zhig gis//'dzam gling snod bcud ma lus pa//bcings kyang bcud la bde ster ba'i//bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i zhabs la 'dud//brtsechen thabs mkhas khyed kyi drin//yang yang dran pas phyag gcig gis//tshims pa min phyir yang yang du//gus pa chen 11sa zhabs la 'dud//'dzam gling skye 'gro mtha' dag la//snyigs lnga'i rgud pas gnod mthong ste//brtse bas 'gog pa'i thabs gcig pu// mi yi sha tshugs 'dzin la 'dud// bsil ldan stod bcud ma lus pa//gang gi 'dul zhing gyur ba'i gshis// 24

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/mdo smad tsong kha'i nor 'dzin gyi//thig ler zhabs kyis bcags la 'dud//gtsang zhing rigs rus btsun pa yi//yum gyi bde chen 'khor lo nas//sngo mtshar 'bum gyi ltas dang bcas//lhums su 'khod pa khyed la 'dud//snod rung gdul byar snang rung gi/mchog gi sku de ngo mtshar ba'i//dri zhim rol mo'i sgra dang bcas//skye dgu'i dpal du bltams la 'dud//snyigs mas ma bosas lha 31 yi//bla mamā 'phrul gyi me long du//khyed sku 'khrungs pa'i kho ra yug kun//gsal bas 'khrul bral khyed la 'dud //25

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/mdo smad tsong kha'i nor 'dzin gyi//thig ler zhabs kyis bcags la 'dud//gtsang zhing rigs rus btsun pa yi//yum gyi bde chen 'khor lo nas//sngo mtshar 'bum gyi ltas dang bcas//lhums su 'khod pa khyed la 'dud//snod rung gdul byar snang rung gi/mchog gi sku de ngo mtshar ba'i//dri zhim rol mo'i sgra dang bcas//skye dgu'i dpal du bltams la 'dud//snyigs mas ma bosas lha 31 yi//bla mamā 'phrul gyi me long du//khyed sku 'khrungs pa'i kho ra yug kun//gsal bas 'khrul bral khyed la 'dud //25

khyad par yi ge a ka ma//gsal bsa.a maro/ sku 'bum mam// yang na /rma rol ba'i dgon//gang yin mchodag tu mtshar la 'dud// gong ma'i phyag rdzas yo byad las//'ga' zhig spyan la bkram ba'i 31da// gzhan dang ma nor ngo ma'i rdzas//phyag tu bzhes pa khyed la 'dud//rgyang yul chos 'khor lha sa nas//brjid chags sku nyid bsu ba'i mi//gzigs tshe 'dris pa'i gnyen bzhin du//lhag par brtse ba rgyas la 'dud// dge bcu'i dpal yon spungs pa yi//tsong kha'i yul chen bco brgyad kyi//26

khyad par yi ge a ka ma//gsal bsa.a maro/ sku 'bum mam// yang na /rma rol ba'i dgon//gang yin mchodag tu mtshar la 'dud// gong ma'i phyag rdzas yo byad las//'ga' zhig spyan la bkram ba'i 31da// gzhan dang ma nor ngo ma'i rdzas//phyag tu bzhes pa khyed la 'dud//rgyang yul chos 'khor lha sa nas//brjid chags sku nyid bsu ba'i mi//gzigs tshe 'dris pa'i gnyen bzhin du//lhag par brtse ba rgyas la 'dud// dge bcu'i dpal yon spungs pa yi//tsong kha'i yul chen bco brgyad kyi//26

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/sa yi thig le spangs nas ni// lha ldan yul du byon la 'dud//dbu rgyan ma11na mthing ral ba yi//mdzes pa'i co pan phangs med du//sa la dor nas rab byung gi/gtsang ma'i brtul zhugs mdzad la 'dud//sgrib gnyis rgya las lhurton dus su//bo la yang lus can sdug bsngal rgyu//'gog phyir dge la bskul pa'i ched//phra rags nyes ltung 'dzem la 'dud// donaganyis mtha' dag rab rdzogs kyang //ches snyigs dus kyi gdul bya'i ngor//rigs mthun mi yi rnam can gyi//sha tshugs 'dzin pa khyed la 'dud//27

bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas dag la//blo gros rgyas kyang slar yang khyed//6)na mazurgan bsnyungan pas gcesan nu nas//mkhas chen grags pa 'bar la 'dud//ches nyen dus su srid skyong 'gas//thodad srid 'dzin la 'jigs skrag nas//dor tshe gang gis dang blangs te//chos srid cig car 'dzin la 'dud//phrag dog me lce 'bar ba 'gas//gang gi mdzad bzang ma bag da nas//rdzas sbyor cho gas gtses pa na//bdud rtsi'i bcud du bsgyur la 'dud//'jigs rung masnu na cha'i 'kho ra 'o/ can //dmar dmag dpung gis chos srid la//28

bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas dag la//blo gros rgyas kyang slar yang khyed//6)na mazurgan bsnyungan pas gcesan nu nas//mkhas chen grags pa 'bar la 'dud//ches nyen dus su srid skyong 'gas//thodad srid 'dzin la 'jigs skrag nas//dor tshe gang gis dang blangs te//chos srid cig car 'dzin la 'dud//phrag dog me lce 'bar ba 'gas//gang gi mdzad bzang ma bag da nas//rdzas sbyor cho gas gtses pa na//bdud rtsi'i bcud du bsgyur la 'dud//'jigs rung masnu na cha'i 'kho ra 'o/ can //dmar dmag dpung gis chos srid la//28

dge sbyong bse ru'i khor gtam/tshul min drag thertel brtsams pa'i tshe/sna tsho gas thabs mkhas mdzad la 'dud// 'phags yul byang chub cesas cesags kyis//spyan 'dren gnas su byon dang lhan//mkhas mchog sa khyodang ne+e ha rur//bod don bka' mchid mdzad la 'dud//rgya yul byang gi pho brang du//rgya rje ma〉( yi mdun sa nas//rgya la rgyal kha ma byin par//rgya bod so sor 'byed la 'dud//dmag dang 'phrul mdas khe ra yug kun//yongs su gang ba'i nor gling nas //dgra dmag g.yel ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyis//phyogs su byon pa khyed la 'dud//29

chol gsum dpa' tho'i bo gas dang bcas//zhabs zung bkra shis 'kho ra le'i ris//nywarngo brgyud spyan g.yas la sku gas su//rim par zhabs kyis bcags la 'dud//dgra sde'i 'phrul gyi nam mkha' lding //rgyang mchodzing shel gyi me 'o/nga can//de yi cadags su shar min pas//bsrung bya sbed mkhas khyed la 'dud//mo1na yul nye ba'i mang mang nas//dgra sdes bcom pa'i bod 'bangs spyi'i//mi bzod sdug bsngal tshur bzhes te/ /snyun gyi ngo bor bsgyur la 'dud//re zhig rang gi 'dul zhing gi/snod bcud dgra yis btsan 'phrog kyang //30

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/ring min chodas srid khri 'phang slar//len pa'i thabs su zhugs la 'dud//blang dor mig dang bral ba yi//61ga lam zhugs pa'i dmar srid la//sdang ba phar zad lhag par du//byams brtse'i yul du 'dzin la 'dud //phan tshun tshulags lhung sku ngas spangs te//rgya yi phan pa mi bsnub cing //bod kyi chag sgo bzlog pa'i phyir//gros gzhi dbu mar mdzad la 'dud//rang rigs sha rus gcig pa 'gas//bsam ngan khyodar rtsub khra'i yul las//'das pa'i 'o/ga sgrub byed pa na//thugs bskyed lhag par brtan la 'dud//31

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/ring min chodas srid khri 'phang slar//len pa'i thabs su zhugs la 'dud//blang dor mig dang bral ba yi//61ga lam zhugs pa'i dmar srid la//sdang ba phar zad lhag par du//byams brtse'i yul du 'dzin la 'dud //phan tshun tshulags lhung sku ngas spangs te//rgya yi phan pa mi bsnub cing //bod kyi chag sgo bzlog pa'i phyir//gros gzhi dbu mar mdzad la 'dud//rang rigs sha rus gcig pa 'gas//bsam ngan khyodar rtsub khra'i yul las//'das pa'i 'o/ga sgrub byed pa na//thugs bskyed lhag par brtan la 'dud//31

smon lam rnam par dag pa yi//〈snal gsum ser skya bsku da nams can//kun gyis cadams med yang yang du/ /dgyes zhal bdud rtsi 'thung la 'dud//phal bas dpag dka'i mi macadan pa'i// dbyings na mthu ldan gnas chung dang //lha mo la sogs bstan srung gis//rtag tu 'phrin las sgrub la 'dud//rgyal mtshams 'brel ba ma yin zhing / /sha rus gcig pa'i gnyen min yang //lan la re min phyi gling mis//srid 'byor mthun rkyen sgrub la 'dud//byin chags nor 'dzin yangs pa'i gzhir//bder gshegs mtshan dpe mngon gsal ba'i//32

dge sbyong bse nu'i kher gtam/'phags yul dam pa'i gzhung dmangs kyis//rtag tu rim gro mdzad la 'dud//gzhis byes 21da rigs kun kyi gshis//gzhan du mi 'gyur bya ba'i thabs//goms pa bzang po slar gsos pas//bod kyi rigs bdag khyed la 'dud//gang sku gzi 'bar phyi yul gyi//rgyal khams dag tu 'khode na yang // 'phrin las rlabs kyis nang r+shar+shags kyi//bod 'bangs dga' ba skyed la 'dud//grags pa chen sngo 'dzam gling gi/khyon las brgal ba'i skad cad che//zhi bde'i rtags ma rin chen khams//phyag mtshan gyur pa khyed la 'dud//33

dge sbyong bse nu'i kher gtam/'phags yul dam pa'i gzhung dmangs kyis//rtag tu rim gro mdzad la 'dud//gzhis byes 21da rigs kun kyi gshis//gzhan du mi 'gyur bya ba'i thabs//goms pa bzang po slar gsos pas//bod kyi rigs bdag khyed la 'dud//gang sku gzi 'bar phyi yul gyi//rgyal khams dag tu 'khode na yang // 'phrin las rlabs kyis nang r+shar+shags kyi//bod 'bangs dga' ba skyed la 'dud//grags pa chen sngo 'dzam gling gi/khyon las brgal ba'i skad cad che//zhi bde'i rtags ma rin chen khams//phyag mtshan gyur pa khyed la 'dud//33

gang gi snyan grags 'bar ba'i gtam//mkhas rgyus bswā da nas ma 15gas pas//11ga gi rlabs la bskyodan nas ni// yul gru kun tu khyab la 'dud//mchog tu brtseba'i nyin byed dbang //shes rab snang ba'i dra ba can//nyin mtshan ris med 'dzam bu gling //gsal mdzad nyi ma khyed la 'dud//drag wa'i dmag dpung ma bskul zhing //rno ngar mtshon cha ma bzung bar//dgra ngan bye ba'i snying gi khyim// gtor mdzad dmag dpon khyed la 'dud//gzhan casar 'jab nas brkus min zhing // drag wa'i thabs kyis 'a21ga min par//34

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/gzhung dmangs nor gyis phyug gyur ba'i//nor gyi bdag po khyed la 'dud//cadags bzhi mtshams bzhi'i ma11na 16) cesags//sna cenags thabs kyis bkugs min par//dbyar gyi mtsho la ngang mo bzhin// bsdu ba'i mgron bdag khyed la 'dud//rtag tu rang la dbang ba'i sa//lag mthil studan tsam snang min yang // phyi nang bod kyi rgyal bo'i khab//'dzin pa'i sa skyong skyed la 'dud//gang du byon pa'i phyogs de la//zhabs kyis bcags pa'i rdul gyi khams//ches mtho'i skye bo'i spyi gtsug gi/rgyan du 'dzin pa khyed la 'dud//35

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/gzhung dmangs nor gyis phyug gyur ba'i//nor gyi bdag po khyed la 'dud//cadags bzhi mtshams bzhi'i ma11na 16) cesags//sna cenags thabs kyis bkugs min par//dbyar gyi mtsho la ngang mo bzhin// bsdu ba'i mgron bdag khyed la 'dud//rtag tu rang la dbang ba'i sa//lag mthil studan tsam snang min yang // phyi nang bod kyi rgyal bo'i khab//'dzin pa'i sa skyong skyed la 'dud//gang du byon pa'i phyogs de la//zhabs kyis bcags pa'i rdul gyi khams//ches mtho'i skye bo'i spyi gtsug gi/rgyan du 'dzin pa khyed la 'dud//35

ljags yangs palhu'i 'dab ma las//legs gsung mngar mo'i thigs pa'i 'phreng //lugs gnyis 'dzin pa'i mkhas dgu yis//snying gi bcud du 'dzin la 'dud//byams brtse 'tshe med zhi ba yi//phan pa'i gsung dbyangs sgrog pa'i mod//'dzam gling cesas pa thams cad kyis// gtsug gi rgyan du 'dzin la 'dud//'dzam bu gling gi khyodags kun tu//zhabs zung bkod pa'i yul de la//char chu dus su 'bab pa dang //sku1 phyugs rtag tu rgyas la 'dud//gang du byon pa'i phyogs de na// rig sbyangs dbang rnon skye bo yis// 36

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/dka' gnad dri ba'i lan gyi tshig/1tegs med smra ba khyed la 'dud//phal ba ngo mtshar gyur ba yi//gzugs sgra'i tshan rig las 'phags pa'i//sems kyi tshan rig byams snying rje//cadags rnams kun tu spel la 'dud//ham can du mas rang gi lha/ga/dor nas 'tshol ba'i nor las lhag/'dod chung chog shes skyid pa'i sems//lhungags rnams kun tu bsgrags la 'dud//'tshe med zhi ba'i lam mchor+shag gi/srid lugs ma lus bde thabs su//kun gyi srid la ston byas pas//thams cad dga' ba bskyed la 'dud// 37

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/dka' gnad dri ba'i lan gyi tshig/1tegs med smra ba khyed la 'dud//phal ba ngo mtshar gyur ba yi//gzugs sgra'i tshan rig las 'phags pa'i//sems kyi tshan rig byams snying rje//cadags rnams kun tu spel la 'dud//ham can du mas rang gi lha/ga/dor nas 'tshol ba'i nor las lhag/'dod chung chog shes skyid pa'i sems//lhungags rnams kun tu bsgrags la 'dud//'tshe med zhi ba'i lam mchor+shag gi/srid lugs ma lus bde thabs su//kun gyi srid la ston byas pas//thams cad dga' ba bskyed la 'dud// 37

rigs pa'i lam nas drangs pa yi//thal 'gyur lta dang tshan rig lugs//phan tshun bsdur bas rgyal ba'i bstan//kun gyis bsngags pa brjod la 'dud//gzugs dang sgra yi rnam 'gyur kun//gsal bar ma11nga ba'i tshan rig pas//sna chosags gnad kyi dri ba la//lan gyis sku/ 11 tshim la 'dud//byams dang snying rje'i gter gyi dbang // khyed gsung gzi yis ye shu dang // kha che'i cesas pa gzur gnas rnams//byams snying bdud rtsis gsos la 'dud//las 'bras blang 〈snar gnas dag la//'dren byed bral ba'i skye bo kun//38

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/ches ma11nga mig gi dbang wa'i khams//ster ba'i sbyin bdag khyed la 'dud//rang rigs gcogen nu mtha' dag la//cor+shas dang rig pa'i gnas rnams kyi //bslab pa'i gnas su rtag sbyar pas//blun po mkhas par bsgyur la 'dud//gang gi brtse ba'i gzi rlabs kyis// 'acad khams kun tu zin byed cing //de las nyam chung bdag 'dra la// lhag par thugs rje 'bar la 'dud //theg gsum chodas dang rig pa'i gnas//rgyal thabs srid dang phun snu gas cadar//thams cad 'jordoms pas skye 'phags kun//rjes 'dzin cha rkyen ldan la 'dud//39

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/ches ma11nga mig gi dbang wa'i khams//ster ba'i sbyin bdag khyed la 'dud//rang rigs gcogen nu mtha' dag la//cor+shas dang rig pa'i gnas rnams kyi //bslab pa'i gnas su rtag sbyar pas//blun po mkhas par bsgyur la 'dud//gang gi brtse ba'i gzi rlabs kyis// 'acad khams kun tu zin byed cing //de las nyam chung bdag 'dra la// lhag par thugs rje 'bar la 'dud //theg gsum chodas dang rig pa'i gnas//rgyal thabs srid dang phun snu gas cadar//thams cad 'jordoms pas skye 'phags kun//rjes 'dzin cha rkyen ldan la 'dud//39

khyed sku gzi byin 'bar ba'i 'phreng //mang zhig lha ldan dag zhing nas//mtshan dpe'i me lta ga bzhad pa'i phyir//dbus gtsang bla ma khyed la 'dud//mdo khams lto yi sgang drug tu//thugs rje'i gter gyur khyed kyi sku//yang yang gser zhal rgyas pa'i phyir// mdo stod bla ma khyed la 'dud//phun tshogs dge bcu'i dpal spungs pa'i//sa bzang byin chags thergang kha'i yul//nyer 'khrungs skyabs kun 'dus pa'i mabosan//mdo smad bla ma khyed la 'dud// bka' lung gzegs ma phra mo sa kyang //shar gling che dgu'i brtan pa'i yid//40

khyed sku gzi byin 'bar ba'i 'phreng //mang zhig lha ldan dag zhing nas//mtshan dpe'i me lta ga bzhad pa'i phyir//dbus gtsang bla ma khyed la 'dud//mdo khams lto yi sgang drug tu//thugs rje'i gter gyur khyed kyi sku//yang yang gser zhal rgyas pa'i phyir// mdo stod bla ma khyed la 'dud//phun tshogs dge bcu'i dpal spungs pa'i//sa bzang byin chags thergang kha'i yul//nyer 'khrungs skyabs kun 'dus pa'i mabosan//mdo smad bla ma khyed la 'dud// bka' lung gzegs ma phra mo sa kyang //shar gling che dgu'i brtan pa'i yid//40

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/snub pa'i lhanar rgyal sras gyur pas//hor chen bla ma khyed la 'dud//rgyal ba sras bcas du mas kyang //btang snyoms bor ba'i gangs ljongs 'gror//brtsebs gdul byar sgyu na pa yi//gangs can mgon po khyed la 'dud//dug lnga'i cho 'phrul 'jigs rung gi/rdul masnu na dar tshe bcengachen gyis//'bad pas 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam//sgyu na mdzad 'dzam gling mgon la 'dud//sdug bsngal rtsa nas mi 'dod cing //bde la cesag shes med pa yi//lus can mtha' dag lha ba pa cad//'gro ba'i mgon po khyed la 'dud// 41

'jam dpal sprul ba bdun 11gas kyi//thugs dam gsal stong 'dzin med gzhung //gser zhun dam cesas gtsigasashadzin pas//sa chen bla ma khyed la 'dud//bka' gdams gong ma'i spyod bzang khar//thal 'gyur lta dang rim gnyis lam//kun tshang man ngag ྅gen pa'i mthosnen//dge ldan bla ma khyed la 'dud//mar mi rgan wa'i man ngag bcud//bde chen 'bar ba'i ye shes la// yang dag lta bas rgyas btab pas//phyag chen bla ma khyed la 'dud//snumags drug shes pa ma 'gag par//rig pa kun tu bzang wa'i gshis//42

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/rjen par gzigs pa'i thesgogs ldan pa//rdzogs chen bla ma khyed la 'dud//gangs can spyi yi chogeg ma'i lugs//gshen rab bstan pa'i man ngag gnad//bon lugs 'dzin la dgyes gsung bas//g.yung drung ston pa khyed la 'dud//'dzam gling khyab pa'i phyi nang chos//'gal med zhi bde rgyas pa'i bo1gas//'gyur thabs gsung gis kun khyab pas//chos kyi rgyal bo khyed la 'dud//tshul bzhin bshes gnyen bsten lugs nas//zung 'jug rgyal ba'i go 'phang bar//lung rig dpe dang nyams myong gis//'chad mkhas lam rim bdag 〈snar 'dud//43

rdzas ngan du ma 'dus pa yi//gong bur gyur ba mi yi lus//lam rim gdams pa'i stod rung gi/dal 'byor rten du sgyur la 'dud//'asnga da mo na mo la nyin mtshan kun//g.yeng ba'i skye bo sdig po che//dge la myur du bskul ba'i phyir//'chi 'awa'i gnas lugs bcadad la 'dud//sdig chen ngan 'gro'i gnas ngan du//dbang med ltung tshe bzod dka' ba'i//drag wa'i sdug bsngal bar med du//snu nga 'gyur 'bo ga par mdzad la 'dud//phyi nang khyad par 'byed pa'i snu sa//'jigs pa kun las lha/ba pa'i gnyen//44

rdzas ngan du ma 'dus pa yi//gong bur gyur ba mi yi lus//lam rim gdams pa'i stod rung gi/dal 'byor rten du sgyur la 'dud//'asnga da mo na mo la nyin mtshan kun//g.yeng ba'i skye bo sdig po che//dge la myur du bskul ba'i phyir//'chi 'awa'i gnas lugs bcadad la 'dud//sdig chen ngan 'gro'i gnas ngan du//dbang med ltung tshe bzod dka' ba'i//drag wa'i sdug bsngal bar med du//snu nga 'gyur 'bo ga par mdzad la 'dud//phyi nang khyad par 'byed pa'i snu sa//'jigs pa kun las lha/ba pa'i gnyen//44

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/gang la bsten na mi bslu ba'i//rgyu skyabs ga3rwa 1ra gdams la 'dud//skyabs bsten pa yi bslab pa'i gzhi//dkar nag las kyi rjes 'brang ste//'bras bu bde sdug 'byung ba'i phyir//blang dor gdams ngag 'chad la 'dud// sdig mang sbyang ba'i gnyen sngo mchog/thebabs bzhi tshang ba'i bshags pa dang //ltung la rang gi phyir bcos kyi//ces ga ma lus bsnyad la 'dud//yid 'ong srid 'byor de dag kyang / /rtsub mo'i tshor ba 'dren byed kyi//cha rkyen yin pas sdug bsngal las//thar ba'i gdams shāg 'chid la 'dud//45

11ga mtha' kun tu skye 11 rnams// mi 'dod sdug bsngal sna tshogs kun//'byung la ma tshang med pa'i rgyu// ༷larmi ྅ na yin par gsungs la 'dud/ /skye rgu sdug la gtod byed kyi//sna 'dren mthar thug ྅/na snu/ngas pa//dngos gnyen stobs kyis 'aXg pas cha//thar ba yin par gdams la 'dud//thar ba dam pa'i snod rung gi/ skal bzang gdul bya mtha' dag ni//bslab gsum 'phags pa'i gzhung las gyi//phyogs su mngags pa khyed la 'dud//rang wa na 'ba' zhig mi las lhag/dud 'gro 'ga' zhig stobs che phyir//46

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/mi yi khyad sbyangs byams pa dang //snying rje gzhan phan bsngags la 'dud//bstan pa'i yang bcud 〈 sna'i lugs//man ngag bdun dang zhi ba lha'i//11la bzang bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i gnad//sbrags nas 〉thon pa khyed la 'dud//rlabs chen bya dka'i cesags gnyis kyis//rang rgyud skusnan tan dpag med khams//bsgrub phyir gang gi tshangs dbyangs kyis//phyin drug sgra sgrog khyed la 'dud//mcho ga tu rgyas pa'i bcengab yis//lhu/ gsum dge bas ma zin pa'i//gang zag smin pa'i man ngag gnad//bsdu dngos thabs skyong khyed la 'dud//47

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/mi yi khyad sbyangs byams pa dang //snying rje gzhan phan bsngags la 'dud//bstan pa'i yang bcud 〈 sna'i lugs//man ngag bdun dang zhi ba lha'i//11la bzang bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i gnad//sbrags nas 〉thon pa khyed la 'dud//rlabs chen bya dka'i cesags gnyis kyis//rang rgyud skusnan tan dpag med khams//bsgrub phyir gang gi tshangs dbyangs kyis//phyin drug sgra sgrog khyed la 'dud//mcho ga tu rgyas pa'i bcengab yis//lhu/ gsum dge bas ma zin pa'i//gang zag smin pa'i man ngag gnad//bsdu dngos thabs skyong khyed la 'dud//47

shes sgrib phra rags spang rung dang // lha yi rnal 'byor bsgrub rung gi//rnam kun masnu ga ldan lha nga ba nyid//rten 'byung lam nas 44na la 'dud//rdo rje theg pa'i kyā rung la//sku bzhi'i sa 11na thebs nges kyi//dbang bskur brgyud bshad man ngag gi/gsum ldan bla mar gyur la 'dud// mdor na sa dge bka' rnying dang //11na sku/gas bshad sku/la 'dra min lugs//tha snyad tsam yang ma bsres par// so so'i lugs su 'chad la 'dud//phyi nang codas dang srid lugs kyi//dmangs gtso dmar wa'i lta ba dang //48

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/tshan rig dang bcas phan tshun du//'gal med zhi bde sgrub la 'dud//cesas kyi khri la bzhugs tsa na//mkhas shing grub pa'i skyes ma〉teg dang //stod ldan ser skya dpag med kyi/ /'khor gyis yongs su bskor la 'dud//srid kyi khri la bzhugs tsa na//phyi nang srid lugs mkhyen pa'i spyan//yangs pa'i gzhung 'dzin bka' spyi skustegs//wad dpon tshogs kyis bsgor la 'dud//chos dang srid kyi sho je'i tshig/gang gi yid du smin pa na//'phral bde phugs su skyid 'thob pas//kun gyis dang du len la 'dud//49

rtag tu ྅ted lam thams cad du//rlabs chen sems gnyis phyin drug dang / /bsdu bzhi zab gsal gnyis med kyi//rnal 'byor rtag tu brtson la 'dud //lha mi ngan pas 'o/ga sgrub kyi//las ngan drag lnga'i macesan cha yis//dge slob 'khor bcas brlags na yang //bzod mchog go cha mthug la 'dud// thugs rje'i gter gyur gangs ljongs mgon//rgyal macor+shag dge 'dun grub pa nas//mdo smad skyes mchog khyed kyi bar//bka' drin skusnan tan dran te 'dud//de ltar gus pas 'dud pa yi//tshigs su bcad pa brgya rtsabargyad//50

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/brtsams pa'i dge bas bdag gzhan kun//brtse ldan bla mas rjes 'dzin phyogag/ tshe 'khrid brgyud pa'i bla ma dang //tshe sbyin lha yi mthu stobs kyis//tshe 'phel bdud rtsis gangs can mgon//tshe brtan rdo je'i sku 'thob shog/gang gis dka' ba brgya phrag gis//bsgrubs pa'i rgya wad zhi 'grig nyin//nga yi skyes yul mdzod dge ru//brtseb chen 〈snas 'khyodan par zhu//gangs ljongs sa yi shar mtha' dang //chen po rgya la sa 'brel yul//bstan pa'i rjodan me 'khrungs pa'i sar/brtse ba chen 〈snas 'droten par zhu//51

khri ral rgyal wa'i phyag mchos kyis//daX rjodang chas kyis spras byas nas//khral len gzhi chags gyur pa'i sde//mdzod dge'i yul du 'byon par zhu //shog pa lnga dang tsho ba brgyad//dgon pa bzhi dang ri khrod bcu'i//skya ser skye 'phags dad ldan gyi// re ba bskang phyir 'byon par zhu//dmar khyedags dmag gis ngo da yul du//thog mar bod mgo gtor ba'i yul//yin phyir sa 'di'i lhag lus mi'i//mya ngan sel phyir 'khyodan par zhu//de ltar gso/la ba btab pa'i mthus//dgyes bzhin bdag gi skyes yul du//52

khri ral rgyal wa'i phyag mchos kyis//daX rjodang chas kyis spras byas nas//khral len gzhi chags gyur pa'i sde//mdzod dge'i yul du 'byon par zhu //shog pa lnga dang tsho ba brgyad//dgon pa bzhi dang ri khrod bcu'i//skya ser skye 'phags dad ldan gyi// re ba bskang phyir 'byon par zhu//dmar khyedags dmag gis ngo da yul du//thog mar bod mgo gtor ba'i yul//yin phyir sa 'di'i lhag lus mi'i//mya ngan sel phyir 'khyodan par zhu//de ltar gso/la ba btab pa'i mthus//dgyes bzhin bdag gi skyes yul du//52
4 4 zhabs zung bkra shis ri snung yisasgod bcud byin gyis brlab gyur
4 4 zhabs zung bkra shis ri snung yisasgod bcud byin gyis brlab gyur

༄༅༅// bod gangs can gyi btsan byol ba gtso gzhung dmangs gsum gyi byas rjes bzang po rang gi blo tshod kyis mthong ba'i snga na la gnas pa'i sku na tan brtsodad pa las/rgezhung dga' ldan 'o/ brang khyodags las rnam rgyal gyi yon tan brjod pa gangs ljongs 6)sa srid kyi gzhung shing zhes bya ba bzhugs 11//dga' ldan pho brang srid 'dzin snga rabs 'gas//chab srid ming gi lhag mar bsgyur ba na//'phags pa'i yul du gangs lhurangs lugs gnyis kyi// grags 'bar lte gnas 'dzin pa'i mabo na de rgyal// /shes rab che gsal myur zhing zab pa'i lha//'jam dbyangs ngur smrig gar gyis rnam rol ba//54

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/kun mkhyen yab sras 'khrungs rabs kun kyis bdag/tshe rabs rjes su 'dzin pa'i shis pa stsol//bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs kyi chos lugs dang //rig gzhung dpal 'byor sa sde mi la sogs//yun ring gnas par 'dod na bla dpon dang //'bangs kyis rang gzhung bkur ba man ngag lags//'acadar ba yar rgyas can gyi phun tsho gas la//'gram chu rang dbang med par ldang ba can// bdag dang bdag 'dra'i chos pa de dag gis//chab srid mi dbotos zhes bya gad mo'i gnas//mi med lung pa stong ba'i brag phug tu//chu dang za tshod tsam gyi 'tsho na gyis// lus rgyas sems skyid snumar bas sim gyur na//chab srid mi dgos zer yang don la gnas//55

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/kun mkhyen yab sras 'khrungs rabs kun kyis bdag/tshe rabs rjes su 'dzin pa'i shis pa stsol//bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs kyi chos lugs dang //rig gzhung dpal 'byor sa sde mi la sogs//yun ring gnas par 'dod na bla dpon dang //'bangs kyis rang gzhung bkur ba man ngag lags//'acadar ba yar rgyas can gyi phun tsho gas la//'gram chu rang dbang med par ldang ba can// bdag dang bdag 'dra'i chos pa de dag gis//chab srid mi dbotos zhes bya gad mo'i gnas//mi med lung pa stong ba'i brag phug tu//chu dang za tshod tsam gyi 'tsho na gyis// lus rgyas sems skyid snumar bas sim gyur na//chab srid mi dgos zer yang don la gnas//55

dgra bos 'tshe ba byas na mi dga' zhing //dad ldan mi yis bkur tshe dga' 'gyur na//bla ma dge bshes yin yang rang gzhung gi/chab srid da dung spong ba'i dus ma yin//sa dge bka' rnying gzhung gi theg chen gtam//rigs drug bde la 'god ces mtshar mod kyi//de bas bstan 'dzin thams cad zhal bo sa te//bod 'di bde la 'god na ci ma rung //rang gi rigs su galta gas pa'i bsil ldan pa//bsad dang btson 'jug dpal 'byor 'phrog pa yi//sdug bsngal 'bo ga pa'i thabs la brtson min na// dmyal 1—gas sems can tshulab ces su yid ches//snu la gsum snu sa lugs kun gyi ma1sgo rim mi//mthun pa'i yid kyis bosgos la zhugs pa na//56

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/gangs ljongs skyid pa'i nyi ma 'od po che//'char la macadan du khyodags pa'i skya rengs nyid//rna ba'i drung du rnga chen ches drag tu//rdung yang mi zhig pa yi ting nge 'dzin//brtan sngo mo da kyang gangs khyodangs 'bo spyi la// bde skyid phun tshogs gnas su sbyor ba dka'//de bas chodas dang 'jig rten sgrub pa ngo sa /rang nyid gcig pur gangs ljongs skyob pa'i mthu//med par mchodang na chodal gsum chig sgril gzhung //lha las lhag tu bkur na bod don 'grub// skyabs mabo/na mchodag dang zam gasnga nga sprul skus ga3 sa//ser skya dpa' thod lhag bsam can rnams kyis//snu la gsum spyi gzhung chothos srid gnyis kyi lugs//yun ring dam du bzung ba'i bka' drin sgoms//57

phyag na pasdus skyabs maskra|na rgyal ba yis//chol gsum srid dang gsar rnying chodas lugs kun//skyong la sdongs grogs byed pa'i ya rabs mi//mthu ldan lha dang bcas pa'i bka' drin sgoms//gang gis 11da snga na sgrub la mthun pa'i rkyen//sbyor bar byed pa'i 'byor ldan 'dzam gling gi/shar nub kun tu khyab pa'i skye 1sgo yi//gtong phod rtsod pa med pa'i bka' drin sgoms//rdzogs chen phyag chen gsal stong 'dzin med dang //thal rang lta ba 'dzin pa'i mkhas rnams kyis//bstan pa phyi la spel zhing phyi yi nor//nang du bkug pa'i bka' drin kun gyis 〈(mas//rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyi la spel ba dang //phyi yi dpal 'acadar nang du bkug nas yodad//58

dge sbyong bse nu'i kher gtam/spyi la phan pa'i ma 〉(ngas mdun lam bzang //'asnu'ol bar byed pa kun kyi bka' drin sbra(mas//ma 'ongs dus su bod la bde dga'i dpal//'dren pa'i thabs mchog da lta 'phags yul 'dir//grags pa 'bar pa'i rang gzhung 'di yi drin//'bur du thon pa'i bka' drin yang yang sgoms//dgā' ba brgya ldas sgrub pa yi//chos srid spya brazlo phyogs kun las//rnam par rgyal ba'i ther+sha pan can//rnongs ljongarmi kun kyis bkur ba'i gzhung //cesal gsum gcig tu sgril ba yi// gzhung ni 〈snad rigs kun kyi gshis//gzhan du mi 'gyur 'dzin nus pas//srog shing lta bu'i 'du shes skyed//59

snudal gsum gcig tu sgril ba yi//gzhung ni sa dge bka' rnying bon/ /kun kyi bstan pa 'acirdon nus pas//bla ma lta bu'i 'du shes skyed//cesal gsum gcig tu sgril ba yi//gzhung ni bod kyi sa sde mi//thams cad lhadang bar bya nus pas//rgyal bo lta bu'i 'du shes skyed//chodal gsum gcig tu sgril ba yi//gzhung ni bod kyi bde ba kun//sgrub cing sdug bsngal sel nus pas//pha ma lta bu'i 'du shes skyed//thosnel gsum gcig tu sgril ba'i gzhung //rgyal ba'i bstan dang rig gzhung rnams//60

dge sbyong bse ru'i khor gtam/ yul khams kun tu spel ba la//son 'debs lta bu'i 'du shes skyed //mār+shal gsum gcig tu sgril ba'i gzhung //yul khams gzhan gyi rig gzhung dang //dpal 'byor nang du 'gug pa'i thabs//lcags kyu lta bu'i 'du shes skyed//mi 'jigs/ seṅges btegs pa'i khrir/ / brjid chags btsoldan sprul ba'i skus//snying rje'i bcud ldan rgyal ba'i bstan// gnas par dathodangs na rang gzhung khyodabs//rigs pa'i gad rgyangs gcig gis kyang //log smra'i snying rtsa'adar byed pa'i//mkhas pas lung dang rigs pa'i gzhung //gnas par dgongs na rang gzhung skyobs//61

sod rgyus smra la mgrin pa'i lam//macesag tu yangs pa'i rgyal rabs pas//bod kyi snod bcud khor yug kun//bskyang bar 'dod na rang gzhung skyobs//tshig 'phreng mdzes pa'i rtsom pa pos//snyan pa'i grags pa gling 'dir yun//ring du gnas par su zhig gis//'dod na rang gi gzhung 'di skyobs//dpa' ngar ngom pa'i stag gi spun//ngar ldan mtshon cha'i bdag po rnams// rtul 'od phyogs kun bsgrag 'dod na//rang don g.yug la rang gzhung skyobs// phyi yi spyode lam 'jam wa'i nyams//nang gi rig pa tsher ma can// 62

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/phyi nang mi mtshungs cor+sha 'phrul gzugs//ston na rang gi gzhung 'di skyobs/ /chol gsum bod mi 'tsho ba'i gzhung //rtsal dgu bton te skyob pa yi//sprul sku masnu ga dang mkhas pa'i dbang //gang na su bzhugs de la 'du da//dpa' sgod rbab rdo thur rgyug dang //rnam dacadad 11ga zhags 'khyug pa'i rlabs//su la sku/da pa lhag bsam gyis//brgyan na 11da mi spyi la phan//dpa' cadas mtshon cha nang sa ra dang // mkhas pas phu mda'adakrug na ni//phyi dgra las ni nang gi dgra// rang rigs 'joms pa'i gshed ma nyid//63

dgra brgya 'jo mas pa'i dpa' ngo dang //mig rgyang bsring ba'i mkhas pa gnyis//spyi the na sgrub la bo(sa 'cham na//tshudags las rgyal ba'i rgyal dar 'phyar//dgra gnyen mi shes dpa' thod dang //spyi sems med pa'i shes rab can//mang yang sa sde mi gsum gyi//bdag por 'gyur ba'i re ba med//dpa' zhing thugs dkyil che ba dang //rang 'bangs byams pas skyong dang lhan//gzhan dag thabs kyis bsdu ba'i da11na//sems shig sku(da na gtsug tu bkur//snod bcud yongs kyi srog lta bu//chos srid 'thor ba sdud pa'i gzhung // 64

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/snying marnag gis zin med na//rang lus lta bu'i gces 'dzin mdzod//mi rigs su la'ang bca' khrims kyi//bka' rgya dam wa'i gzhung sku1da na//dpal 'byor sna tshogs rig gnas dang //chos lugs sogs kyi rtsab brtan// btsan byol gtso phal zla bsgril te//g.yar ba'i sa na btsugs pa'i gzhung //gzhis byes bod mi'i srog lta bu 'i//bka' drin malnga nga lnga sa bswā da kyis sho/na//sngon tshe bod yul lha ldan du//cesas wisad la rgya stag g.yag bzhin//mche sder rwa rtses 'debs res kyis/ /spyi don sha lpags rngon pas 'phrog /65

'on kyang sa 'dir bsam bzang dang //mkhas shing gzur gnas 'das gson gyis//ngal brgyas bsgrubs pa'i mang gatho'i gzhung //chol gsum wad mi'i dpal du shar//mang gtso'i gzhung gi dbang 'dzin pa//rigs rus mthon wa'i gdung rgyud min//bla ma chen wa'i sku mched min//mkhas mdzangs gathos che rigs mi gtso//ya rabs sku1na tan phun cesags na//'byor med rgan mo kher 'dug ma'i//bu chung snabs 'dzar de nyid kyang //dmangs kyis bkur te rgyal khab 'dzin//ya rabs sku1na tan spangs gyur na //dpon wa'i gdung rgyud bla ma'i spun//66

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/ phyug wa'i bu dang btsan wa'i rgyud//de dag mi ser khrod na lus// mang gatho'i gzhung gi srid 'dzin par //skyon brjod yig 'phreng spel na yang //klad pa gtor ba'i me mdang dang //yan lag 'ching ba'i lcags cadag med//rang gi 'asnga da pas bzang ngan gtam//rlung dang nywa ga gi rba rlabs la//skyon te 'dzam gling sgrog na yang //kha khrims med pas mang gasgu skyid//mang la 'dod pa ci yod pa// gzhung gis de ltar sgrub pa las//mang la 'thodad pa med na ni//gzhung gis gnya' gcadad med pas skyid//67

gzhung gi bca' khrims mang gi sdusar//ma 'thad ngo log zing langs kyang //dmag skul macesan chas drag ga3rten gyis//'bangs rnams bsod rdung med pas skyid//rgyal ba'i mtshan dpe'i pad+ma'i 'dzum//skye dgu'i dpal du bzhad pa'i yul//byin chags cathor 'dzin rgya gar gyi//dha sa'i btsan byol gzhung 'di rgyal//gangs ri'i khrod kyi wad ces pa'i// snyan pa'i grags pa 'dzam gling gi/kho ra yug kun tu khyab pa 'di//btsan byol gzhung gi drin du go/theg pa gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i//'chad nyan cadags kun spel ba na//68

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/ bod 'di chodas ldan rgyal khab ces// bsngags pa gzhung gi drin du bo /sa dge bka' rnying g.yung drung bon//kun gyi mkhas mang 'dzam gling cadan//snu sa wa na bstan pa spel ba 'di//btsan byol gzhung gi drin du go/ ser skya gang zhig 'byor ldan gyi//rgyal khab gang du skyodad na lam//yod pa de ni chol gsum spyi'i//gzhung 'di yod pa'i drin du go/yul khams gzhan gyi dmangs ltosad du// rang gi skad dang yig rigs sku gas//ltod med gces shing 'dzin pa 'di//btsan byol gzhung gi drin du go/69

rang rigs gatheṭan nu 21 snu/ rnams//gzhan gyi skad yig lnga ga med du //smra brjod rgyas pa'i spobs pa 'di//btsan byol gzhung gi drin du thod/sa mtha'i yul na rang 'bangs la/ / gzhan gyi 'tshe ba ma byung bar//bag yangs spyod pa'i bde ba 'di//btsan byol gzhung gi drin du go/bod nas nor 'phrog lag stong du//btsan gyis sa mthar bskrad na yang //deng dus dpal 'byor phun tshogs 'di//btsan byol gzhung gi drin du go/sa dge bka' rnying cadan bcas pa'i//mkhas btsun gser ri'i 'phreng 'dras chodas//70

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/'dzin skyong spel ba'i mdzad bzang 'di//btsan byol gzhung gi drin du go/dmar phyogs gzhung gis brtse med du//mi drag bsad la bshags pa'i lhurtor//brgya phrag sprad pa de nyid kyang //btsan cadal gzhung gi drin min nam//thar med btson khang bcug pa yi//bla dacadan phyug po btsan wa'i bu//rgas khar rang yul mthong ba de//btsan cadal gzhung gi drin min nam//khyodan gyi zhwa mote brtsegs pa'i mi'i//yan lag lcags 11ga dam wa'i rgya//grod de dga' ba'i 'dzum mdangs de//btsan cadal gzhung gi drin min nam//71

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/'dzin skyong spel ba'i mdzad bzang 'di//btsan byol gzhung gi drin du go/dmar phyogs gzhung gis brtse med du//mi drag bsad la bshags pa'i lhurtor//brgya phrag sprad pa de nyid kyang //btsan cadal gzhung gi drin min nam//thar med btson khang bcug pa yi//bla dacadan phyug po btsan wa'i bu//rgas khar rang yul mthong ba de//btsan cadal gzhung gi drin min nam//khyodan gyi zhwa mote brtsegs pa'i mi'i//yan lag lcags 11ga dam wa'i rgya//grod de dga' ba'i 'dzum mdangs de//btsan cadal gzhung gi drin min nam//71

'jag skyas khyab pa'i dbodzin shul du//btsun pa rgan 21sa rgyal ba'i bstan//slar gso'i 'bad pa stod med de//btsan cadal gzhung gi drin min nam//mtherdzor na thodal gsum chig sgril gyi//gzhung gis bod kyi stod bcud kun//bsrung ba'i 'bad pa 'dir dpog na //bsngags pa mi brjod su zhig yod//'tshe med zhi ba'i srid lugs la//mdzes ma'i bzhin la'ang mi gzigs pa'i//'dul 'dzin chos pa dge tshul slong //zhugs kyang cor+shas la ci'i phyir 'gal// bod la bde skyid 'byung ba'i thabs//rgya la rtsis med mi bya bar//72

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/gnyis ka skyid pa'i dbu ma'i lam//gzur gnas su zhig der mi dga'//11da kyis rgyal bstan spel ba dang //rgya yis dpal 'acadar skrun pa na//chos 'byor ldan pa'i yul ljongs la//skye bo su zhig dga' mi byed//rgya 11da mthun pa'i dge mtshan gyis//zhing phyugs 'byor ba yar ldan gyi//bza' bca'i 'asnu ba phun tshogs te//yul gzhan mi yi 'gram chu ldang //bod la rang dbang gnang ba'i nyin//rgya rigs dpon rnams lha ltar brtsi//sku tshe brtan pa'i zhabs brtan sgrub//mdzan 'phrin rgyas pa'i sgyu ma lam 'debs//73

'dzam gling thod la'i khyedags bcu yi//nyam thag lhamab pa'icag ri'i gzhung // tshad ldan mang gtso khyed lta bu//shar phyogs 'di na sngon chad med//da lta bod dang 'dabs 'brel na// dkar nag rgya yi dmag rtsal gyis//nyam thag yul gyi cesas srid kun// dar rgud gang yin dbye 'byed dka'//yul ljongs chen po gnyis kyi bar//gnas pa'i chodas ldan gangs can par//chos srid rang dbang gtsang ma'i dpal//nam zhig 'a〈snab na rgya tho/da skyid//rgya rigs bde la 'god 'dod kyis//lnga/da sku/gas pham pa'i chab srid de//74

dge sbyong bse ru'i khor gtam/gzur gnas mkhas pa'i lugs min pas//bde ba bskrad cing sdug bsngal 'gug /rgya rigs dpon po ya rabs kyi//lam du zhugs te yodad 11gas la//rang dbang dga' bde sbyin na ni//shar gling mi yis pha ltar brtsi//rgya rigs da11na 11 rgyal bstan gyi//lag len las 'bras brtsi ba dang //nyam chung skyob pa'i lugs 'dzin na//'dzam gling mi rnams yid smon 'gyur//rgya rigs dalhu/na 11 kun gyi thugs//byams dang snying rje gzhan phan gyi//gter du gyur na 'dzam gling 'di'i//zhi bde 'dzin pa'i mgon du 'gyur//75

dge sbyong bse ru'i khor gtam/gzur gnas mkhas pa'i lugs min pas//bde ba bskrad cing sdug bsngal 'gug /rgya rigs dpon po ya rabs kyi//lam du zhugs te yodad 11gas la//rang dbang dga' bde sbyin na ni//shar gling mi yis pha ltar brtsi//rgya rigs da11na 11 rgyal bstan gyi//lag len las 'bras brtsi ba dang //nyam chung skyob pa'i lugs 'dzin na//'dzam gling mi rnams yid smon 'gyur//rgya rigs dalhu/na 11 kun gyi thugs//byams dang snying rje gzhan phan gyi//gter du gyur na 'dzam gling 'di'i//zhi bde 'dzin pa'i mgon du 'gyur//75

sngon gyi dus su rgya yi yul//theg chen bstan pa da ra ba'i mthus//phan sems can gyi phul byung mi//gtan zad 'gyur ba mi srid snyam//ri bo rtse lnga'i rten drung du//rgya rigs gachoṭan nu'i gus lugs la// dpog na da dung sangs rgyas kyi//bstan pa'i bag chags sku1da par sems//ma hwa tsi na'i spyi dacadan gyis//mes wa'i lugs bzang rgyal ba'i bstan//gtsug tu bkur ba'i nyin snu/ nas//sangs rgyas bstan pa'i cangab brtan//phyi gtsang nang gtsang dge 'dun sde//chen cad rgya yi yul gru kun//76

dge spyong bse ru'i khor gtam/khyab pa'i dus bzang shar ba na//sangs rgyas bstan pa'i yal ga rgyas//byams dang snying rje rab rgyas te//nyam chung skye bo mtha' dag gi/phra rags sdug bsngal sel ba na//sangs rgyas bstan pa'i 'bras bu smin//bod rgya'i gtso 'dzin thugs mthun te//zhi gros gcig gis yul ljongs gnyis//chos srid rang dbang dga' ba'i sgo//dbye ste zhi bde'i bsti gnas 'grub//bod kyi sum rtags dag gsum gyi//yig tshogs yid ngor shar ba rnams//byang dang mi brjed bya ba'i thabs tshigs su bcad pa 'di bris so//77

'di yi brtsod bya srid lugs la//re ba yod phyir thar 'dod kyis//gzigs na dgyes par mi 'gyur zhing //phal cher khrel dathoged 'acesar ba'i gnas//'on kyang bstan pa'i dar rgud ni//chab srid yang 'o/ga 'phel 'grib la//rag lus phyir na 〈snas pa 'gas//rtsom 'di la ni yi rangs 'gyur//bla ma macesag gsum las 'bras kyi//bden mthu yang dag smon lam stobs//bya dka'i snyu la sgrub du ma'i mthus//rgya zhi bod 'grig yong bar shog/gangs can mabo na khro'i rla bas chen 'phrin las dang //bka' sgrub gzhung 'dzin mi yi lhag bsam dang //78

'di yi brtsod bya srid lugs la//re ba yod phyir thar 'dod kyis//gzigs na dgyes par mi 'gyur zhing //phal cher khrel dathoged 'acesar ba'i gnas//'on kyang bstan pa'i dar rgud ni//chab srid yang 'o/ga 'phel 'grib la//rag lus phyir na 〈snas pa 'gas//rtsom 'di la ni yi rangs 'gyur//bla ma macesag gsum las 'bras kyi//bden mthu yang dag smon lam stobs//bya dka'i snyu la sgrub du ma'i mthus//rgya zhi bod 'grig yong bar shog/gangs can mabo na khro'i rla bas chen 'phrin las dang //bka' sgrub gzhung 'dzin mi yi lhag bsam dang //78

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/mthu ldan dmar nag srung ma'i lhu/ngas lha gas kyis// btsan byol thod kyi grags snyan 'dzam gling ldir//btsan byol gzhung gi 'dzin skyong las khungs dang //ra nga gzhung skyob par byed pa'i tshogs pa dang / / phyi gling mi yis ram 'degs byas pa'i tshul//tshigs bcad re re'ilam nas brjod par bya//skyabs maboton rgyal bas bstsal ba'i lugs gnyis kyi//bka' lung ci mchis 'phral du sgrub dang lhan// gzhung mang kun la cadag cing dpal 'khyodar rnams// spro bsdu'i byed po sku sger yig tshang lags// ji srid bod pa gnas pa de srid du//gzhung gi 'dzin skyong bkod 'doms rgyun ldan du//'gan gyi gtso bo 'khur ba'i pha lta bu//lugs gnyis lhasag shing 'dzin pa bka' shag lags//79

byung zin sems kyi sdug bsngal sel byed dang //'byung 'gyur sdig pa'i lhu/ snu 'bo ga thabs kyi//gsar rnying chos dang g.yung drung bon gyi lugs//'dzin lharmeng las 'gan 'khur ba cesas ro/na lags//rang gi sngar yod rig gzhung gzhir bzung nas//nyer malta'i phyi gling rig gzhung zung 'brel gyi//khyodab ma phyogs mthar spel ba'i 'dzin skyodang gi/las 'gan dang du len pa shes rig lags//byung zin chag cad ma lus 'dum pa dang // 'byung 'gyur rnyog dra'i sgo mo 'gog thabs kyi//rtsub mo'i tshig dang dbyug pas brdung pa sku gas///drag sbyor sprodab thang sku da pa bde srung lags //nyam thag dbul bor zas gos sbyor ba dang //gzhung 'dzin las la med du me rung ba'i//80

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/nor phyir bzo tshong bun skyed la sogs pa'i//las rigs 'khur du 'dzin pa dpal 'acadar lags//rgyal khab kun tu bkram pa'i btsan sdudal 11da//kun gyi zas bo|sa gnas mal la 11gas pa'i//rgud pa lharmeb pa'i thabs lam sna cesags pa//dang len 'gan du bzhes pa nang srid lags// nang gi gnas tshul phyi ru 'grem pa dang //phyi yi legs cha gang yode nang khul du//'dren pa'i thabs la rtag tu bce na pa'i khur//dang du len pa'i las 'dzin phyi srid lags//byung zin lus kyi zug rngu bcos thabs dang //'byung 'gyur na tsha ma lus 'bo ga thabs su//phyi nang sman sbyor khor yug gtsang sbra'i las//bce na dang bslab bya mdzad pa 'a'o/da bsten lags//81

cadags kun bkram pa'i ris med mi mang rnams//srid gzhung gcig gi categ tu 'dren pa'i thabs /byed dang lhan du dmangs kyi bde sdug kun//sgrub dang sel ba'i gzhung 'dzin spyi 'thus lags//khyim gyi bza' tshang 'khrugs pa'i ro/na rkyen nas//bka' khri spyi gatho rwargar ba'i kha mchu'i bar//drang bden skad cha'i lam nas 'grig thabs kyi//bar 'dum gzur gnas ches mtho'i khrims zhib lags//gzhung gi srog shing 'dzin pa bka' shag dang // cadags kun bkram pa'i mang tshab spyi 'thus dang // gzur gnas ches mtho'i khrims zhib dang bcas pa//mang gatho'i gzhung gi ka ba gsum du grags/ /gzhan gyi dbang du ma gyur 'os bsdu dang //rang dbang cha tshang yod pa'i 'dems bsgo dang //82

cadags kun bkram pa'i ris med mi mang rnams//srid gzhung gcig gi categ tu 'dren pa'i thabs /byed dang lhan du dmangs kyi bde sdug kun//sgrub dang sel ba'i gzhung 'dzin spyi 'thus lags//khyim gyi bza' tshang 'khrugs pa'i ro/na rkyen nas//bka' khri spyi gatho rwargar ba'i kha mchu'i bar//drang bden skad cha'i lam nas 'grig thabs kyi//bar 'dum gzur gnas ches mtho'i khrims zhib lags//gzhung gi srog shing 'dzin pa bka' shag dang // cadags kun bkram pa'i mang tshab spyi 'thus dang // gzur gnas ches mtho'i khrims zhib dang bcas pa//mang gatho'i gzhung gi ka ba gsum du grags/ /gzhan gyi dbang du ma gyur 'os bsdu dang //rang dbang cha tshang yod pa'i 'dems bsgo dang //82

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/ma1—na lnga'i cad bsrung mi dbosas rtsis zhib rnams//rang dbang ldan pa'i las khungs gsum du grags//rang gzhung skyob par byed pa'i tshogs pa ni/ /chol kha gsum dang gzhon nu bud med dang //rgyal yongs mang gtso dpa' bo dgu bcu gsum//mnga' ris snumags pa dang bcas brgyad du grags//brgyad ldan rta mchog gtsang wa'i stod smad du//gnas shing 'chos ba'i macesag dman kun gyi gshis//dam snu sa sgrub la dga' ba'i choges ldan gyi//zhing khams bod yul ste gnas dbus gtsang lags//'bri chu lta la lhu gas pa'i shar nub tu//snying gi dbus na lcags kyi phur bu can// gangs ljongs rgyal bstan 'dzin pa dpa' tho'i sde//gzugs bzang gshis ka brtan pa masnga lha da lags//83

rma gtsang shar la 'bab pa'i bho byang na//snying gi rtsen ral gri'i 'khor lo yis//shes bya'i mdud rgya 'thag pa'i byed las can//rig gnas 'od snang 'bar pa mdo smad lags//lus ther+shabs rgyas pas bya ba kun la grim//sems shugs dar bas rig gnas sna snumags sbyangs//mi rigs la rgya 'dzin cing thosnegs wa'i chosags//'dzam gling kun la khyab pa gachothon nu lags// mi rigs rang btsan rtsod pa'i bya byed dang //lhan du nyam thag bud med skyob byed cing //bgrang yas rgyab lha1ra 'dzam gling 〈snags kun na // blo gas mo'i chortags kyis gang ba bud med lags// mang la 'dod pa med pa'i lam phyogs la//drag 'ded btsan bskul las la mi sbyor zhing //84

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/gang 'dod gdam ga yod pa'i bzang lam du//'jam wa'i tshig gis 'khrid pa mang gathe lags//rang don yal bar dor nas rang rigs ched// rang sku ga 'ben la bzhag nas rang btsan brtsad//rang yul sdod thabs bral nas rang sa bzhag/gangs ljongs dpa' bo dpa' mo dgu bcu gsum//chos phyir sku srog dor ba'i ye shes 'od//gangs ljongs spyi la brtses dgongs byang chub 'od//nyer 'khrungs ti se lhun po'i khor yug na//gnas shing 'tsho ba'i 'brog sde mnga' ris lags//bdag ni ri thotho nags kyis bkab pa'i kho da// gnas pas spyi ཿṭāgs las la swār+shangs gyur pas//'di yi ca rwaku go rim ci'i mi 'khrugs//de la dbe|ngas 'gal med pa mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen//85

gangs ljongs gtso gzhung dmangs la sa mtha' 'dir//lag mthil cadan tsam dbangaba'i sa med kyang //g.yar ba'i sa na btsugs pa'i gzhung 'di la// bkur bsti ram 'degs 'dzam gling kun tu khyab//skyabs mthothon rgyal bas gnang pa'i mang gatho'i gzhung //mchosan pa'i lugs gnyis rgyal dar rlabs sngo che//gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i ba gam mthon wa'i rtser// 'jam wa'i rlung gis dal gyis bskyod par shog/rang gi mi rigs su 'dra zhig gis byas rjes bzang 1sna ci 'dra zhig bzhag yod na/ de la rjes su yi rangs kyi sgo nas bstod bkur bsngags gsum byed rgyu gal chen 1te yin par snang lags// //

gangs ljongs gtso gzhung dmangs la sa mtha' 'dir//lag mthil cadan tsam dbangaba'i sa med kyang //g.yar ba'i sa na btsugs pa'i gzhung 'di la// bkur bsti ram 'degs 'dzam gling kun tu khyab//skyabs mthothon rgyal bas gnang pa'i mang gatho'i gzhung //mchosan pa'i lugs gnyis rgyal dar rlabs sngo che//gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i ba gam mthon wa'i rtser// 'jam wa'i rlung gis dal gyis bskyod par shog/rang gi mi rigs su 'dra zhig gis byas rjes bzang 1sna ci 'dra zhig bzhag yod na/ de la rjes su yi rangs kyi sgo nas bstod bkur bsngags gsum byed rgyu gal chen 1te yin par snang lags// //

ra༅༅// bod gangs can gyi btsan byol gtso gzhung mang gsum gyi byas rjes bzang po rang gi blo chod kyis mthong ba'i don la gnas pa'i sku/na tan bathegad pa las/ dmangs lhag bsam can chodal gsum ser skya sku ngas kyi sku na tan bcadad pa chig sgril rdo je'i gong bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so//'jigs rung drag dmag bye ba'i dpung stobs kyis//swā ngar masnuran cha'i char ba phab na yang //kun tu byams pa'i zhal ras 'dzum gyi mdangs//yal bar ma gyur gangs can gtso la 'dud//gangs ljongs dbus kyi thub bstan snang ba'i mdzod//mdo smad mun pa'i gling du 'dren mdzad pa// 'jam mawaXn bla ma kun mkhyen yab sras 11gas//rgyun 'dzin mkhas grub rnams la phyag 'tshal sbas//87

ra༅༅// bod gangs can gyi btsan byol gtso gzhung mang gsum gyi byas rjes bzang po rang gi blo chod kyis mthong ba'i don la gnas pa'i sku/na tan bathegad pa las/ dmangs lhag bsam can chodal gsum ser skya sku ngas kyi sku na tan bcadad pa chig sgril rdo je'i gong bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so//'jigs rung drag dmag bye ba'i dpung stobs kyis//swā ngar masnuran cha'i char ba phab na yang //kun tu byams pa'i zhal ras 'dzum gyi mdangs//yal bar ma gyur gangs can gtso la 'dud//gangs ljongs dbus kyi thub bstan snang ba'i mdzod//mdo smad mun pa'i gling du 'dren mdzad pa// 'jam mawaXn bla ma kun mkhyen yab sras 11gas//rgyun 'dzin mkhas grub rnams la phyag 'tshal sbas//87

thod yul chos ldan gyi zhing khams su bod rigs ser skya yongs kyis chos dang chab srid gnyis las chos gajorwa 1 byed pa dang / tshe 'di phyi gnyis las phyi ma dang / rang gzhan gnyis las gzhan gathog na byas te dmag dang drag chas kyi 'du 'thod la mi brtson par dpal 'byor rang la 'tsho ba tsam ma gtogs mang che ba dam pa'i chosadar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i slad du btang ste/ da lta'i bar du gnas te 'dzam bu gling ba rnams la byams snying rtsa ba can gyi sangs rgyas kyi cesas ni 'di yin cad ges bstan du sku/da pa ni lha/da rigs ser skya snga rabs pa rnams kyi rtsol sgrub bar ma chad pa'i drin las byung ba yin par mkhas blun su 'dra zhig yin na rtogs sla'o// de lta bu'i chos ldan kyi yul khams bzang po de nyid klo bur dudamar dmag gis thod kyi cad thams cad dbang du bsdus/ bcud thams cad zil gyis mnan kyang / kho'i dbang shed kyis rdzi ma bakhrod pa'i skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu dang / btsan dbang zhags pas 'gug ma thub pa'i cesal gsum wade mi bdun khri lhag tsam 'phags yul du 'byor te bod spyi pa'i las don sgrub pa'i byas rjes bla na med pa mang du sku da pa las/ da ni btsan sdudal mi mang rnams kyi bka' drin rjes su dran te brjod par bya'o//88

dge spyong bse nu'ikher gtam/theg gsum bstan pa 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun sde//bstan 'dzin gtsug tu bkur ba'i chodal gsum 'bangs//ser skya mnyam 'brel mthu las thode snga na las//ltod med sgrub pa'i bka' drin brtsod kyis nyon//byams dang snying rje'i bcud 'dzin pa'i//rgyal ba'i bstan la dga' ba'i ྅/da//srid 'acadar phun chorgags rgyud na yang //yid kyi dga' bde nyams mi 'gyur//mi dang skad yig tha dad kyi//yul du nor med lag stong dang //gnas med 'khyam pa'i dus byung yang //gdong gi 'dzum mdangs yal ma gyur//skyes pa'i yul dang bsags pa'i nor//thams cad cig car lha ra na yang //89

dge spyong bse nu'ikher gtam/theg gsum bstan pa 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun sde//bstan 'dzin gtsug tu bkur ba'i chodal gsum 'bangs//ser skya mnyam 'brel mthu las thode snga na las//ltod med sgrub pa'i bka' drin brtsod kyis nyon//byams dang snying rje'i bcud 'dzin pa'i//rgyal ba'i bstan la dga' ba'i ྅/da//srid 'acadar phun chorgags rgyud na yang //yid kyi dga' bde nyams mi 'gyur//mi dang skad yig tha dad kyi//yul du nor med lag stong dang //gnas med 'khyam pa'i dus byung yang //gdong gi 'dzum mdangs yal ma gyur//skyes pa'i yul dang bsags pa'i nor//thams cad cig car lha ra na yang //89

chos dang chab srid slar gso ba'i//bsam pa'i cadabs shugs sku(ra ma gyur//bya rgod gshog rtsa'adar ba'i ri// ma11na 11 te ma la yi gangs//kha char 'thab pa'i grang reg gis// rdzi bar ma gyur su mi mtshar//gangs chu g.yang du lhung ba'i sgra//'brug stong dus gcig ldir ba bzhin//'jigs 'phreng g.yang las thar ba'i bod//lha yi phyag gis 〉teb min nam//gcan gzan gtum wa'i bsti gnas kyi//nags klung stug wa'i gseb lam du//rkun jag skung bas ma bkums pa//lag stong yin pa'i drin du 'o//90

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/ 'phags yul spyi khyab dbus gzhungagi /lag pa 〈snang ba'i maXten 〈sna rnams//sne len mthun sbyor byas pa ni//skyabs mabe|na rgyal ba'i drin du 11mas//deng dus ngo mtshar 'dzin pa'i yul//tshan rig lugs la 'gran bzod pa'i//rgyal bstan bod la yod pa 'di//rab byung mkhas pa rnams kyi drin//srid dang 'byor ba rgyud na yang //snyan pa'i grags pa 'bar ba'i rgyu//theg ma〉sgrog bstan pa dam 'dzin pa'i//dge 'dun sde rnams bsngags pa'i yul//'dzam gling skye bo gzur gnas la//ngo mtshar skyed pa'i legs skyes mchog/91

thub gsung yin phyir sde stod gsum//'dzin pa'i dge 'dun bod kyi rgyan//rdul masnunan la 11gas drag chas rigs//dmag macesan 11da la ma mchis kyang //de 'bo|ga thabs bzang rgyal ba'i bstan//bod la yod pa mkhas mang drin//calab bcengabs zin pa'i 〈snas /bod la yod pa'i theg gsum sngags// gzhan la med pa'i lugs bzang 'di// dge 'dun mkhas mang 'dus pa'i drin//thosad ni rgyal khab gang zhig tu//phyin na ya rabs bzang 11 zhes//bsngags pa'i yul du 'dzin pa ni//bstan dang bstan 'dzin du ma'i drin//92
