thub gsung yin phyir sde stod gsum//'dzin pa'i dge 'dun bod kyi rgyan//rdul masnunan la 11gas drag chas rigs//dmag macesan 11da la ma mchis kyang //de 'bo|ga thabs bzang rgyal ba'i bstan//bod la yod pa mkhas mang drin//calab bcengabs zin pa'i 〈snas /bod la yod pa'i theg gsum sngags// gzhan la med pa'i lugs bzang 'di// dge 'dun mkhas mang 'dus pa'i drin//thosad ni rgyal khab gang zhig tu//phyin na ya rabs bzang 11 zhes//bsngags pa'i yul du 'dzin pa ni//bstan dang bstan 'dzin du ma'i drin//92

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/ tshe gang 3wa skya lha sa hrul gyis //cor+shag shes ngang nas bshad sgrub kyi//bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba'i 'khur//bsnams pa'i dge 'dun phyag gi yul//bslab khrims gtsang ma'i stod bzang du//lung dang rtogs pa'i bdud rtsi'i khams//bsags pas sku ngas bkangadage 'dun sde//bod kyi snyan grags spol ba'i gathe //the da kyi srid 'drodar rgyud pa'i nyin//sde stod 'dzin pa med na ni//deng dus bod 'di gzhis bye sa na//grags med go med nyid du 'gyur// rgyal ba'i bstan pa med na ni//srid lugs kho nas bod kyi ro/na//93

'bad kyang mtha' 'bras yid 'ong ba//re ba che yang 'grub pa dka'//mtshan snyan srid gsum brgal pa yi//rgyal ba paṇa chen la 11gas pa'i//grags pa 'bar ba'i wade rje rnams//rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'di las byung //sa mtha'i yul na gsar rnying gi//mkhas grub du mas bod spyi'i don//sgrub par gyur pa thos pas bdag/bod nas bstan 'dzin yongs la dad//mjal tshe bstan bshig ltas ngan pa//yod mod de las bzang wa'i phyogs//'dzin pa'i snu sa pa mang mjo nga tshe/rtsaba'i dad pa log ma gyur//94

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/ngan pa'i skyodan la snyad btags nas//bzang la skur 'debs byed pa ni// bzang ngan dbye ba mi shes pa'i//mi de blun 11 ma yin nam//blun wa'i rjes su 'brang ba na//cesas pas ma〈snang na bstan dgra zer// chab srid pas ni 11 pa zhes//tha ma kun gyis blosnad pa'i gnas//deng gi dus su khams gsum gyi// 'bo/ ba'i sdug bsngal bsal ba yi//dmigs rnams skyodang ba'i spyodas pa las//bod don sgrub pa'i mi la dga'//gzhan yang lung rigs smra ba'i dbang //gsar rnying gzhung lugs 'dzin pa yi//95

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/ngan pa'i skyodan la snyad btags nas//bzang la skur 'debs byed pa ni// bzang ngan dbye ba mi shes pa'i//mi de blun 11 ma yin nam//blun wa'i rjes su 'brang ba na//cesas pas ma〈snang na bstan dgra zer// chab srid pas ni 11 pa zhes//tha ma kun gyis blosnad pa'i gnas//deng gi dus su khams gsum gyi// 'bo/ ba'i sdug bsngal bsal ba yi//dmigs rnams skyodang ba'i spyodas pa las//bod don sgrub pa'i mi la dga'//gzhan yang lung rigs smra ba'i dbang //gsar rnying gzhung lugs 'dzin pa yi//95

sprul ba'i sku dang dge ba'i bshes//chos pa'i bka' drin slar yang gamathon//skyabs mabe|na rgyal bas cesas srid kyi//'phrin las rgya phibs 'degs pa'i ka/phal cher bla sprul dge ba'i bshes//yin phyir bdag ni lhag par dad//phyi nang kun tu rig gnas kyi/slob grwar bod yig sne 'khrid pa'i//gathorwa na dge 'dun gtogs gyur pas//ma dad na yang su yis 1snad//a ri la 11gas phyi gling gi/yul gru kun tu bod brgyud chos// rig gzhung snurags pa dgu brgya tsam//yod pa gsar rnying chos pa'i drin//96

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/bod kyi lo rgyus 'dzam gling 'dir//྅ge la ri 31 bar+shasnas pa bzhin//gsub par mi 'gyur srid mtha'i bar//gnas pa gsar rnying chos pa'i drin//rgyal bstan glegs bam 11da yig las//phyi gling skad yig sna tshogs su//sgyur ba'i byed po gsar rnying gi/skad sgyur mkhas pa'i drin du go/phyi gling nor gyis phyug pa'i mi//dpal 'drodar bde bas ma tshims par//wade brgyud rgyal bstan 'asnural mang pa//gsar rnying chos pa'i drin du go/1snad kyi gces nor rgyal ba'i bstan//gzur gnas sdurdzo 〈snas rgyas pa'i mis //97

dpyad na 'phral phugs bde ba'i rgyu/ /'di las lhag cig yod dam ci//tshe 'dir mkho ba'i phun tshogs nor// gang da thothos len pa med na yang //chor+shas kyi nyams len skusgod pa'i mi//gang du phyin na phun sum tsho gas// bod rigs btsan byol chol gsum 'bangs//sa mtha'i yul na bde skyid dpal//longs su spyod 'di skyabs mgon dang //sangs rgyas bstan pa mode pa'i drin //skyabs mabosgon rgyal ba'i bka' lung gi/rjes 'brang lhag pa'i bsam pa can//ya rabs spyod bzang chol gsum kyi//btsan byol thodad mi bsode nams bzang //98

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/rtag par theg pa chen 16) cesas//rna ba'i lam du zhugs pa'i mthus//sems rgyud phal las 'phags gyur ba// btsan 〈snal thode mi'i bskusgod nams nyid//khyim du gnas pa'i dad ldan gyis//lam rim blo sbyong klog pa dang //dmigs rnam khyodang ba'i nyams len pa//mthong tshe btsan byol bod rigs mtshar//dbang bzhi nod cing lha'i rnal 'byor//sgom dang bzlas brjod brtson pa yi//btsan khyedal kherdzod kyi ya rabs 'gar//btsun gzugs bdag 'dras 'gran mi ho/da//dge 'dun sde rnams mchod pa'i tshe//thog ma'i skyabs 'jug rgyal ba'i dbang //99

sku tshe brtan cing bzhed pa'i thegen//bde blag 'grub pa ga4 01ra zhu//tshe gang bsags pa'i gces pa'i nor//thod don phyogs su phangs med du//gtong phod ldan pa'i ngang tshul la//bdag gi yid ni lhag par 'phrog/skyabs maboton yul swātengs gzhan dag tu//drodan tshe gnas 'dir ma gshegs par//bsang gi dud sprin mi yal ba//dam tshig gtsang ma yin par macesan//btsan 〈snal gathoto gzhung dmangs gsum gyis//'bad pa'i byas rjes ches mang yang /bdag khra'i yul du gyur pa 'ga'//yi rang byas te tshigs su bcad//100

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/'bad pa chung ngus rlabs chen snurags//gasku1ga par byed pa gzhan dag gi/dge la rjes su yi rang 'dis//bskude nams mkha' dang mnyam par sku(ga/ba11da nams mthu yis gangs can gyi//chos srid mnga' bdag rgyal ba'i dbang // sku tshe bskal brgyar brtan pa dang //bzhed snga na mtha' dag myur 'grub cadag/bdag kyang tshe rabs kun tu yang //skyabs mthothon rgyal bas rjes bzung ste//btsoldan grogs dang lhan cig tu //dam pa'i chos la spyod par shog/ tshigs bcad 'di ni sku sgor gyi//yig tshang phyogs su lto ba'i kha//101

gtod pa'i nyam chung yul gyar ba//ye shes rgya mchod ges pas bris//zhes thode kha ba gangs can gyi shar cadags ma hā tsi na'i rgyal khab chen wa de nyid/ sngon theg chen gyi bstan pa'i bsti gnas su gyur te 'tshe med zhi ba'i yul ljongs chos dang srid dang dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa'i bde skyed la longs spyod cing mi'i yul na bde skyid 'di las che ba med pa lta bu yin/der ma zad sa la gnas pa'i rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' grangs las 'das pa zhig rgya rigs kyi sha tshugs bzhes te/ rang gi yul ljongs kyi skye 11 rnams bde skyid kyi gnas su 'thode pa dang / mtha' bzhi'i rgyal khab rnams la btsan gatheṭan mi byed padang / gzhan gyis btsan thenal byed pa ma11nga na thabs du mas sdu/ngas bo gas byas nas rang gzhan gnyis ka bde ba la 'thod pa'i mi rigs shin tu ya rabs shig yin na'ang stabs ma legs pa zhig la deng dus u ru su kho rang tsho la mi dgos pa'i dmar wa'i lam lugs dmar gsod khrag sbyor gyi chab srid de nyid chen po rgya'i yul du mched de/ smon lam log pa'i rgya rgan kha shas shig gis chab srid yang dag tu bzung ste 1snag mar rgya yul gyi yul srol bzang bo spyi dang / khyad par du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bstan 'dzin 102

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/ dang bcas pa dug gi dwangs ma dang dgra'i gatho rwagur bzung nas bstan pa snub par byed pa dang / bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnams dmar gsod dang btson 'jug gi bya ngan gyis rgya yul thams cad cham la phab pa'i rjes su bsil ldan kha ba'i swā ngas su zhi dmag dang drag dmag gis rim bzhin du sa cha'i rgyus len pa dang rgyus blangs te drag gcan gyis chol gsum thod kyi yul lung thams cad khrag dang mchi ma'i rgyun phab pa'i mthar dwa phrug dang yugs sa ma'i yul ljongs shig tu bsgyur to// de lta bu'i dmar dmag gi dpung stobs kyis chol gsum bod kyi khyod bcud thams cad dbang du bsdus shing zil gyis mnan na'ang spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyams pa'i dus la ma slebs pa dang / sbru/sa su cor+shal gsum bod mi'i bskusnad nams kyi 'phen pa ma the gas pas/ rang cag gangs ri ba rnams kyi bsode nams macadan par bsags pa'i mthu thengabs dang / 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sngon gyi thugs bskyed dang smon lam dus su smin pa la brten nas skabs 'di lta bu zhig la zhi sku 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i brtul zhugs kyis cad la sku gas pa'i skye cad mang sngo la phan pa dang bde ba bsgrub pa'i slad du re zhig btsan cadal gyi tshul du rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du zhabs sor bathode pa'i skyabs mabo|na rgyal ba'i dbang 11 thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs 103

pa chen 10 macesag gis cad spyi pa'i chodas srid kyi slad du 'phrin las khyod bsdu mang du yod pa las/ rang gi blo ngor shar tshod tsam gus phyag gi tshul du bde rnying dang mngon brtsod kyis ma bcings par bod spyi yongs kyi skad dang mthun pa'i tshigs su bcad pa da nga / gzhan yang gathorwa nga gang gi thugs rje'i 'phrin las kyi gzi brjid dang / bod rigs ser skya lhag bsam can 'das gson mang wa'i ce la sgrub bar ma chad pa'i byas rjes bla na med pa ྅/da cesal kha gsum gyi srog shing ngam lcags ri lta bu'i rang gzhung gi bka' drin rnams rjes dran gyi tshul du tshigs su bcad pa dang / yang / chodal gsum btsan khyodal thodad mi dam gtsang rnams kyis skyabs mabokhen yid bzhin cadar bu dang rang gzhung la bkur sti lhod med byas pa'i grub 'bras bzang po la ngo mtshar te bsngags brtsod kyi tshigs su bcad pa dang rim pa gsum du phye nas bris sku da/ 'di 'bri 'dod kyi 'dun pa 'phel lugs ni 'di lta ste/ dang po skyabs mabo na rgyal ba rin 11 che dang chodal gsum cadad mi bdun khri lhag tsam rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du btsan byol du phebs skabs thod kyi bla dpon 'byor ldan rnams kyis 'di ni khyed cag rgya gar du sku/nga nas wa da spyi la phan pa'i gzhung 'dzugs pa'i thebs rtsayin nyo zhes sgor mo gcig kyang sprad med pa dang / yangabatsan khyodal ba gathong 'kho ra rnams kyis nged cag rgya gar du sku nga nas lnga da 104

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/spyi la phan pa'i gzhung 'dzugs nges yin zer nas mi mang gi lag nas khral bsdu btsan len gcig kyang byas med na'ang deng dus kun gyi mjo nga snang la gsal ba ltar/ gzhan gyi sa ༄teg na rang gzhung 'dzam gling la grags pa rgyas pa zhig dang / de'i skyabs 〉(ga na grwa btsun rnams la dar+shatshen pa/ phru gu rnams la s+thā/ba grwa/ mi mang rnams la gzhis chags bskrun pa la 11gas pa'i phyi 'brel nang skyong gi rigs mtha' yas pa dang / de dang chabs cig bod rang dbang dang rang btsan gyi las 'gul lo nas lo brtson pa dang deng dus brtson pa je drag tu 'gro ba sogs mi nyung shas kyis byas rjes chen po bzhag pa la ngo mtshar te 'grig kyang mi 'grig kyang 'bri 'aro/da kyi 'dun pa de las byung pa lags sku //ye shes rgya mamārgas bris/

ra༅༅// mdo smad bshad sgrub bstan pa'i 'byung gnas bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i chos grwa chen wa'i don gnas kyi yon tan rang gi blo tshod kyis mthong ba brtsod pa bkra shis 11 bdun pa zhes bya ba/steng mtha' dpag dko'o thugs bskyed nam mkha'i dbyings//mkhyen pa'i nyin byed tsha zer rgyas na yang //brtse chen gangs dkar lhun po ma zhu ba//lhag lha gangs ri'i mgon po srid na rgyal/snyigs lnga'i rang mdangs bdo ba'i dus mtha' 'dir//rgyal thabs rtsub mo'i srid kyi khrims casag tu//thub bstan phyogs mthar spel la spobs pa'i gter//rgyas pa'i kun mkhyen yab sras bcas la 'dud//106

ra༅༅// mdo smad bshad sgrub bstan pa'i 'byung gnas bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i chos grwa chen wa'i don gnas kyi yon tan rang gi blo tshod kyis mthong ba brtsod pa bkra shis 11 bdun pa zhes bya ba/steng mtha' dpag dko'o thugs bskyed nam mkha'i dbyings//mkhyen pa'i nyin byed tsha zer rgyas na yang //brtse chen gangs dkar lhun po ma zhu ba//lhag lha gangs ri'i mgon po srid na rgyal/snyigs lnga'i rang mdangs bdo ba'i dus mtha' 'dir//rgyal thabs rtsub mo'i srid kyi khrims casag tu//thub bstan phyogs mthar spel la spobs pa'i gter//rgyas pa'i kun mkhyen yab sras bcas la 'dud//106

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/gangs dkar lhun pos bsgor ba'i zhing khams su//theg gsum sngags dang rig pa'i gnas rnams kyi//man ngag brgyud pa tshang la ma cartser ba//yongs 'dus mdo smad dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil//mtha' bzhi kun na phyi gtsang nang gtsang gi/dathosnen lag bshad sgrub 'dus sde brgya phrag las//lhag gis dbang lung man ngag len pa'i khungs//yin phyir bstan pa'i 'byung gnas bkra shis 'khyil// dbus gtsang dam pa'i snu sa kyi zhing khams kyi//brgyud ldan dam pa'i man ngag ma lus pa//khrims gtsang lcags ri zlum wa'i khor yug tu//shong bas dbus gtsang gnyis pa bkra shis 'khyil//cadags bcu'i rgyal ba kun gyi sras kyi gajoto//rgyal sras dpa' 1sto rnams kyi spun gyi maspyoteg/107

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/gangs dkar lhun pos bsgor ba'i zhing khams su//theg gsum sngags dang rig pa'i gnas rnams kyi//man ngag brgyud pa tshang la ma cartser ba//yongs 'dus mdo smad dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil//mtha' bzhi kun na phyi gtsang nang gtsang gi/dathosnen lag bshad sgrub 'dus sde brgya phrag las//lhag gis dbang lung man ngag len pa'i khungs//yin phyir bstan pa'i 'byung gnas bkra shis 'khyil// dbus gtsang dam pa'i snu sa kyi zhing khams kyi//brgyud ldan dam pa'i man ngag ma lus pa//khrims gtsang lcags ri zlum wa'i khor yug tu//shong bas dbus gtsang gnyis pa bkra shis 'khyil//cadags bcu'i rgyal ba kun gyi sras kyi gajoto//rgyal sras dpa' 1sto rnams kyi spun gyi maspyoteg/107

mi yi sha tshugs 'dzin pa'i sems dpa' che//khri phrag brgyad kyi gdan sa bkra shis 'khyil//macadan du 'bad pas sbyin bdag ma bkug la//lkog nas nor lha g.yang 'gug ma byas kyang // khab len rdo yis drangs pa'i lcags phye bzhin//mthun 'byor ngang gis 'du ba'i bkra shis 'khyil//yongs rdzogs thub bstan lung gi go ba tsam// ma yin dpal ldan cesas kyi grags pa'i gzhung //tshad ma'i stobs las nges pa rnyed pa yi//go rigs mda' ltar rno ba'i bkra shis 'khyil//thub pa'i dbang bos byams mthosnen 〈snags med 〈snags//brgyud pa'i rgya chen spyod rgyud gzhung lugs rnams//'chad nyan dka' ba brgya phrag spyad pa'i 'bras//thos pa mkha' ltar yangs pa'i bkra shis 'khyil//108

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/rgyal bas 'jam dpal dbyangs dang klu sgrub sku/gas//shes rab che gsal myur zhing zab pa yi//gdul bya kho nar bstsal ba'i lta ba'i rgyud//cho sa bsam gnad du 'thigs pa'i bkra shis 'khyil//bathodam ldan 'das kyi bka' las chodas rnams kyi//rang spyi'i mtshan nyid gtan la 'bebs pa'i lugs//slob dpon dbyig gi gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i gzhung //chos mngon rgya mtsholimadzod 'dzin bkra shis 'khyil//sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gzhi ma 'dul ba'i lugs//phyogs bsdus byed po 'dul 'dzin mchog gnyis kyi//gzhung lugs sgyu sa bsam jo sa thosan nyams bzhes pa//'dul 'dzin gtsang ma'i 'dus sde bkra shis 'khyil//bde gshegs bstan pa'i snying bcud gsang chen sngags//ches zab rgyud sde bzhi yi 'chad nyan dang //109

10ma sgrub chu tho'i rgyun bzhin da lta'i bar//nyams med gsang chen gter 'dzin bkra shis 'khyil//bzhi brgya cangabazhi'i nad kun 'jodams pa yi//gnyen po mchog gyur bdud rtsisman gyi gzhung //'chad nyan sdeb sbyor gso rig bcud len gyis//tshe zad 'jigs las skyodab pa'i bkra shis 'khyil//sa la ri mo 'bri ba'i byed thabs kyis//gnam gyi rgyu skar byed las rtogs nus pa'i// gtsug lag rtsis kyi bstan bather+shas la brten nas//gnam gzugs skar dpyad mkhas pa'i bkra shis 'khyil//snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor legs sbyar gyi//skad 11gas sbyang pas thun mosnang thun min gzhung //sna tshogs brtsams pas legs bshad wad kyi 'phreng //mkhas dgu dga' ba bskyed pa'i bkra shis 'khyil//110

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/mdor na gdan chodag gcig nas dbus gtsang gi/brgyud ldan man ngag kun dang mdo sde dang //rgyud dang rgya gzhung rig pa'i gnas rnams kun//gang sbyang mthun rkyen 'jordoms pa'i bkra shis 'khyil//snga 'gyur bstan pa'i rgyud las byung ba'i lha//yi dam rta mgrin pad+ma gar dbang gi/bsnyen sgrub sngags chu khyodags kun 'grem pa yis//gsang chen snga 'gyur khyodags 'dzin bkra shis 'khyil//mar mi sgam ྅6) nyams bzhes thugs dam mthil//gsang bde'i rgyud las sgyu 'od zung 'jug gi//rim pa lha na pa'i man ngag kun tshang bas//bka' rgyud bstan pa'i lhasal 'dzin bkra shis 'khyil//'jam dbyangs sprul gabadun brgyud sa skya las//brgyud pa'i dpal ldan dgyes pa lda je yi//111

rim gnyis lam gyi babosad pa kun tshang bas//dpal ldan sa skya'i bstan 'dzin bkra shis 'khyil//mkhas grub chen sngotshe 〉tel ba'i mabo na 〈sna las//brgyud pa'i bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i gzhung //rjodar drug man ngag khrid rgyun ma nyams pas// rtag brtan lnga nang bstan 'dzin bkra shis 'khyil// bka' gdams bo nga ma'i lho da pa gtsang ma'i khar//grub mtha' rnam bzhi'i rgyud dang khyad par du//thal 'gyur lta dang rim gnyis rnal 'byor sogs//tshang bas dge ldan bstan 'dzin bkra shis 'khyil//mdor na gangs ri'i khrod kyi chos rgyal dang //lo paṇa zhal 'dzoms drin las gsar rnying gi/cesas las man ngag ma tshang med pa yis// gsar rnying bstan pa'i 'byung gnas bkra shis 'khyil//112

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/'jam dbyangs bla ma ngag dbang brtson 'grus dang //ngag dbang bkra shis khri chen sde ba dang //snumis rgyal 'ju nang rnam rgyal 〈snal ma yis//josnag mar phyag 'debs mdzad pa'i bkra shis 'khyil//mkhas grub bye ba'i gtsug rgyan 'jam dbyangs dacags//kun mkhyen bla mas dbus gtsang mkhas dgu'i zhabs//bsten cing mtshungs med mkhas grub masnu ga brnyes pas//dbus gtsang drin las grags pa'i bkra shis 'khyil//ngo mtshar dge bcu'i dpal yon rab dar zhing //khyad 'phags sa bzang mdo stod yul gru nas//'jam dbyangs bla ma sku 'phreng gnyis phudan pas//mdo stod dpa' bos bskyangs pa'i bkra shis 'khyil//'jam dbyangs bla ma sku 'phreng rim pa gsum//lhasnen gnam dag pa'i dum bu sa gzhi la// 113

bting 'dra'i mtsho sngon phyogs nas byon pa yis//mdo smad byang bas gzigs pa'i bkra shis 'khyil//gang gi thugs sras rje btsun gung thang ba'i//sku 'phreng phal cher rin chen bye ma'i rgyu na//'dren pa'i rma gtsang phyug mo'i lto nas byon//maro/ smad 〈sna bas gzigs pa'i bkra shis 'khyil//gnas der 'dus pa'i mkhas mang dge 'dun sde/ /cadags bzhi mtshams brgyad kun nas 11 bsdu'i rgyun//dbyar gyi mtsho la ngang mo 'du 'god bzhin//bgrang yas skal bzang 'du ra bkra shis 'khyil//mdo smad bshad sgrub bstan pa 'byung ba'i gnas//bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i cesas grwa che//rnam mang rgyu dang rkyen la blto sa pa yis//rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i bkra shis 'khyil//114

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/rgyal thabs rtsub mo'i cadag nas bya dka' yang //kun mkhyen yab sras dge ba'i bshes rnams kyi//spobs pa lhod du med pa'i ngang tshul la//skyabs maboton rgyal bas bsngags sku( bkra shis 'khyil//skyabs mabosan rgyal ba'i zhal gyi tshangs dbyangs las //gang gsung brda la byang ba'i go ba 'di//chos sde de dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi//bka' drin khote nar dran cate bkra shis 'khyil//'di brtsams dge bas gangs ljongs mtha' dbus kyi//lugs gnyis 'dzin pa'i dpon dang bkur ba'i 'bangs//kun kyi lhag bsam gtsang ma cos ma'i rgyun//bkra shis stod bzang gcig tu 'khyil bar shog/skyabs mabo na macesag dang bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i 'a11ra//gang na su bzhugs de dag sku che'i khams//115

sho je'i gshis su 'gyur ba'i mtshon rtags su//zhabs la bkra shis ri snu 'khyil bar lha ga/bdag ni gang du phyin pa'i khyerdzogs de yi//skye bo kun gyis bstod smad bgyis pa dang //bkur dang brdeg pa'i bsam rjodar brtsams pa rnams//bkra shis bde dga'i dpal yon 'khyil bar shog/gangs ljongs gzhi na spun zla 'brog sde rnams//rtochu rtsod pa'i rgyu las rang rigs kyi//thod la gtad pa'i drag chas me mda'i sbubs//bkra shis chos dung dbyibs su 'khyil bar shog//rang rigs byes cadal gzhan gyi g.yam rgyugs nas//rdo rje slob dpon rgol ba'i log sgrub las//'khyod tshangs dad nis mtshon rtags dpral dgras su//bkra shis dga' 'khyil g.yas su 'kho ra bar sna ga/116

dge sbyong bse tshu'i kher gtam/gangs can zhing na snu nga las byed 1/ 'gas// rten rnying brku las 'tsho ba'i byed thabs kyi//nyes la 'jigs nas spangs pas de ma thag/ bkra shis g.yang mcho'o mdun du 'khyil bar ro/ga/masnga ra na gangs can mabo na wa'i thugs bskyed kyi//gangs dkar lhun po las byung chu klung rgyun//bkra shis rlabs 'phreng ri ces ca༄ma bzhin du//'dzam gling sa chen kun tu 'khyil bar smon// mdo smad mdzod dge'i yul du lte khrag lhung //bla brang dgon pa'i 'dabs nas zur khrid brtson//sku sger yig tshang skyabs cardog bya bral ba'i//ming 'dzin mjo da dge ye shes rgya mtshos bris//phyi 61 2003 6 7 la bris/117

dge sbyong bse tshu'i kher gtam/gangs can zhing na snu nga las byed 1/ 'gas// rten rnying brku las 'tsho ba'i byed thabs kyi//nyes la 'jigs nas spangs pas de ma thag/ bkra shis g.yang mcho'o mdun du 'khyil bar ro/ga/masnga ra na gangs can mabo na wa'i thugs bskyed kyi//gangs dkar lhun po las byung chu klung rgyun//bkra shis rlabs 'phreng ri ces ca༄ma bzhin du//'dzam gling sa chen kun tu 'khyil bar smon// mdo smad mdzod dge'i yul du lte khrag lhung //bla brang dgon pa'i 'dabs nas zur khrid brtson//sku sger yig tshang skyabs cardog bya bral ba'i//ming 'dzin mjo da dge ye shes rgya mtshos bris//phyi 61 2003 6 7 la bris/117

༄༅༅//'phags yul dha ram sa la'i stod bcud kyi yon tan mdo tsam brjod pa snyigs lnga'i rgud mun sel ba'i 'od snang zhes bya ba/ dkyil 'a〈per kun gang lha na gnam dag pa'i zla//cordo mtsho'i thorags su lan brgyar bkrus pa bzhin//dkar zhal mdangs 'dzin brtse gter spyan ras gzigs//mi yi gar mdzad gangs ri'i mthodan la 'dud//brtse ba'i gter bdag mgon po skyed kyi bka'//yid kyi thig ler bathodad pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang //zam gdong sprul sku la sogs gangs ljongs spyir//phan pa'i las mdzad dam pa rnams la 'dud//dpag med yon tan mdzod 'dzin shākya'i tog/ zhabasazungabakrashis ri smadardo1 /la gyi khams//

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/ma lus byin gyis rlabs pa'i zhing gi macesag/'phags yul byin chags sa 'di malnga nga ba med//gzi ldan dpa' snu mdzes ma'i sha tshugs kyis//stod ldan skyes bu tshe gcig sangs rgyas sar//btsan thabs babo da pa'i man ngag ster ba'i yul//nyer bzhi'i mchog gyur dza 'chi ra zhes//'phags 11da grub maces ga kun kyis lan mang du//bsngags pa'i gnas mchog mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i rdzong //rkang zung ri mo bkod pa'i skal ba 'di//btsan byol gtso gzhung dmangs kyi drin las byung //dga' bzhi'i dpal ster yid 'ong mkha' 'gro ma//dgyes pa'i tshems dang 'o 'dzin bum pa'i rtse//mjo nga dang reg pas yul can sems kyi khams//bde dga'i gter du ma gyur bdag ni dman//119

casdon kyang de 'dra'i ye shes yum gyi mgrin//'khyud dang 'o yi bde bas chos kyi dbyings//zin pa'i zung 'jug skal ba ma mchis kyang //byin chags gnas kyi sa chu reg pa bzang //sngon byon rig 'dzin dpa' bo dpa' mo dang //grub pa mchodag gis sngags dang ting 'dzin gyis//byin gyis brlabs pa'i sa sku gas 'byung bzhi'i rdul//lus la byug na yid bde rnyed pa'i grogs//byin rlabs bdud rtsis dpal 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i rdzong / /nye ba'i yid 'ong khorayug dha sa'i gtam//mnyan la rna ba yangs pa'i skye thosgo la//mdo tsam brjod kyis snyan zur nga la blogs//dgra dmag dpung gis bskrad pa'i btsan cadal ba//thog mar sa 'dir 'byor tshe khor yug kun//120

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/nags dang bo nga gseb thar lnga ra ma gtogs pa//bde skyid 'a17mas pa'i sa zhig min par bshad//nags tshal stug pos brgyan pa'i dha sa'i steng //skyabs mabo na rgyal ba'i zhabs zung swā rje'i khams//bsna da pa'i gzi yis btsan 〈snal chig sgril gyi//rang gzhung bskrun pas chos 'byor bde skyid 'bar//tshal gsum ser skya sa 'dir 'dzoms ma thag/'phags yul skad la snar+shangs pas lkug pa'i rtags//mang du bstan pa'i lo rgyus gleng ba na//nyan mkhan rgyu ma na ba'i gad ces skusad//de bas sems kyi rmongs pa sel byed dang //smra la mgrin pa yangs parirno thabs dam pa//ston pa'i sna tshogs skad yig gzhon nu'i tshogs//bsdus te bslab pas mkhas pas lhudzigs kun khyab//121

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/nags dang bo nga gseb thar lnga ra ma gtogs pa//bde skyid 'a17mas pa'i sa zhig min par bshad//nags tshal stug pos brgyan pa'i dha sa'i steng //skyabs mabo na rgyal ba'i zhabs zung swā rje'i khams//bsna da pa'i gzi yis btsan 〈snal chig sgril gyi//rang gzhung bskrun pas chos 'byor bde skyid 'bar//tshal gsum ser skya sa 'dir 'dzoms ma thag/'phags yul skad la snar+shangs pas lkug pa'i rtags//mang du bstan pa'i lo rgyus gleng ba na//nyan mkhan rgyu ma na ba'i gad ces skusad//de bas sems kyi rmongs pa sel byed dang //smra la mgrin pa yangs parirno thabs dam pa//ston pa'i sna tshogs skad yig gzhon nu'i tshogs//bsdus te bslab pas mkhas pas lhudzigs kun khyab//121

sngar bsags dpal 'aX ra dgra yis 'a'o/ga pa dang //rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag gsar ba ma rnyed pa'i//bar du chodal gsum 'bangs la zas thodas cadar// dkon zhing dka' ba'i snang ba byung zhes bshad//rgyal ba'i dbang tho'i thugs bskyed nam mkha 'i dbyings//tshad med smon lam chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa'i rlabs/ /kun tu khyab pas 'asnga da sku na char gyi rgyun//rtag tu babs las 'khyodar ldan chu klung rgyas//sngar gyi chos sde dgra yis gtor ba dang //'phags yul 'di ru dgon sde ma skrun pa'i//bar du sangs rgyas bstan pa'i 11sa bsam rgyun//rgud pas bstan 'aci(na thugs khral bsam mi khyab//skyabs mabo na rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i nyi cad rlabs//gsar rnying mkhas pa'i blo gros palhu'i 'dab//122

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/lhan 'dzoms rten 'brel lha chos sbrang rtsi'i bcud//skal bzang bung ba mtha' yas zas su spel//sngar gyi rang gzhung dgra yis 'a'o/ga pa dang //si 'oder bzhung zhesar 4 btsusas ngar du ni sne gzhis lus thodad 'bangs gces pa'i btsan cadal ba//lhag bsam can rnams bde ba'i skabs ma rnyed//skyabs mabo na rgyal ba'i bka' lung sho je'i tshig/tshul bzhin mnyan cing sgrub pa'i lha mi'i dpung //lhan 'cho mas mthu yis skru la gsum chig sgril gyi//rang gzhung rgyal dar nam mkha'i dbyings na mdzes //srid 'khyodar bde ba kho nas sems kyi phugs//)ma tshims yid bde ster ba'i dam pa'i chodas /'tshol phyir skyabs mgon rgyal ba'i dbang bo'i drung //phyi gling dad ldan dbyar gyi sprin bzhin 'du//123

gang gi brjid chags sku dang snyan pa'i gsung //brtseba'i thugs ni skye thod su dag gis//malnga nga dang thos dang yid la dran pa'i mo da//sngar med dga' bde thob pa'i skye bo mang //gangs ri'i mgon gro'i spyan sngar deng dus kyi//tshan rig smra ྅/bas rgyas pa'i mkhas grags can//ji snyed 'byor ba de yis gang gi bka'//chodas pa'i smadad la zhi bde 'gug pa'i spo gas//'dzam gling shar nub kun gyi kho ra yug na //longs spyod mdzod brgya'i gter la dbang 'byor ba'i//khyim bdag chen pos gang gi spyan snga ru// sdudar gyi sa 'dzin rtsig pa'i las la brel//rgyal thabs srid kyi sdud bo/sa rab yangs shing //bka' lung gcig gis yul khams dbang sdud pa'i//124

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/mi dbang rnams ni gang gi mdun sa ru//bod kyi rgyal dar bslang ba'i g.yar dam mdzad//tha dad yul na sna snu gas chodas lugs pa//smra mkhas brjid chags 'khesar cesags rgyas pa yi//che rgu de dag gang gi mdun drung du//'dzam gling zhi bde sgrub pa'i rtogs pa skyes//rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i yang bcud byams snying rje//srid don sgrig lam 'dzin pa'i skye bo'i rnar//lan mang bsgrags pa'i mthu yis deng gi dus//nub gling mang gtso'i srid la chos dri bro// gangs ljongs spyi yi gces nor gsar rnying chos//'dzam gling mtha' dbus kun tu spel ba na//bstan pa dug tu brtsi ba'i bstan dgra'i gasgu //tang dpon bsod skam sems la zug rngu skyes//125

rgyal bstan kun tu spel bas 'dzam gling gi//dad ldan mtha' yas gang gi spyan snga ru//bsam sbyor gus pas gsung gi bdud rtsi'i dbyangs//gsan tshe rna ba galta da lugs cadad las 'phags//gang gi bden gsung lda je'i zegs ma yis//lta ngan mkhreg 'dzin brag gi klad pa can//ma lus bshigs te klad rnying mkhreg bzung rnams//bde 'jam yangs pa'i thang ltar bag yangs gyur//zlum gzugs 'dzam gling bo la'i lhu gas kun na//stod bcud gcig car 'joms pa'i rdul phran mtshon//'phen la macadan du lhu gas tshe gang gi thabs//'phrul gyi phyag rgyas btab pashin gtam gyis khyab//bden gsung byin rlabs 'bar ba'i bdud rtsi'i char//rab myur 'phrul gyi rlung dang lhan cig tu//126

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/byurga na'i yul gru kun tu babs pa na//dad ldan myu gu gsar bas cadags kun khyab//bslu med brtseb mchog gi yu ba drang //rlabs chen phyin drug spyod pa'i rtsibs dang ldan//gzhan phan bsdu bzhi'i dar gyi sham bu can//mdzad bzang gdugs dkar go la'i steng na mdzes//srid zhi'i khyon gyi shes bya'i chu gter dbus//skye 'gro'i phan bde sgrub pa'i rgyal rtsal can//de nyid gzigs pa'i gser migang rab yangs pa//mdzad bzang nya mos 'dzam gling kho ra yug bsrungs//gang gi mkhyen pa'i lto ba rab yangs shing // brtse ba'i bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis yongs bkang ste//nus pacirnge dpag bsam stanan paXrno kha rgyan can//mdzad bzang bum pas skye dgu'i dri ma sbyangs//127

snyigs lnga'i rgyud chosags bsnga ba'i 'dam masnum las /nyer 'khrungs skyon gyi ra ris ma gos shing //dpag yas sku na tan sbrang rtsi'i bcud 'dzin pa'i//mdzad bzang pad+mas skal bzang bung ba 'gug/rlabs chen cesags gnyis mtha' yas rgya maces las//nyer byon rang don rjogs pas phyi nang dkar//gzhan don gzugs sku'i ri mo g.yas su 'khyil//bden gsung dung sgras skye dgu'i rmongs gnyid bslangs//dpag med bskal ba'i sngon nas 'gro ba'i don//sgrub pa'i thugs mchod ga bskyed pa'i dus nas bzung //gdul bya'i log sgrub la sogs bzod dka' yang //dam bcas ma zhig dpal be'u'i mdud rgya brtan//yid 'ong tshul khrims gos kyi sham bu brtsegs//mi zhig ting 'dzin ri dwags mtshan mas mdzes//128

snyigs lnga'i rgyud chosags bsnga ba'i 'dam masnum las /nyer 'khrungs skyon gyi ra ris ma gos shing //dpag yas sku na tan sbrang rtsi'i bcud 'dzin pa'i//mdzad bzang pad+mas skal bzang bung ba 'gug/rlabs chen cesags gnyis mtha' yas rgya maces las//nyer byon rang don rjogs pas phyi nang dkar//gzhan don gzugs sku'i ri mo g.yas su 'khyil//bden gsung dung sgras skye dgu'i rmongs gnyid bslangs//dpag med bskal ba'i sngon nas 'gro ba'i don//sgrub pa'i thugs mchod ga bskyed pa'i dus nas bzung //gdul bya'i log sgrub la sogs bzod dka' yang //dam bcas ma zhig dpal be'u'i mdud rgya brtan//yid 'ong tshul khrims gos kyi sham bu brtsegs//mi zhig ting 'dzin ri dwags mtshan mas mdzes//128

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/yang dag lta ba'i tog gi gzi cad 'bar//thabs mkhas yu bas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs//'tshe med zhi ba'i lam gyi lte ba brtan//cesas srid kun dang mthun pa'i rtsibs ma brtan//rgyab skyor dpung rogs gnyan wa'i mu khyud brtan//ce sa srid 'a11ra 'o1 rin chen phyag na brtan// sa chen 'dzam gling khyodan gyi phyogs kun tu//zhabs zung balnga ༷sa ri mo bskrun pa'i mod// ngo mtshar rtags dang ltas bzang 'gog med du//shar bas snyigs lnga 'jigs brgyud ngang gis zhi//'phags yul gnas chen dza lan dha ra dang //nye ba'i gnas mamār+shag dha ram sa la'i gtam//mnyan 'dod skye bo'i rna bar bsgrags dang lhan//rang gi bsku da nams lhun sngo/ mkha' la bsnyegs//129

chol gsum chig sgril dpung gi mthu stobs kyis//rgyal dar gyen du bslangs pa'i gnas dam pa//dha sa'i brag nags 'thab pa'i gdong zur nas//ri nyal dge sbyong ye shes rgya mtshos bris//phyi 'o1 1995 yas mas shig la bris/

ge sbyong bas ra'i kher gam/༄༅༅//gnam lo gsar ba'i shis brjod tshe srung rdo rje'i gur khyim zhes bya ba/ rdo rje'i rdul mang brtsegs pa'i sa 'dzin rtser// lda je'i khams las grub pa'i pho brang dbus//rdo rje rtsebargya bsnol ba'i khri 'phang du//lda je 'chang dbang dpal ldan bla ma rgyal//do je'i 'od gur drug rim brtsegs pa'i nang //rdo rje'i srung 'khor drag tu 'khor ba'i dbus//rdo rje sku brnyes yid bzhin 'khor lo yis//rdo rje 'chang dbang bla ma'i sku tshe srings//cho ga'i tshig ltar rang lus stong sbyangs te//dbyingasalasazhalaphyagathenaXs pa'i 'phags ma'i skur//

bzhengs par 〈snas 〈snam byed pa'i dge ba'i mthus// bla ma'i zhabs brtan bzhed wa na lhun 'grub lha ga/de yi thugs shar 'dab brgyad nya gang zla'i//gdan la cosad chags ting 'dzin sems dpa' las//'od 'a'o/sa ye shes 'gug cing bstims pa yis//bla ma'i zhabs brtan bzhed snga na lhun 'grub lha ga/dbang gi lha tshogs nam mkha'i dbyings gang ste// bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis gtams pa'i bum bzang las//dbang skur sku gang dri ma kun dag pas//bla ma'i zhabs brtan bzhed dodan lhun 'grub lha ga/bdud rtsi'i lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las//rigs kyi bdag wa snang ba mtha' yas sku//zhal phyag sku1ngas su ljangags pas rgyas btab pas//bla ma'i zhabs brtan bzhed ro/na lhun 'grub lha ga/132

bzhengs par 〈snas 〈snam byed pa'i dge ba'i mthus// bla ma'i zhabs brtan bzhed wa na lhun 'grub lha ga/de yi thugs shar 'dab brgyad nya gang zla'i//gdan la cosad chags ting 'dzin sems dpa' las//'od 'a'o/sa ye shes 'gug cing bstims pa yis//bla ma'i zhabs brtan bzhed snga na lhun 'grub lha ga/dbang gi lha tshogs nam mkha'i dbyings gang ste// bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis gtams pa'i bum bzang las//dbang skur sku gang dri ma kun dag pas//bla ma'i zhabs brtan bzhed dodan lhun 'grub lha ga/bdud rtsi'i lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las//rigs kyi bdag wa snang ba mtha' yas sku//zhal phyag sku1ngas su ljangags pas rgyas btab pas//bla ma'i zhabs brtan bzhed ro/na lhun 'grub lha ga/132

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/dacadas su bshams dang yid kyis sprul ba yi//chu gnyis nyer spyod snga la mo mchod pa'i sprin//sgeg mdzes lha mos mchod cing bstod pa yis//bla ma'i zhabs brtan bzhed ro/na lhun 'grub lha ga/thugs /ra 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad la//mu khyud lnga dang sngags kyi 'phreng ba las//codad dang bdud rtsi'i gzi byin 'bar ba yis//bla ma'i zhabs brtan bzhed dodan lhun 'grub sna ga/gtsug gi rigs bdag snang mtha' sku ngas gyur las//dkar dmar mdangs ldan bde gshegs tshe dpag med//phyag gnyis bum bzang rgyan dang bo sa bklubs pas//bla ma'i zhabs brtan bzhed snga na lhun 'grub sku/ga/sku yi phyi rol rdo rje'i srung 'khor la//ral gri'i rtsibs dang me lce'i 'phreng bas 'khyud//133

gasnyad byed gtub dang sreg pa'i byed las kyis//bla ma'i zhabs brtan bzhed thosgon lhun 'grub sna(ga/'phrin las rnam bzhi rab 'byams las kun dang //de rnams brtan byed rdo rje'i 'od khyim drug/brtsegs pa'i bar mtshams ༷/spal gtams pa yis//bla ma'i zhabs brtan bzhed sngathon lhun 'grub sna(ga/rigs bdag thugs lnga'i trī las cadad 'alnga sa pas//'khor 'das tshe bsod yongs bsdus bum par zhugs//gyen 'phyur tshangs bug brgyud nas nyes sbyangs pas// bla ma'i zhabs brtan bzhed wa na lhun 'grub lha ga/thugs ma'i 'kho ra 'o/ sngags 'phreng bcas pa las//bdud rtsi'od dkar sngags kyis sgra sgrog cing //lus kun skusnangs gang nyes sbyangs tshe rgyas pas//bla ma'i zhabs brtan bzhed ro/na lhun 'grub cadag/134

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/gang gi thugs ma'i cardod 'aho/sa bsgrub bya yi//tshe bsod yar 'thor sdud cing 'khor 'das kyi//legs snu'ogs bkug ste bum par zhugs pa yis /bla ma'i zhabs brtan bzhed snga na lhun 'grub sna ga/de las bdud rtsir gyur te 'phyur ba yis//tshangs bug lam nas zhugs te bsgrub bya'i lus//sku1ngas gang tshe bskusnad rgyas par mo1sa pa yis//bla ma'i zhabs brtan bzhed dodan lhun 'grub sna ga/bsgrub bya'i tshe bsod rdo rje'i rang khams su//sgrub pa'i thabs su yi ge bcu ba'i gzungs//chag med bzlas ba༄ted 'bad pa'i bden mthu yis//bla ma'i zhabs brtan bzhed sngasan lhun 'grub thertog/mdun gyi stegs la bcud ldan tshe'i ril bu//dmigs gtad zhi ba'i dbyings las tshe sbyin ma//135

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/gang gi thugs ma'i cardod 'aho/sa bsgrub bya yi//tshe bsod yar 'thor sdud cing 'khor 'das kyi//legs snu'ogs bkug ste bum par zhugs pa yis /bla ma'i zhabs brtan bzhed snga na lhun 'grub sna ga/de las bdud rtsir gyur te 'phyur ba yis//tshangs bug lam nas zhugs te bsgrub bya'i lus//sku1ngas gang tshe bskusnad rgyas par mo1sa pa yis//bla ma'i zhabs brtan bzhed dodan lhun 'grub sna ga/bsgrub bya'i tshe bsod rdo rje'i rang khams su//sgrub pa'i thabs su yi ge bcu ba'i gzungs//chag med bzlas ba༄ted 'bad pa'i bden mthu yis//bla ma'i zhabs brtan bzhed sngasan lhun 'grub thertog/mdun gyi stegs la bcud ldan tshe'i ril bu//dmigs gtad zhi ba'i dbyings las tshe sbyin ma//135

ye shes rang snang grub pa'i skur bzhengs pas//bla ma'i zhabs brtan bzhed snga na lhun 'grub sna ga/thugs shar tshe 'khe ra rigs kyi bdag sngo dang // rdo rje'i srung 'khor 'od khyim drug la sogs//bdag bskyed ji bzhin snungs pa byas pa yis//bla ma'i zhabs brtan bzhed snga na lhun 'grub sna ga/tshe rdzas yid bzhin 'khor le'i rnam can gyi//thugs sha'i hūm̐ yig 'od chags thig le'i dbus//bsgrub bya bla ma khe/ na gsal ba yis//bla ma'i zhabs brtan bzhed snga na lhun 'grub lha ga/rang nyid lha ru gsal ba'i thugs ka nas//'od 'phros mdun lha'i sngags 'phreng skul ba las//ho da bcud gser zhun rnam par bkug pa yis//bla ma'i zhabs brtan bzhed ro/na lhun 'grub lha ga/136

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/gzungs sngags 'phreng las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis//zla ser gdan la 'khod pa'i bsgrub bya'i sku//sku ngas gang bar chad kun zhi tshe 'phel bas//bla ma'i zhabs brtan bzhed snga na lhun 'grub sna ga/de yi mthu las nyes cesags kun sbyangs nas//tshe bsod gzi brjid dbyar gyi gaṅga ma//'phel zhing rgyas la kun nas theg 'dri bas//bla ma'i zhabs brtan bzhed dodan lhun 'grub lha ga/rigs sngags rgyal bo yi ge bcu ba'i gzungs// 'bad pas grangs mang bzlas bltard byas pa'i mthus//ril bu tshe 'phel bdud rtsir bsgyur ba yis//bla ma'i zhabs brtan bzhed thodan lhun 'grub lha ga/gzhan yang ྅/na bsags las sgrib rjodang ba dang //'di dang phyi mar bde dga' 'thob pa'i thabs//137

rjodan pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad kyi//zhabs zung sho je'i khams su 'gyur bar shog/bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i ce sa grwa ru//dpal ldan bla ma kun mkhyen yab sras dang / /'jam dbyangs mtshan can la 11gas bshes gnyen kun//zhabs pad brtan cing zhal mchothong gsung lnga sa sku ga/sa dge bka' rnying g.yung drung bon bcas pa'i//bstan 'dzin skyes bus rang lugs 'dzin dang lhan//thodad kyi srid la gzigs pa'i spyan ldan pa//de dag rnams kyi zhabs pad brtan gyur cig/bod yul chol gsum rang dbang 'thob pa'i thabs//gzhung gi las la hā la med bsnyungan pa yi//las byed ser skya pho mo thams cad la//tshe ring nad med bsdudad nams rgyas gyur cig/138

rjodan pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad kyi//zhabs zung sho je'i khams su 'gyur bar shog/bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i ce sa grwa ru//dpal ldan bla ma kun mkhyen yab sras dang / /'jam dbyangs mtshan can la 11gas bshes gnyen kun//zhabs pad brtan cing zhal mchothong gsung lnga sa sku ga/sa dge bka' rnying g.yung drung bon bcas pa'i//bstan 'dzin skyes bus rang lugs 'dzin dang lhan//thodad kyi srid la gzigs pa'i spyan ldan pa//de dag rnams kyi zhabs pad brtan gyur cig/bod yul chol gsum rang dbang 'thob pa'i thabs//gzhung gi las la hā la med bsnyungan pa yi//las byed ser skya pho mo thams cad la//tshe ring nad med bsdudad nams rgyas gyur cig/138

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/'phags yul ba dang rgyal khab gzhan dag gi/gzhung dang tshogs pa sber dang bcas pa yis /bod la stongs grogs las su 'bad pa can//de yi yul la bkra shis bde legs lha ga/tshe khrid brgyud pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dang //tshe la dbang ba'i yid bzhin 'khor lo sogs//tshe 'phel bdud rtsidangs ma'i char rgyun gyis//tshe bsod gzi brjid rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog/bla ma'i bka' lung sgrub pa'i yig tshang gis//cesas sgrub mthun rkyen gtsang snga'i rgyun bzhin du//gnang ba dngos grub tshul du za ba bo//mtshams pa ye shes rgya maces des byas bris//phyi lo 1993 zla 1 tshes da la/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor le'i cho ga'i gzhung ltar tshigs su bcad de bris pa'o//139

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/'phags yul ba dang rgyal khab gzhan dag gi/gzhung dang tshogs pa sber dang bcas pa yis /bod la stongs grogs las su 'bad pa can//de yi yul la bkra shis bde legs lha ga/tshe khrid brgyud pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dang //tshe la dbang ba'i yid bzhin 'khor lo sogs//tshe 'phel bdud rtsidangs ma'i char rgyun gyis//tshe bsod gzi brjid rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog/bla ma'i bka' lung sgrub pa'i yig tshang gis//cesas sgrub mthun rkyen gtsang snga'i rgyun bzhin du//gnang ba dngos grub tshul du za ba bo//mtshams pa ye shes rgya maces des byas bris//phyi lo 1993 zla 1 tshes da la/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor le'i cho ga'i gzhung ltar tshigs su bcad de bris pa'o//139

༄༅༅// yul khyad 'phags sa dge bka' rnying g.yung drung bon dang bcas pa'i dus gsum dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi spyan sngar gangs ljongs chol gsum skyob pa'i phur tshugs galha/la 'debs ting 'dzin skul ba'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba/rgyal ba'i bstan dang g.yung drung bon gyi lugs//spel la bce na pa'i mkhas grub bla ma la//phyogs ris spangs te thal mo snying gi thad//sbyar te gsol 'debs 'di yi don la dgongs//cadad gsal lha yi brgyud las byung ba'i rigs//bod kyi mnga' bdag dpal ldan sa skya ba'i//dam pa rnams la ga11la ba btab pacirnge mthus//gangs ljongs chol gsum mthun par byin gyis rlobs//140

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/khyad par da lta'i dus su 'tsho gzhes pa'i//sa skya'i bstan 'dzin gang na su bzhugs la//gsol ba 'debs shing re btā sa byed pa yis// gangs ljongs chol gsum mthun par byin gyis swā bas//rigs pa yang dag lam nas rgyal ba'i bstan//yongs rdzogs 'dren pa'i ri bo dge ldan pa'i//dam pa rnams la yang yang ga11la btab mthus//gangs ljongs chol gsum mthun par byin gyis rlobs//khyad par deng gi dus su 'tsho gzhes pa'i//gzhi dang byes na bzhugs pa'i ming dang to/na//mtshungs pa:rno bla ma rnams la gus pacirnge mthus//gangs ljongs chol gsum mthun par byin gyis tā bas//rtse gcig sgrub la bsnyu na zhing grub pa'i rtags//mkha' la 'phur dang pha bong brdzis pa snu gas//141

cag mtshar grub dbang bka' brgyud bla ma mkhyen//gangs ljongs chol gsum mthun par byin gyis rlobs//khyad par deng gi dus su bka' brgyud kyi//gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi/ /sems dpa' rnams la ga11la ba btab pa'i mthus//gangs ljongs chol gsum mthun par byin gyis rlobs//bod yul rgyal bstan yongs kyi phyi mo mchog/gsang chen snga 'gyur 'dzin pa'i mkhas mang dang //grub dbang rnams la ga11la ba btab ba'i mthus//gangs ljongs chol gsum mthun par byin gyis rlobs//khyad par deng gi dus la gzhis byes na//gsang sngags snga 'gyur bstan 'dzin su bzhugs la//lhurto gsum gus pas lan mang btud pa'i mthus//gangs ljongs chol gsum mthun par byin gyis rlobs//142

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/phal rgol ngan pa'i dpung tshogs gzhom nus pa'i//mthu dang nus pa 〈snags med mnga' ba yi /g.yung drung bon gyi rig pa 'dzin pa rnams//gangs ljongs chol gsum mthun par byin gyis rlobs//khyad par da lta'i dus su bon lugs kyi//bstan pa 'chad nyan mdzad pa'i mkhas rnams la//〈snags ris spangs te gasku la ba btab pa'i mthus//gangs ljongs chol gsum mthun par byin gyis rlobs//cesal gsum bar la phan tshun ma mthun pa'i//kha 'thab lag 'dzings byas pa ma yin kyang //bsam pa cos chu bzhin du 'dres med pas//shin tu mthun pa'i thabs su ga11la ba btab//chol gsum chos lugs rab tu mthun pa na//mi rigs rang tshugs thub pa'i thabs mchog ste//143

bod don bsgrub par 'dod pa gang zhig gis//sna snurags thabs kyis 'di la 'bad par zhu//rang la bod don bsgrub pa'i mthu med pas//mkhas grub bo|nga ma rnams la ga11la ba btab//'di la sngagen 'bras kun nas ma byung na//mal gyi nang du shugs ring 'asnga na las ci//bstan dang 'thod ba kun la phan pa'i phyir// 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam gyi rgyal thabs la//'dul 'dzin dge slong zhugs kyang nyes ltung gis//thodas par mi 'gyur nyams su len pa'i mthodag/chos lugs rang rang lugs kyi lta grub tsam//dam du bzung ste 'jig rten yal bor na//thodad snga na cha tshang bsgrub par mi nus pas//srid kyi cadags la'ang spyan ras yangs par zhu//144

dase spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/snying rje smon lam dbang gis gangs ljongs kyi//dmu rgod gdul bya 'dul ba'i byed po mchog/sprul ba'i sku dang mkhas dbang yod do cog/ thugs rgyud skul ba'i tshigs bcad re zhig snyungags//phrad spyi pa'i chos srid kyi las 'gan rgyal ba rin wa ཿ dang thod gzhung gi las byed kha shas kyi las 'gan du bsam nas ma bsdad par rang la nus pa ci yod kyi sgo nas rang gzhung la rgyab skyor dpung rogs sdongs grogs chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du dbo ngas gnang sku/da pa mkhyen/ mkhyen/ mkhyen// //

dase spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/snying rje smon lam dbang gis gangs ljongs kyi//dmu rgod gdul bya 'dul ba'i byed po mchog/sprul ba'i sku dang mkhas dbang yod do cog/ thugs rgyud skul ba'i tshigs bcad re zhig snyungags//phrad spyi pa'i chos srid kyi las 'gan rgyal ba rin wa ཿ dang thod gzhung gi las byed kha shas kyi las 'gan du bsam nas ma bsdad par rang la nus pa ci yod kyi sgo nas rang gzhung la rgyab skyor dpung rogs sdongs grogs chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du dbo ngas gnang sku/da pa mkhyen/ mkhyen/ mkhyen// //

༄༅//sems kyi dga' sdug 'phel 'grib ri mo zhes bya ba/phyogaXbacudus gsum rgyalas nagyi//brtsa byen gzugs ṭ+wāṃ grub pa khams//ngur ga 'char+sha bapo ༵rtul zhugs can//gangs can man zhabs la 'dud//khyed kyi rjes su 'brang ༷ yi/mi/༷zugs caX gzugs ma~X ༵༵ //lags sgrub skya 'phags mas ga/bdag gi dad pa'i yul du 'dzin//snag bsam dag byes ga/ gi paX//lags sgrub ngur ga 'an pa sdar//dadapaskudepalta ci 11sa// sku1khyimaganas dgala~Xng gus pa da//

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/gang gis thothod spyi'i snu sa srid las//nyin mtshan bce na tshe de nyid la//gegs byed bla gzugs seṅge'i khrir//'khod kyang dad pa'i yul du ci//gang gi bka' bzhin legs sgrub pa'i//mi de rtag chad gnyis ma'i mthar//lhung ste mu stegs nyid yin kyang //brtsibakur mi byed rang dbang ci//gang la wesgol ba'i mkhas blun dag//dge tshul slong gi sdom pa'i khrims//gtsang zhing lta ba dbu ma'i lam/ /thal 'gyur yin yang su zhig gus//gang gi bka' gtsigs dang len gyi//las la nyin mtshan bsnyu na pa'i mir//147

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/gang gis thothod spyi'i snu sa srid las//nyin mtshan bce na tshe de nyid la//gegs byed bla gzugs seṅge'i khrir//'khod kyang dad pa'i yul du ci//gang gi bka' bzhin legs sgrub pa'i//mi de rtag chad gnyis ma'i mthar//lhung ste mu stegs nyid yin kyang //brtsibakur mi byed rang dbang ci//gang la wesgol ba'i mkhas blun dag//dge tshul slong gi sdom pa'i khrims//gtsang zhing lta ba dbu ma'i lam/ /thal 'gyur yin yang su zhig gus//gang gi bka' gtsigs dang len gyi//las la nyin mtshan bsnyu na pa'i mir//147

yig drug bswā da pa mchis min yang //dad dang bsngags pa'i yul du 'dzin//gang gi mdzad bzang smad pa dag/dge slong yin zhes bud med rnams//mjogeng tshe mjing pa gcu na yang //dad pa'i zhing du su yis re//gang gi bka' la bkur ba'i mis /chos tre gas sdom pa ma blangs kyang //srid lugs spang blang mkhas gyur pa//rab byung bdag 'dra'i lhag tu gyur// gang gi bka' las phyir ༷dgas na//sprul ming mkhas pa'i grags 'bar yang //spyi sems bzang 11sa ma zin phyir//grags skam yin pas gus snga na med//148

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/gang gi bka' yi cha shas tsam//'bad pas sgrub kyang las dbang gis//mthar phyin skal ba ma byung yang //de la mi kun ngo so yod//gang la thun mong snang ba'i byer//gus tshul lha na yang nges snga na la//61ga sgrub las la zhugs pa'i mi// bod don snub pa'i nang dgra nyid//gang gi mdun du gus pa yi//zhe cirgag thal sbyar ma mchis kyang //༷ la med bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mi//thodad khams bde skyid 'dren pa'i gnyen//gang gi spyan sngar dbang nod de//thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor ma nus kyang //149

phu dkrugs mda' dkrugs mi byed pa'i//skye bo rnams kyi dam tshig gtsang //gang gi mdun sar ham sems kyis//masnga rgyud man ngag zhus pa'i rjes //ngo log byas te phu mda'i bar//dkrugs pa'i mi de dam tshig nyams//gang gi thugs mnyes slad du 'gas//rang nor bod spyi bde thabs su//phangs med gtong ba'i skye bo rnams//bsam pa bzang sngo lha las lhag/gang gis snu sa srid slar gso'i bka'//mi brtsi dmar nag rgya yi 21gas//rang gces kherdzo nas blangs blangs nas//bsags pa phugs sngagen dmyal ba'i rgyu//150

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/phyi gtsang nang gtsang pad+ma'i sbubs//rang bstod 'ud po brjod pa 'gas//mtshon sbyor drag pos gsod lugs 'di//'dul ba'i bstan pa yin ྅rte 'o(//rigs slob 'gan 'dzin dpon slob kyi//mgrin pa gri yis bcad pa dang //gri rtse mig la btsugs dang lhan//lha/ga dbang 'gag pa a tsa ma//gung khran tang gi drag wa'i gzhung //ngan zhes gleng brjod mang na yang //lha 'dre smod pa'i las lan la//lhasag khrims bcad pa ngas ma bo//cadan kyang de la pham pa yi//yid mi bde ba byas ci phan//151

snyigs ma bdo ba'i rang mdangs te// de la bcos su ci zhig yod//nga rang skyes yul mdo smad du//btsun gzugs snurmes bo/sa khyodan ma thag/dbyangs gsal mgo mjug mi shes kyang //dge 'dun yin zhes brtsi ba mjosgong //'di gar rdo rje slob dpon la//mtshan smod ngo rgol byed pa dang //'khor gyi mkhas pa slob dpon 'ga'//brtse sems ྅sner nas bsad pa ma11nga //kye ma 'di 'dra'i 'o/ga sgrub la//so so'i skye bo bdag 'dra'i sems//skyo ba lta ci phyogs dus kyi//rgyal kun skyod nas mchi ma 'acesar//152

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/ya rabs mjogeng bas dad gus dang // ma rabs skyodan la lham ba'i sems res snunas tshul gyis dran pa rnams//gzugs su bkod pa 'di lags sku //masngagar na bdag 11gas sems can kun//phan tshun ya rabs ྅7da bzang gis//lugs gnyis bzung ste rang gzhan don//smon pa bzhin du 'grub par shog/dgra cadas bslu thabs gsang ba'i 'o/gas//a 〈(ra sa ya byin pas kyang //rang gi gatherga gzhung dmangs rnams kyi//phyags don dkrugs par ma gyur cig/sems kyi dga' sdug 'phel 'grib las//legs nyes rtsom gyi sde tshan 'di//153
dha sa sku sger yig tshang gi/gsos bu ye shes rgya mtshos bris//phyi sod 1998 1 5 la bris/
dha sa sku sger yig tshang gi/gsos bu ye shes rgya mtshos bris//phyi sod 1998 1 5 la bris/

༄༅༅// sems kyi cho 'phrul rnam rtog slog zhags 'khyug pa'i rlabs ris zhes bya ba/sngor mtshar 'phrin las cadar bu'i zhags pa yis//'dzam gling 'dzin ma'i khor yug ma lus pa// dam du bcings kyang 'gro la bde dga'i dpal//sbyin mdzad gangs can mabo/na wa'i zhabs la 'dud//nyid kyi bka' tshig rdo rje'i 'phreng ba'i rgyan//gtsug tu 'dzin pa'i phul byung skyes bu mchog/gang na su bzhugs de dag lha las lhag/gtsug tu 'dzin cad dam ldan thugs ma zhum//rgyal blon lo paṇa mkhas mang drin las deng //'dzam gling skye tho'i mig sngar theg gsum sngags//155

༄༅༅// sems kyi cho 'phrul rnam rtog slog zhags 'khyug pa'i rlabs ris zhes bya ba/sngor mtshar 'phrin las cadar bu'i zhags pa yis//'dzam gling 'dzin ma'i khor yug ma lus pa// dam du bcings kyang 'gro la bde dga'i dpal//sbyin mdzad gangs can mabo/na wa'i zhabs la 'dud//nyid kyi bka' tshig rdo rje'i 'phreng ba'i rgyan//gtsug tu 'dzin pa'i phul byung skyes bu mchog/gang na su bzhugs de dag lha las lhag/gtsug tu 'dzin cad dam ldan thugs ma zhum//rgyal blon lo paṇa mkhas mang drin las deng //'dzam gling skye tho'i mig sngar theg gsum sngags//155

skyes su btegs pas gangs ljongs chos ldan gyi//rgyal khab yin pa'i rang mdangs 'bur du chodan//de ltar yin yang bod kyis bkur ba'i zhing //bla ma rnams dang dasngo na rigs gsar rnying kun//zhal 'cham bo/sa 'grig bya bas rang gzhung 'di// bsil ldan dbus su spo ba'i thabs la rem//rang nyid mtho bar 'dzin pa'i bla dpon 'gar//rang sa ma lnga ba sa mtha'i yul ༷rmegs su//rang mgo thon pa'i dpal 'byor yod na yang //rang rigs phyi rabs thodad la mi gzigs sam//mi chen su dag rang mgo thon pa'i nyin// mi mang re ltos can la mig zur tsam// mi blta rang don kho nas tshe 'khyol ba'i//mi ngan de las khrel 'das su zhig sku da/ /156

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/chung nas skad yig slob tshe rang gzhung gi/drin las myongan tan rjodang ba'i mthun pa'i rkyen//thob kyang rang mgo thon pa tsam nyid nas//rang gzhung rgyang skyur byed pa khrel re chung //lda je 'chang zhes bla ma chen po dang // rgyal tho'i ming can dpon po du ma zhig/bod la yod kyang gangs ljongs skyong lugs ni//'brug pa'i gzhung la ma do 'di ci yin//sham bha la dang ri rgyal lhun po yi//chags rim tshon mdangs ri mo ngo mtshar can//bris pa yod mod bod longs khor yag la///dra/ ring sa khra gcig tsam ma bkod 'di ci yin//bod rgyal gdung rabs bcad pa'i rjes nas bzung //chab srid brtsad de dpa' rgod du ma yis//157

phyi 'khrugs nang 'khrugs byas pa mang na yang //snga na ldan rgyal kha ma jo ba 'di ci yin//dam ce)sa 'chad nyan sbru/ma sgrub dang //srid dang dpal 'byor gang dang gang //don du gnyer ba de dang des//rang sa len la tho rtsesgrims//'phral du skyabs mabo/na rgyal ba'i drin//sa mtha' yin yang bde dga' rgyas//phyags su 'di 'dra 'byung dka' phyir//rang sa len la cho ༄7sgrims//rgan rabs thodad kyi gtam dpe la//sa mtha'i yul na skyid 1/ med// mdzo 'phongs zhon na bde bo med//zer ba de la bden pa yod//158

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/sngon ma dha sa'i gzhi chags 'dir//rgya gar kho sa nas swā dbyug pas//sgo dang sge'u khung bcag pa sogs//mi skyid pa yi snga ltas shar//deng dus macadan sum mchodang bzhin du //rgya gar bzi bos rdung na yang //yodad gachodan zhum nas 'dug lugs 'di//mi skyid pa yi snga ltas shar//sna cho gas snubs lugs 'dzam gling shar nub kun//khyab kyang brtse ba'i bcud kyis zin pa'i chos//rgyal bstan 'di 'dra dkon pas 'di ring du//gnas phyir bsnyu na par mi byed bstan 'dzin su//sngon gyi mkhas pa'i gsung las lta sgom spyod//ro/gas 'asnga na ched du phan tshun dgag pa'i tshig/159

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/sngon ma dha sa'i gzhi chags 'dir//rgya gar kho sa nas swā dbyug pas//sgo dang sge'u khung bcag pa sogs//mi skyid pa yi snga ltas shar//deng dus macadan sum mchodang bzhin du //rgya gar bzi bos rdung na yang //yodad gachodan zhum nas 'dug lugs 'di//mi skyid pa yi snga ltas shar//sna cho gas snubs lugs 'dzam gling shar nub kun//khyab kyang brtse ba'i bcud kyis zin pa'i chos//rgyal bstan 'di 'dra dkon pas 'di ring du//gnas phyir bsnyu na par mi byed bstan 'dzin su//sngon gyi mkhas pa'i gsung las lta sgom spyod//ro/gas 'asnga na ched du phan tshun dgag pa'i tshig/159

mda' mdung lta bu malnga nga tshe ma dga' nas//'kho na dang 'tshig pa za ba blun wa'i lugs// wade yul mtha' dbus kun tu khyab pa yi//sa dge bka' rnying bon dang bcas pa'i lugs//kun chub skyabs mgon rgyal dbang lta bu'i rje//ma 'ongs dus su 'byon par dka' bar snang //ci'i phyir zhe na cho sa rgyal gdung rabs rgyun//bcad nas da lta'i bar du lugs gnyis srol//sku ngas snyu gas 'dzin mkhas 'ablo mabo/na chodas 'phags dang //gong sa lnga ba bcu bzhi nyid las med//srid lhadang gzhan rnams bsam pa rgya che yang //sbyor ba gangs ljongs spyi la phan pa'i lam//ma baXsnas lta grub chodas kyi khyodags zhen gyis//nang 'khrugs khrag dri bro ba'i 'o/ rgyus mang //160

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/mtha' dmag med pas rgya 11ga kha che yis//mtha' mtshams nye ba'i bod kyi yul lung 'gar//mtha' med sdug la gtad de bod ljongs sa//mtha' nas rim gyis blangs te dbus la slebs//nags tshal bcad pa'i ri bo gcer bu dang //gter kha blangs pa'i brag ri khog stong dang //chos rig bsnubs pas yul ljongs mtha' 'khob tu//bsgyur jo nad gcasnan mkhas pa'i cho gas rnams kye//rmad byung zhing phyugs nags tshal gter kha'i rigs//ma tshang med pa'i bang mdzod mtsho sngon gyi//yul la dpal 'byor don du gnyer ba yi//rgya 11ga kha che kun 2)sa 'tshangs ka byed//tsong kha'i ljongs na chags pa'i mtsho sngon gyi//srid gzhung lte ba grong khyer zi ling mkhar//161

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/mtha' dmag med pas rgya 11ga kha che yis//mtha' mtshams nye ba'i bod kyi yul lung 'gar//mtha' med sdug la gtad de bod ljongs sa//mtha' nas rim gyis blangs te dbus la slebs//nags tshal bcad pa'i ri bo gcer bu dang //gter kha blangs pa'i brag ri khog stong dang //chos rig bsnubs pas yul ljongs mtha' 'khob tu//bsgyur jo nad gcasnan mkhas pa'i cho gas rnams kye//rmad byung zhing phyugs nags tshal gter kha'i rigs//ma tshang med pa'i bang mdzod mtsho sngon gyi//yul la dpal 'byor don du gnyer ba yi//rgya 11ga kha che kun 2)sa 'tshangs ka byed//tsong kha'i ljongs na chags pa'i mtsho sngon gyi//srid gzhung lte ba grong khyer zi ling mkhar//161

〈snan chad masnga smad yul khams chig sgril gyi//rgyal sa yin moted deng dus ga 'dra 'dug/ rgya rigs thams cad pha mes yang mes kyi//chos lugs nang pa yin gyi tang gi srid//mang gatho'i lam du bsgyur ba'i nyin 31 nas//bod la phan pa sgrub pa'i re ba yod//mdo smad rma klung phyug mo'i lto byang gi/yul na gnas pa'i skusgog rigs rgyal bstan la//dad pa che zhing goms gshis bzang tho'i lugs//〈snad mi ya rabs dag dang 'dra ba yin//chig sgril dpung tshogs brtan pos rang phyogs skyob//'jigs bral snying stobs chen pos pha rol 'joms//chos nor gang gis blo kha bsgyur dka' ba'i//klad mkhregs kha che'i bu la thabs mkhas mjordod//162

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/sa dge bka' rnying mkhas pa mkhas pa'i bar//phrag sngasag 'gal ba byung tshe rgya 11gas kyis //lhag par dkrug ste rang yul brlag la nyen//bla sprul dge bshes rnams kyis dogs zon mdzod//cesas kyi cadags la 11sa pa ma byas shing //srid kyi lam la lto/ngas pa bad ga lta bus//drin lan 'o/ga par 'jal ba'i tshul mthong na//chen po rnams kyis bzod pa sgom par mdzod//rgyal sras spre'u'i rus pa'i lhu rgyun dang //sems ma brag srin sku yi sha khrag rgyun//mnyam 'dres bo nga bu cadad rigs sa ya drug/gnyen gyi mthar thug yin pas brtse ba ma1rdod//mdo smad k+ṣiṃ brgyud rnga ba'i yul ljongs na//'byor ldan skye bos slob grwa 'dzugs pa dang //163

khyim tshang dbul bo dag la zas gos nor//phangs med gtong ba'i mi la kun gyis bsngags//sa mtho'i yul na chags pa'i mabo| 'o1ga tu/ /dad ldan chos pa kun kyis gsar rnying gi/cor+shas la ༷dgas ris mi byed bstan pa kun//'gal med 'dzin pa'i chothos pa ya mtshan sku da//bod kyi nub mtha' mnga' ris 'brog yul na//gzhan nor 'phrog pa'i rkun jag med pa dang //rtswa sa'i rtsod gleng mi bsad khrag sbyor sogs//'jigs rung spyod ngan med pas bsngags brjod yod//deng dus phyi nang kun na gsar rnying gi/bstan la hur bsnyungan mdzad pa'i mkhas dbang zhes//grags pa kun la khyab pa'i bstan 'dzin macesag/phal cher mdo stod dpa' tho'i khrod na mang // 164

dpe sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/ ya rabs spyod bzang 'di la dpe longs la//rang gi spyod pa bzang ngan ci 'drar 'dug/zhib 'jug legs par byas nas gangs swā ngas kyi//chodas srid gdugs dkar yu bar dam du 'jus//theg chen bstan la zhugs pa'i gsar rnying gi/chodas pa kun kyis mnyam 'brel rang rigs thodad// jo ga mar bde la babo da de phyis nas gzhan//sems can spyi don brjod na go rim 'grig/spyi snga na bsgrub pa'i thabs mchodag mthar thug pa//chos bon chol gsum dog rtsa gcig sgril nas//rang gzhung lha las lhag tu bkur byed na//rgya thodad zhi 'grig sku nga ba'i lam kha bde//rang gzhung mi bkur dpa' bo stag 'dzin dang //chig sgril med pa'i mkhas mang lce bde dang //165

spyi sems bral ba'i 'o/gas len las byed pa// ci tsam mang yang bde skyid 'dren pa dka'// de las ldog pa'i dpa' bo mkhas mang dang //las byed ci mchis gangs ri ra ba'i zhing //bde skyid myur du 'dren pa'i byed pa po//yin phyir lha las lhag tu bkur bya nyid//mi dbang rgyal ngo'i rgyal sa ma bde na//yul 'khyam sprang wa'i nyal sa mi bde ba'i//gtam dpe bod la grags pa de nyid ni//deng dus rang la dpog na bden pa nyid//bsam tshad kha nas sna/ra ba'i ngag bkyal 'di/ /skyes bu 'ga' yi thugs la 'bab dka' yang //rjes su yi rang goms pa'i skye bo 'gas//bsngags brjod me tog gtor ba'i yul du'ang 'gyur//166

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/gang gis nyams su blangs na ni// sems la bde dga'i dpal ster ba'i//brtseba'i bcud ldan rgyal ba'i bstan//gangasaljongs snyu si gcesanor 'gas//gangs lhungangs btsan cadal sa mtha' nas//snyan grags 'dzam gling rgyas pa'i rgyu//sangs rgyas bstan pa 'di yi drin/ /yin phyir phyi rabs rnams kyis khyodangs//deng 'dir gzhan la med pa'i rje//skyabs mabosan rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen//skrun byed theg chen rgyal ba'i bstan//yin phyir phyi rabs rnams kyis khyodangs/ /'jigs rung mtshon dang dmag gi dpung //ma lus zhi byed byams snying rje// 167

〈pen pa'i bstan pa phyi rabs kyi// bod gzhon rnams kyis gces par skyongs/ /gangs ri'i zhing gi sngon byon gyi//rgyal blon khyim bdag 'byor ldan gyi//'bad bsags gser gyi rin yin phyir //phyi rabs gachodan nus gces par skyongs//rgyal ba'i bstan 'di gangs can gyi //mkhas chen skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang //du ma'i srog gi rin yin phyir//phyi rabs mi yis gces par khyodangs//bstan pa 'di ni sngon byon gyi//dam pa du mas lto gos gtam//gyong la bskur nas thos bsam sgom//mi rabs brgyud pa'i drin las byung //168

〈pen pa'i bstan pa phyi rabs kyi// bod gzhon rnams kyis gces par skyongs/ /gangs ri'i zhing gi sngon byon gyi//rgyal blon khyim bdag 'byor ldan gyi//'bad bsags gser gyi rin yin phyir //phyi rabs gachodan nus gces par skyongs//rgyal ba'i bstan 'di gangs can gyi //mkhas chen skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang //du ma'i srog gi rin yin phyir//phyi rabs mi yis gces par khyodangs//bstan pa 'di ni sngon byon gyi//dam pa du mas lto gos gtam//gyong la bskur nas thos bsam sgom//mi rabs brgyud pa'i drin las byung //168

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/gangs can shī༄ngas kyi lhu gas kun tu//khyab pa'i gsar rnying 6)sa lugs rnams//skye 'bo 'phral phugs bde ba'i thabs//yin phyir phyogs ris 'gong bo spongs//brtse ba'i bcud kyis zin pa'i thodas//yang rab swā gas chen thugs dam gyi//mthil du bzung ste sgrub pa pos//chodas la phyogs ris byed pa 'khrul//khyed ni gangs ljongs bstan pa spyi'i//chodag ma'i byed sngo a ma bzhin//yin phyir sa dge lar 'brug rnams//gces bu bzhin du gzigs pa gal//theg chen sems dang dbu ma'i lta//nyams len gachodal ba'i dge ldan pa//169

la la dag gis cesas zhen gyis//gzhan lugs snying nas blo da pa 'khrul//khyed ni bka' gdams rnying ma'i lugs//gzhir bzung sa rnying shar 'brug gi/zab rgyas gdams pa sna chortags kyis//brgyan phyir de yi slob phrug nyid//skye bo kun mthun yul lung la// bkra shis phun sum chortags rgyas te/ /dgra sde rnams kyis mi 'tshe zhing //bsod nams ngang gis 'phel bar 'gyur//sangs rgyas 'khor bcas slob lam du//bya sreg ri bong sprel glang gi/sha tshugs bzung ste ches mthun pas//yul la bkra shis byung ngo gsungs//170

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/rang dbang bde skyid 'dod pa dang //mthun sgril gatho rwakur mi 'dzin na// dgra bos bskrad de sa mtha' nas//'dug dgos byung yang sdug gyong red//tang gzhung gtsugs pa'i bog ma ru//ma'o yi 'khor du dmag dponabacu//kha mthun dpung gi ngar shugs kyis/ /mi rigs lnga bzhi 'bangs su bsgyur//chen wa3 )ra gyi rgyal 'bangs kun//chig sgril dpung gis shar tshulags kyi//rgya macerngasno mtha' nas nub kyi ༷rtogs//lo gcig bgrod pa'i sa cha blangs//bod rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum dang //blon 'bangs mthun pa'i dpung shed kyis//171

mtha' bcinotsware sa cha blangs patsware mazurgams//deng dus mi yis ha mi bo /chos dang chab srid gang sgrub na//gatho 'kho ra 'dus nas mthun pa'i gros//yod pa de la phal rgol gyis//brdzoba'i go skabs dka' ba nyid//a ri su sid sogs kyi gzhung //gtso 'khor 'dus te spyi phan gyi//gros kyis skyong nas deng dus su//srid 'asdudar mtho ba'i grags pa 'bar//bod ni srid dang dpal 'byor dang //tshan rig 'phrul chas skrun pa'i las//bstan kyang swā gas par mi nus pa'i//rtswa gzan lta bu'i dbang rtul min//172

bse sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/thon mis yi ge bzos lugs dang // lo stos bka' bstan bsgyur lugs dang /// mkhas pas bstan bathesgros brtsams pa'i tshul//bsam na 'di 'dra gzhan la dbo na//sa chu rtsi shing srog chags dang //rin chen sdeb pa'i sman nus kyis//nad rnams 'chogams shing phyi rabs par //phan phyir bstan bathodas brtsams la lta sa// rtsis kyi ang ris sa yi ngos//bris pas nyi zla gza' 'dzin gyi//tshes grangs chu tshod skar cha sogs//'khrul med ston pa'i tshul la ltos//dam snu sa sgrub pa'i gang zag gi //rgyud kyi byams dang snying rje'i stobs//173

rgyas pas rang las gzhan gces pa'i//ngo mtshar skyes bu bod la mang //sngon byon grub dbang mi la rje//sogs kyis pha ngo nga brdzis pa dang //mkha' la bya ltar lding ba yi//cad mtshar rdzu 'phrul yid las 'das//dmangs gces can gyi grub pa'i dbang //thang lha nga rgyal thodas chu 'jigs las//'thod ba skyodab phyir lcags kyi zam// bskrun pa'i bden dpang bstan du sku da//yodad kyi bla dalnga na thugs mthun te// dmangs gces kho nas chos dang srid//skyong ba yin na deng gi dus//bod 'di dgra bos ga la bcom// 174

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/rgya mis thothod yul bathodam pa'i g.yul gyi las//dpa' bo'i rgyal kha'i grangs su su yis brtsi//sbyin pa'i bdag po klo bur smyo nad kyis//gzir nas pha mes a macesad ba3r+sham pa lags//tang gis cha/da kyi chodas srid bathe ma pa'i gtam//gzhis lus rgan 11sa rtag par smra na yang //btsan sdudal gatho gzhung dmangs kyis thabs 'phrul gyis//lugs gnyis srid mthar brtan pa'i phyag rgyas btab//rgya mis 11da 'di mtha' la sprad min na//pho brang po ta la ru rgyal ba'i dbang //'od snang 'bar ba'i grog gi sgron me mchog/rang shong stod du bcug pa bzhin du 'gyur//deng dus gang gi mdzad bzang gzi rlabs kyis//'dzam gling 'dzin ma gasku gas pa'i dge mtshan 'di//175

rgya mis gangs swā ngas bathe ma pa'i rkyen ngan pa//grogs su song zhes bzod sgom byas na legs//btsan byol khrod na gzhon nu pho mo rnams//sna tshogs skad yig smra la spobs pa'i blo//rgyas pa 'di ni rgya yis tho/da pham pa'i//rkye na ngan grogs su song zhes bzod na legs//bod ni sa rgya che zhing nags tshal dang //gter kha sdudags las jo na pa'i dpal 'khyodar gyis// grangs mang rgya rigs dbul phongs bsal ba'i dge/thar dang kun mkhyen 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo//mi rtag g.yar ba'i lus 11 spyin gyi khams//gzhan phan 'du byed char chu'i rgyun dbo na yang //rnam the ga bī/ga zhags 'khyug pa'i ri nyal ba//ye shes rgya mtsho ༄ra bas smyug sne khrid// 176

ra༅༅// byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i sa bcad rags pa tshigs su bcad pa dpal ldan bla ma'i ljags kyi bdud rtsi zhes bya ba/snod bcud ye shes gcig gi rang snang las grub pa'i//gru 'dzin zhing gi dpal gyur snying rje yi lha mchog/spyan ras gzigs dbang mi yi rnam rol ba'i mgon po//bdag sogs byang chub brnyes kyang rigs bdag tu mdzod cig/gsum ldan bla ma mchog dang dbyer med kyi lha mchog/'jam dpal drag tu khros pa'i gshin rje yi gshed po//phyi nang bar chad srung nas dasngo sa grub kyi mchog gyur// lam gyi gathorwa 1 rnam gsum ches myur tu stsol cig/༷ gas bcu'i rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen bceladang nus gsum//gcig tu bsdus pa'i gong bu mtshan ldan gyi bla ma//177

ra༅༅// byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i sa bcad rags pa tshigs su bcad pa dpal ldan bla ma'i ljags kyi bdud rtsi zhes bya ba/snod bcud ye shes gcig gi rang snang las grub pa'i//gru 'dzin zhing gi dpal gyur snying rje yi lha mchog/spyan ras gzigs dbang mi yi rnam rol ba'i mgon po//bdag sogs byang chub brnyes kyang rigs bdag tu mdzod cig/gsum ldan bla ma mchog dang dbyer med kyi lha mchog/'jam dpal drag tu khros pa'i gshin rje yi gshed po//phyi nang bar chad srung nas dasngo sa grub kyi mchog gyur// lam gyi gathorwa 1 rnam gsum ches myur tu stsol cig/༷ gas bcu'i rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen bceladang nus gsum//gcig tu bsdus pa'i gong bu mtshan ldan gyi bla ma//177

sku(na tan gter gyur bka' drin bsam yul las 'das pas//bsam dang rjodar bas tshul bzhin bsten pa zhig byung na//'dzam gling bo| la zlum ྅6) chu skam gyi gnas na//phra rags sems can sku/da tshad grangs tsam la masnu na tshe//mi ni nyung shas de las dal 'byor gyi lus rten//rnyed pa'i lus can skal bzang kha shas re red 'dug/rnam dkar las la 'bad kyang bsnyu na 'grus kyis mi swā gas//nyes ltung las sgrib sbyong yang gnyen po la ngar med//gshin rje'i gad mo dgod bzhin sne len du yong tshe//mi 'gro rang dbang med pa'i ngang tshul de skyo song //snga da 'khyags reg bya 'thab pa'i tsha grang gi dmyal ba//'tsho thabs bzang btung mi rnyed lus rid kyi yi dwags//glen rā ngas gcig gis gcig la za ba yi dud 'bo //sdig pa che 'bring chung gsum bsgrubs pa las byung 'dug/178

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/'jigs pa kun las bo(la zhing 'acas 'dren macesag sangs rgyas//sgrub na rgud pa kun las skyodab byed kyi lha chodas//legs 'phel nyes 'grib grogs bzang bslu med kyi dge 'dun//byang chub ma lnga/ba bar du 'bral med kyi skyabs gnas//ngan song gnas ngan 'grim pa'i lag 'khyer gyi gatho rwaku//'dir yang chag sgo du ma'i phung krol gyi sne len//nag wa'i las lam bcu la garo/nga len zhig byed pa'i// dpung rogs dam pa bla ma mchog gsum gyis mdzod cig/skal bzang skye bos bsnyegs pa'i zung 'jug gi rgyal sar//babo da pa'i rnam smin sku na tan brgyad ldan gyi rten bzang //ma rnyed bar du lam bzang sgrub pa yi sa snurmed//med par bsam na ci bya gdo/la med la thug sku nga //lha bas ldan sdig pa chodag ma med pa nas bsags shing / /da lta'i rten la lhu/ma gsum bcas mtshams la rā/ngas pas//179

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/'jigs pa kun las bo(la zhing 'acas 'dren macesag sangs rgyas//sgrub na rgud pa kun las skyodab byed kyi lha chodas//legs 'phel nyes 'grib grogs bzang bslu med kyi dge 'dun//byang chub ma lnga/ba bar du 'bral med kyi skyabs gnas//ngan song gnas ngan 'grim pa'i lag 'khyer gyi gatho rwaku//'dir yang chag sgo du ma'i phung krol gyi sne len//nag wa'i las lam bcu la garo/nga len zhig byed pa'i// dpung rogs dam pa bla ma mchog gsum gyis mdzod cig/skal bzang skye bos bsnyegs pa'i zung 'jug gi rgyal sar//babo da pa'i rnam smin sku na tan brgyad ldan gyi rten bzang //ma rnyed bar du lam bzang sgrub pa yi sa snurmed//med par bsam na ci bya gdo/la med la thug sku nga //lha bas ldan sdig pa chodag ma med pa nas bsags shing / /da lta'i rten la lhu/ma gsum bcas mtshams la rā/ngas pas//179

ltung ba phra rags char bzhin 'beb pa yi gnyen ngo //skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dag byed bdud rtsi rang red 'dug/las ngan chu 'dzin nag ho/ 'khrigs pa yi 'e/nga nas//thodan shā ngas chodag ser 'thab pa'i 'tshub rlung gi rlabs las//gtan bde'i so/ legs 'thag pa'i ngang tshul 'di bsam na //rang gi las nyon rang dgra kho na rang red 'dug/'kho ra ba tsher swā na 'khrigs pa'i nags klung gi khrod du//sdug bsngal mche sder rno ba'i gcan gzan gyi ngar skad// drag tu bsgrags kyang mi go nges don gyi 'on pa//bdag la brtse bas dbo ngas shig drin can gyi bla ma//srid pa'i phun tshogs spu gri'i so kha yi sbrang rtsi//longs su spyod nyes gyur na phugs skyid kyi lce dbang //btsan gyis gshags na chad med sdug bsngal gyi khrag dmar//rgyun du babs na bag da glags med pa yi skyodan che//180

dge sbyong bse nu'i kher gtam/ma yi mngal du nying mtshams sbyar ba nas zla 'gar//lus lnga rim gyis smin pa sdug bsngal dang sbrags nas//las rlung drag pos ded de dog po yi 'phreng nas//byung ba'i bu chung dpag med sdug bsngal zhig yod skad//gnag snum skra myos 〈snan kha'i ba mo1 yi masnga ga bzhin//bzhin ras gnyer mas gang zhing lus sngo yi khur lci//sgo lnga'i shes pa 'grib cing bzang btung yang mi 'phrod//gshin rje'i rgyang brda yin pas rga ba yi sdug bsngal//rtag tu gces par bzung ba'i lus phung gi 'phrul 'khor//mi bzad na tsha drag wa'i dug mda' yi ngar shugs//don lnga stod drug gnad kyi lhu lag la phog na//gtor ba'i nyen kha mo da pa na ba yi sdug bsngal//gnas dang so/ngas khyodad mthun pa'i gnyen bshes kun phar zad//ma yi lus las lhag cig byung ba yi rang lus//181

mal gyi nang du bskyur nas gsal rig gi rnam shes//gcig pu dbang med 'khyam pa 'chi ba yi sdug bsngal//las ngan nyon mongs gdon la 'brel ba zhig yod phyin//rdzas sngags bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu cad mtshar gyi grub rtags//josna la zhabs rjes brag la sku rjes shig bzhag kyang //khyab pa 'du byed sgrog las shor ba rang min 'dug/bsags pa'i las ni sa skyodang gan ma17da kyi rā ra bzhin//mang du mchis kyang sred len gse sa 'debs dang bral na//tshor ba rtsub mo'i reg bya rang 'gags su song ste//bde ba thob wa de bas nyon mongs la 'thab dgos//ras la snum gyis zin ltar 'khor ba ru mching byed//gtso bo chags zhen dam po lcags sgrog las thu bas//re zhig mgo gnon byed pa'i kha gtad kyi gnyen po//mi sdug balhu ma pa yin par bla ma yi gdams ngag/182

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/mdza' bshes longs spyod 'gog pa'i phongs byed kyi 'gong bo//dge ba'i phung bo sreg pa dmyal khams kyi sne len//sems kyi zhi bde 'bo ga pa'i rang kho ga gi dgra tho'i//'phral gnyen byams sems yin par bla ma yi gdams ngag/zab mo'i gnas lugs sgrib pa'i sku la ba yi ga༄ḍa thod//gti mug mun pa de yis pha snga la gyi shes bya//bsgribs par snang mod don la rang sems ni g.yogs te//blang dor lam bzang snang byed rten 'byung gi nyi ma//las nyon sdang dgra rten dang brten pa yi btsan rdzong //yang dag lta ba brtan wa'i 'phrul lhadags kyi mthu yis//cig car galta ra ba g.yul las rnam rgyal gyi dgra 'dul// thar ba'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i nges don gyi dpa' bo//ches snyigs rang mdangs bdo ba'i mun nag gi khrod du//dmu rgod skye tho'i phrag dog rlung 'tshub kyi bar na//183

tshul khrims snang gsal 'dzin pa'i dpa' thod yi rnam thar//jo sa pa'i snu da la thal mo snying thad nas thum sku nga //ma thul yid kyi glang ro/ 'o/ga 'thod ba'i lus la//dran shes 'phrul zhags lcags kyu swā na wa yis btab ste//gar 'a gro rang dbang 'phrog pa'i rtse gcig gi glang rdzi//bo gas su 'gug na gzhung bzang slu med cig yin skad//gang gā'i bye ma snyed kyi grangs mnyam kyi bde gshegs//rgyal sras dpa' ngo babo da pa'i gzhung lam gyi sne na//thog mar gom pa 'jog sa'i 'khrul med kyi sgo mo//sems bskyed khe na yin pa man ngag gi nying khu//tshegs med dge ba'i longs spyod sdud pa dang lhan du //sdig pa'i bud shing ma lus sreg byed kyi me dpung //gcig gi sa gnyis bo comad pa'i byang chub kyi sems macesag/su la mnga' ba de la mgon skyabs su 'dzin no//184

tshul khrims snang gsal 'dzin pa'i dpa' thod yi rnam thar//jo sa pa'i snu da la thal mo snying thad nas thum sku nga //ma thul yid kyi glang ro/ 'o/ga 'thod ba'i lus la//dran shes 'phrul zhags lcags kyu swā na wa yis btab ste//gar 'a gro rang dbang 'phrog pa'i rtse gcig gi glang rdzi//bo gas su 'gug na gzhung bzang slu med cig yin skad//gang gā'i bye ma snyed kyi grangs mnyam kyi bde gshegs//rgyal sras dpa' ngo babo da pa'i gzhung lam gyi sne na//thog mar gom pa 'jog sa'i 'khrul med kyi sgo mo//sems bskyed khe na yin pa man ngag gi nying khu//tshegs med dge ba'i longs spyod sdud pa dang lhan du //sdig pa'i bud shing ma lus sreg byed kyi me dpung //gcig gi sa gnyis bo comad pa'i byang chub kyi sems macesag/su la mnga' ba de la mgon skyabs su 'dzin no//184

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/rang gi rgyud kyi sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa'i nges 'byung //gzhan gyi sdug bsngal yid kyis mi bzod pa'i snying rjes//drangs pa'i lhag bsam mi 'jigs gru gzings la brten nas//skal bzang ded dpon spyod bzang rgya mtsho ru zhugs so//sems 'di'i bcud kyis ma zin rnam dkar gyi bsku da nams//'bras bu lan gcig smin tshe zad pa dang zin na//'dzad mtha' med pas thams cad mkhyen pa yi nyer len//bla na med pa'i chos kyi nying khu 'di mtshar ro//gang gi thug sa la chodas de 'khrungs pa yi snu da la//zhabs zung gang la b.lo/da pa'i byin chags kyi rdul khams//dregs ldan lha mi'i gtsug gi cod pan gyi khrod du//nor bu rin chen lhag las rgyan bzang du 'dzin no //sems 'di med pa'i skye bos dngos bzang gi sbyin pa//'bos la gtan pa med pa'i btang pa yi phan sku(na//185

zan changs sbyin pas zil gyis gcasnan nus kyi dge rtsa//tshegs med gsag la mkhas pa'i rgyal sras la 'dud sngatho//bdag gzhan mnyam brje bakhyodam lugs zhi ba lha'i lugs la// man ngag bdun pa bskyang lugs jorwa ku yi lam srol//gnyis ka bsres nas bsgrub tshul dge ldan pa'i khyad ce)sa// de la ham sems skye ba nga rang gi 'dod rngam//cesags gnyis phra rags ci bsags sems bskyed kyis zin na//sgrib gnyis phra rags ma lus gtan zad rang byas te/ /sku gnyis phra rags shes bya'i dkyil 'khor du khyab pa//sngasan gnyis phra rags mthar phyin sangs rgyas kyi sa cha//dbul ba'i gdung ba ldog pa'i longs spyod dang dge ma/phangs pa med par gzhan la btang ba yi 'bras bu//de yang rnam par smin la re med kyi ngang nas/ /yongs su bsngos na rgyas sras dpa' bo yi sbyin pa//186

dge sbyong bse nu'i kher gtam/dkon yang bde blag nyid du rnyed pa yi dal 'byor//sgrub thabs dam pa bcas rang phra rags kyi mtshams las /nam yang mi 'da' lhu/ma sems yang yang du byas te//nyes ltung phra cesas ma bo|sa rgyal sras kyi tshul khrims//mi 'asnga da rkyen ngan dug gi masnu na cha yi char ba//drag tu 'beb pa 'gog byed rdo rje yi go khrab//lus la khyodan dang lhan cig khams gsum gyi skye 'gro//gnyen du sgyur byed rgyal sras dpa' bo yi bzod pa//phun snurags sku/na tan ma lus 'gug byed kyi lcags kyu//le lo rkun wa'i dpung ngan bdang 'ded kyi dpa' bo//dga' spri'i ngang nas rnam par dkar ba yi las bzang //sgrub la rtag 'bad rgyal sras dpa' thod yi bsnyu na 'grus//bsam gzugs bde dang btang lha mas ched gnyer tsam min par//rang gzhan rgyud kyi 'khor rtsagacod thabs kyi sta bo na// 187

bying lha da bral ba'i rtse gcig mnyam bzhag gi ting 'dzin//'khrul med lhunam pa rgyal sras dpa' cad yi bsam gtan//skyodan gyi mthar thug gang yin lta byed kyi mig bzang //yon tan ma lus gzugs mchog 'jal byed kyi 'od snang //gtan tshigs du ma'i lam nas drangs pa yi lta ba//'khrul med sbru/ma pa rgyal sras dpa' thod yi shes rab//theg mchog spyod bzang 'dod 'jo ba mo yi nu bcud//chodas pas bsrubs te gnad bsdus phyin drug gi rtsi mar//gang gis spyad na nyams dang dodags pa yi lus rjodabs//rgyas par byed pa rgyal sras dpa' bo yi spyod pa//rang rgyud smin byed pha rol phyin drug gi nyams len//dang du blangs te gdul bya snod ldan gyi skyes bu//thar dang kun mkhyen sa la 'jug thabs kyi man ngag/bsdu ba rnam bzhi yin par bla ma yi zhal gdams//188

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/shī1ga pa'i lam du zhugs pa'i snyigs dus kyi sems can//mi bzod snying rje drag pos lam bzang du 'god phyir//thogs mar zang zing sbyin pas kha drangs pa'i rjes su//gdams pa'i bcud kyis ga11 ba mtshan ldan gyi bla ma// 'khor du 'dus pa'i skye bo sems can la gzigs te//zhal ras 'dzum mdangs rab dgyes ngag 'jam gyi lam nas//gdul bya'i khams kyi dri ba 'dri ba yi snyan gtam//smra la mkhas pa gang de mtshan ldan gyi bla ma//phan mdzad 〈snan pa masnu ga gi bstan pa yi snying thod//tshang la ma cathor gdul bya'i bsam pa dang 'tsham par//skyo ngal med par yang yang 'chad pa yi sgo nas//de'i don spyod pa gang de mtshan ldan gyi bla ma//gdul bya gang la gdams pa'i bstan pa yi gnad 'gag/snyan pa'i ngag gis smras pa tshig rkyang tsam min par//189

rang gis snga na dang mthun par rgyun ldan du nyams bzhes//mdzad pa gang de bsten bya'i mtshan ldan gyi bla ma//'di 'dra'i bla ma'i drin la log sgrub cig byung tshe// dgra bgegs phye mar 'thag pa'i dam can gyi 'phrin las//mngon du mdzad de zur gsum drug cu ma'i gtor zor//drag wa'i sdang mig dang bcas kha nang du sna bas shig/rang gi thod sngo phyi nang thun mo nga gi nyams len//skyabs 'bo/sa zin na nang pa nges 'byung dang sbrags na//thar lam yin la smon 'jug sems bskyed kyi stobs kyis//rnam mkhyen rgyal btsware rgyu cesags bsam gtan zhig 'grub na//rgyu tshogs kun tshang khod sgoms sa gzhi yi steng du//'du shes brgyad kyi btsan rdzong brtan po zhig grub tshe//nyes pa lnga yi dgra ngan glags skabs dang bral te//ting 'dzin dmag dpon skyid pa'i skal bzang de mtshar ro// 190

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/dge ba'i pad mtsho 'chodams pa'i sems lha da kyi glang nag/dran shes zhags pa spyod ba swār+shan 11 yis rim par//btul te 'dod sems rtse gcig grub pa yi glang bo//kha dog dkar la rang bzhin lhod ltod rang gnas 'dug/ting 'dzin yun ring goms pas sems dbang du gyur te//las rung rlung gis lus la khyab pa yi mthu las//lus la shin sbyangs dga' bde skyes pa yi rjes su//sems la skyes tshe zhi gnas ngo ma de grub bo//sa mtshams 'di nas rang cag nang pa pacingabo ma kha//nges legs lam la bsgyur nas rang gzhan gyi sngaṭan gnyis//mtha' dag bsgrub pa'i bsam pa bather+shas min zhig byung na//a ma bu zhig skyes pa'i don go rang chod 'dug/zhi gnas cang shes rta mchog gshog thogs kyi gong na//lhag mthong dgra brgya cig car 'joms pa yi dpa' bos//191

rigs pa'i masnu na cha swā na lha nam mkha' ru gdengs te//sdang dgra'i pha rgan bden 'dzin mgo bo la nyen che//gdags gzhi btags chodas ma phye gnyis co gas kyi steng na//nga zhig ming brdas phar la btags pa tsam min par//tshugs thub snang ba lam gyis shar ba zhig byung na//dgag bya'i snang tshul 'phyugs med rjen pa rang red 'dug/dgag bya'i nga de phung wa'i tshogs pa yi steng du//tshugs thub yod na gcig dang tha dad du dgos la//med na phyin chad khe rang med pa yi khyab pa//nges te yang yang khyodam pa thar lam gyi maskra/na po//dgag bya'i bdag de phung tho'i tshogs rgyun dang gcig na//phung bo lnga yod bdag kyang lngar 'gyur pa'i skyon dang //yang na bdag gcig yin pas phung thod lnga'i snu gas rgyun//gcig tu thal ba'i lhadan las thar ba rang mi 'dug/192

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/phung bo lnga dang 'brel med tha dad cig yod na//phung bo lnga ga so sor bsal ba yi shul du//rang tshugs thub pa'i bdag cig dngos bstan du dgos la//med na bden 'dzin brag ri gnam lcags kyis galta ra nyen//yum chen shes rab pha sngagel phyin pa yi yang bcud//gnad bzhi'i sbru/ nas gtan la phab pa yi lugs 'di//lam rim rgyas bsdus kun gyi zab gnad rang yin pas//rang gi yid la bo mas phyir tshigs bcad du byas sku //grangs med bskal bar pha 1ril phyin pa yi lam gyi//bya dka'i gnas la rang nyid skyo ngal rang med kyang //de yi ring la sems can sdug bsngal gyis mnar tshul//bkodad par dka' na gsang sngags myur lam la 'jug dathodas/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug kun gyi snying nor gyi gtso bo//gsang sngags lam gyi rim pa rang sdud la bo mas phyir//193

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/phung bo lnga dang 'brel med tha dad cig yod na//phung bo lnga ga so sor bsal ba yi shul du//rang tshugs thub pa'i bdag cig dngos bstan du dgos la//med na bden 'dzin brag ri gnam lcags kyis galta ra nyen//yum chen shes rab pha sngagel phyin pa yi yang bcud//gnad bzhi'i sbru/ nas gtan la phab pa yi lugs 'di//lam rim rgyas bsdus kun gyi zab gnad rang yin pas//rang gi yid la bo mas phyir tshigs bcad du byas sku //grangs med bskal bar pha 1ril phyin pa yi lam gyi//bya dka'i gnas la rang nyid skyo ngal rang med kyang //de yi ring la sems can sdug bsngal gyis mnar tshul//bkodad par dka' na gsang sngags myur lam la 'jug dathodas/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug kun gyi snying nor gyi gtso bo//gsang sngags lam gyi rim pa rang sdud la bo mas phyir//193
