tshigs bcad spel 'asnga da sku da kyang mkha' 'aspo dang srung mas// bka' chad 'byung du dodags nas 'bri ba rang ma 'o/da//sku/ngas cadags bstan pa'i mnga' bdag gangs can gyi mabokhen ༄/sa//theg macesag bstan pa'i sman bcud yang yang du blud pas//bdag gi yid kyi gcadad sems khrag skran gyi thodang bu//rim gyis zhi ste je chung je chung du gyur 'dug/ngo da kyi khyodad bcud brlags pa'i rgya dmar gyi srid la//sngon chad sdang sems drag wa'i sdug bsngal zhig yod kyang //deng dus bla ma'i gsung gi gzhan phan gyi bslab bya//yang yang chodas pas sems la bde 'jags kyi skabs rnyed//chodas rgyal sku paṇa da3ras brgyud mkhas mang gi drin las//chodas dang rig gzhung bcud ldan zas masnumig gi gasku la ras /rnam dpyod so la za ba'i rno ngar rang med kyang //sdug rus rnyil gyis 'brad pa'i rtsol ba zhig los byed//194

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/'dren byed skyo bas phra gzugs yig 'bru yi 'phreng ba//mthong bar dka' yang rang gi chos rig la dga' ste//sna tshogs dpe cha mig gi sgo drung la sbyar nas//yun ring bltas pa'i grub 'bras tshigs bcad 'dis dngo ga thub//blo gros stobs ldan mkhas pas rtsom pa de mtshar mod//de bas blun pos tshigs bcad rtsom pa 'di mtshar ro//rgan pos gzungs sngags dur phyur bgrangs pa de mtshar mod// de bas dmar 'byar phru gus ma ṇi rang mtshar mo //tshigs bcad 'di la rnam dkar legs cha zhig mchis na//'dzam gling spyi dang khyad par byang sems kyi rnams sprul//pha rgan sprel dang ma rgan brag srin las mched pa'i//gces phrug sa ya drug la bde dga' yi rgyur bsgyu //swā chen gangs la mjosgon wa'i shar lhu gas kyi sa cha//pado smad yul du khral len khri ral gyis mngags pa'i//195

mardo da pa ye shes dar rgyas brgyud pa yi rus las//dpe sbyong rtags can spu shes ñju masnro yis spel lags//smras pa/rab byed 'di ni mtho la phrag dog dang //mnyam la 'gran sems dma' la nga rgyal gyi//bsam pas ma yin rang sdus lam rim la /'dris shing bo mas pa'i phyir du bgyis pa lags//gzhan yang khyodan khyodan dam pa'i rnam thar las//slob mas lung rtogs phra rags bla ma la//'bul tshe tshigs bcad bgyid pa'i srol yod pas//ngas kyang lugs bzang de nyid dang du blangs//gang la thos pa byas pa'i go don rnams//ngag gi lam nas chodags med lhug lhug tu//196

mardo da pa ye shes dar rgyas brgyud pa yi rus las//dpe sbyong rtags can spu shes ñju masnro yis spel lags//smras pa/rab byed 'di ni mtho la phrag dog dang //mnyam la 'gran sems dma' la nga rgyal gyi//bsam pas ma yin rang sdus lam rim la /'dris shing bo mas pa'i phyir du bgyis pa lags//gzhan yang khyodan khyodan dam pa'i rnam thar las//slob mas lung rtogs phra rags bla ma la//'bul tshe tshigs bcad bgyid pa'i srol yod pas//ngas kyang lugs bzang de nyid dang du blangs//gang la thos pa byas pa'i go don rnams//ngag gi lam nas chodags med lhug lhug tu//196

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/smra la byang dang be|mas pa ma mchis kyang / /rang blor 'tsham pa'i gang sbyangs rtsom na gsal// shes bya kun las macesag gyur rgyal ba'i gsung //tha mal bdag gis phal ba'i tshig rjosnar gyi//lam nas drangs pa 'di dag rung min na// mkhas dang grub pa rnams kyi spyan sngar 'chags// yid 'ong khor yug mdzes pa'i dha sa yi//brjid chags sa 'dzin mthon po'i gdong zur du//dge sdig 'dres ma sgrub pa'i gsar 'byor ba//rang ming gong du brjod pa de yis smras//rgyal ba'i gdung 'cho ba dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs//bsam dang rjodar bas tshul bzhin bsten pa nas//mthar thug zung 'jug rgyal ba'i go 'phang bar//sgrub la gegs byed mtshan ma med par lha ga/ 197

brtsodad bya byang chub lam la g.yar ba dang //rjod byed snyan sum gzhung la brkus pa'i rtsom//'di la bro ba yod med gzigs pa wa'i//rnam da17da ljags kyi 'e nga du dgram na gsal//phyi 611994 10 6 bris/

brtsodad bya byang chub lam la g.yar ba dang //rjod byed snyan sum gzhung la brkus pa'i rtsom//'di la bro ba yod med gzigs pa wa'i//rnam da17da ljags kyi 'e nga du dgram na gsal//phyi 611994 10 6 bris/

༄༅// lo gzhon mkhas sar gyi smod rtsom chu log 'thodag pa'i lcags rags zhes bya ba/phyi yi gzugs sgra'i tshan rig 〈sna na yis//nang gi sems la zhi bde 'dren dka' bas//phyi nang zhi bde'i lam bzang rdo na mdzad pa//zhi bde'i ded dpon chen khra'i zhabs la 'dud//bde dga'i phyogs la mi dga' su yang med//bde ba'i lam bzang mjodzing pa srid mtha' tsam//bde ster sdug bsngal 'joms la bde ba'i lam//bde blag mthong ba dam pa'i chos las gang //rgyal ba'i dbang bos dbu tshad zung 'brel gyi//rgyal bstan tshan rig smra la bka' babosas pas//199

rgyal khab kun ༷) 'argan ༷rdog mkhan 11 yis//rgyal bstan sems kyi tshan rig khe ngas su bcug/rnam mang 'askras la gcig tu phan pa'i lam// rnam dag chos kyi go rigs zung 'brel gzhung //rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i thosgo 'phang sgrub pa'i thabs//rnam dpyod mchog ldan bod kyi tshan rig lags//thodad rgyal 'bangs dang bcas pa'i gser gyi rin//bod rigs skad gnyis smra ba'i srog gi rin//yodad brgyud rgyal bstan bshad sgrub lhur len pa//bod kyi rgud pa zlog pa'i byed po nyid//dpag med yon tan gter gyur bcom ldan 'das//nyid kyi legs gsung snying wa'i yang dag lta//deng dus tshan rig lugs dang ches mthun pas//bdag gi yid kyi dad pa lhag par 'phel//200

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/nyam chung 'bo la byams dang snying rje yis//zin pa'i phan pa 'ba' zhig sgrub pa'i cesas//'di la rang lugs 'dzin pas smos ci dgos//phyi rol mu stegs yin yang bsngags pa brjod//phra rags sdug bsngal kun las gzur 'dod dang //bde ba'i phyogs su bsnyeg par 'dod pa'i sems//sems can kun gyi 'thodad snga na thun mo nga ba//sgrub byed rgyal ba'i bstan pa kun la phan//brtse ldan ston pa mchog gis gsungs pa'i chos /rigs pa'i dbang phyug du mas dpyad pa'i gzhung //grub dbang rnams kyis nyams su bstar ba'i bcud//rdul mcho na dus rabs sdudag pa'i cha rkyen lags//'di 'dra'i thodad kyi tshan rig rgyal ba'i bstan//gzhan gyis bsngags kyang rang gi gachodan skyes 'gas//201

srid kyi 'gog rdo gyur ces gleng ba rnams//chos spangs sdig pa'i ri bo rtsig pa nyid//g.yul las 'thab 'dzings bo mas pa'i tang gzhung gis//rgya rje snga ma'i srid gzhung bsnubs pa'i mthar//gangs ljongs gtso 'khor spyugs kyang sa mtha' na//rgyal bstan sku da pas grags snyan 'dzam gling khebs//'di 'dra'i bstan pa bod la med gyu ra na//snyan grags 'dzam gling khyab par mi 'gyur zhing //mtshon spyor kho nas rang dbang rtsod dgos na//ngal brgya 'bras med 'gyur ba'i nyen zhig gda'//deng dus 'dzam gling rgyal khab bcu phrag bzhir//gangs ri'i kho da nas brgyud pa'i chos rig gi/co gas pa brgyad brgya dgu bcu 'dus pa rnams//rgyal ba'i bstan pa yod pa'i drin du go/202

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/10na rabs thodad kyi khyim bdag thams cad kyis//chodas dang rig gzhung yun du gnas pa'i thabs /gces nor phangs med btang ste dge 'dun sde//bskyangs pa'i 'bras bu deng gi dus su shar//stobs ldan tang srid drag wa'i khrims 'og tu//'gug par ma nus gangs ri'i mthodan sngo/ yis//zhi bde'i rtags ma phyag mtshan bzhes pa'i gzi//sangs rgyas bstan pa yod pa'i drin du go/rgyal khab kun tu bkram pa'i 11da 'bangs rnams//ya rabs rjodad pa bzang zhes gzhan dag gis//bsngags pa'i yul du 'dzin pa de dag kyang //sangs rgyas bstan pa mo da pa'i drin du bo /rdul phran tshan rig smra ba'i dbang cad yis /nang thodas tshan rig yin zhes bsngags pa'i gzhi//203

gdan sar khyodab pa'i rab 'byams gzhung lugs las//rnam 'grel rigs pa yod pa'i drin du go/bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs kyi stod bcud kun//nyams pa slar gso bya ba'i bzang wa'i lam byams dang snying rje sems kyi tshan rigs las/ /rdul phran nus shugs sgrub kyang dka' bar snang //byas rjes ri bo brtsigs pa ma mthong bar//zhabs 'dren ril bu tsam la snyad btags nas//skyon brjod chu log drag wa'i g.yas g.yon du//brtan wa'i lcags kyi rags shig rgyag dbo sa byung //gzhung lugs smra ba'i gral du ma tshud cing //smra don sgom pa'i khongs su ma bslebs par//grong gong ri bo'i 'dabs su gnas 'cha' ba /mtshams pa'i ming 'dzin ye shes rgya mcho sa bris//204

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/zhes pa 'di ni pha yul gcig pa'i grwa pa sdu/ bzang rgya masnuras kha chodag yig thog nas chos dang gang zag la skyon brtsod byed mkhan gyi gzhon skyes re zung 'dug de dag la lan lta bu zhig 'bri rogs/ ngas tshags par steng 'grem spel byed rgyu yin zer/phyi 'o/ 19997 'ostor/

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/zhes pa 'di ni pha yul gcig pa'i grwa pa sdu/ bzang rgya masnuras kha chodag yig thog nas chos dang gang zag la skyon brtsod byed mkhan gyi gzhon skyes re zung 'dug de dag la lan lta bu zhig 'bri rogs/ ngas tshags par steng 'grem spel byed rgyu yin zer/phyi 'o/ 19997 'ostor/

ko༅༅// las dkar nag gi rnam gzhag bshad pa theg pa sku/ngas kyi gzhung lam du babo da lugs gcig pa'i gom 'gros zhes bya ba/ cadags bcu'i rgyal kun kyi zhal skyin//chos 'brel dngos thob kyi bla ma'i//sprul gzhi legs snumags kyi 'byung gnas//gangs can mgon po la 'dud do//khyed kyi bka' bzhin du sgrub pa'i//ya rabs spyod bzang gi las bzang //rtag par sgrub pa yi skyes 'phags// gang na su yod la 'dud do//bod yul mdo smad kyi shar phyogs//rgya dang sa 'brel gyi yul khams//206

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/mjotshod dge'i yul gru nas bslebs pa//bdag la thugs rje yis gzigs zhu//bdag gis rnam g.yeng dang sbrags te//lam gyi dmigs rim gyi rnam gzhag/yid ngor goms 'dris shig byas kyang //'dod don tshim pa zhig mi yong sngon byon dbus gtsang gi rnal 'byor// mi la'i snying rus la bsam na//nga 'di ri khrod du bsdad kyang / /chos kyi dri ma rang mi 'dug/ mkhas grub ma6)ga brnyes kyi skyes chen//tre+e hor skyor dpon zhes mtshan snyan//kun tu khyab na yang mdze can //bu ltar bskyangs pa la sus 'gran// 207

mdo smad gser mo yi ljongs kyi//mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi bya bral//skal ldan rgya maco la bsam na//nga la bya bral ba ma zer//casan kyang bla ma yi zhabs brtan// rgyun ldan sbyin bdag gi drin lan//zag med bsam gtan rang med kyang //6 sngags rigs gzungs rigs re los 'don//bo rigs zung 'brel du byas nas//pod lnga rgyud sde bzhi'i gzhung chen//sgos bsam skal ba rang med kyang //bslab bya than thun re los blta//gangs ljongs chos ldan gyi zhing du//bcu phrag rig gnas kyi gzhung lugs//208

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/yongs sbyang blo gros rang med kyang //sum rtags dag gsum re los 'dzin/ /chos srid slar gso yi spyi don//sgrub pa'i nus shugs rang med kyang //bde blag 'grub pa yi sgyu na lam//yang yang sems phugs nas so/sa 'debs//bla ma yid bzhin gyi nor bu//mtshan dpes spras pa yi sangs rgyas//'ba' zhig mjal ba rang min yang //mi las phul byung zhig 'o/sa mjo nga dal 'byor rjes mthun gyi rang lus//nges legs sgrub byed kyi rten bzang //bsgyur ba'i rtsol sgrub rang med kyang //tha chad log sgrub la los 'dzem/ / 209

cad mtshar tshan rig gi sman pas//don snod brje ba yi sman bcos//ston min mthong thos su yod kyang //'phen pa snyu gas pa ni so/sa 'chi//gzhan dbang 'ba' zhig tu gyur ba'i//da lta'i dud 'gro yi sdug bsngal//bzod dka'i snang tshul 'di bsam na//ngan sdudang sdug bsngal la 'o/sa 'jigs//tshe 'di'i lto gos tsam sgrub par//masnu ga gsum ma bsten kyang cesag na/tshe rabs gtan bde zhig 'aro/da na//skyabs gsum spyi gtsug tu 61sa bkur//'dzub ston gzugs bzhin du dka' yang //skyes yul nang pa rang yin pas//210

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/bslu med las 'bras kyi blang dor// cung zad bsam blo re los gtong //'jig rten yang dag gi lta ba//las 'bras 'jug shī/ga gi nyams len//bla mas yang yang du gsungs pas//bo ba'i bag chags re 'o/sa 'jo ga/ma6)ga dman su 'dra zhig yin yang //'phral phugs bde ba zhig 'dodad phyin//ldig spong dge sgrub kyi lag len//zla 'bad lo 'bad re los byed//༷rdog gnas du ma la mkhas kyang //las 'bras rtsis med kyi skur 'debs//'dzem med smra ba yi mi de//lta log ltas ngan du los brtsi //211

nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i cesas lugs//u tshugs rā ngas dad rang ma yin/ dacadas wa'i gnas tshul zhig yin pas//gzur gnas yid ches shig 'o/sa skye//rgyal bstan ma dar ba'i yul gyi//mi yi 'dod tshul gyi dri ba//'phral du lan 'debs rang dka' ba'i//dri ba 'di 'dra zhig dris byung / /thodad rigs tshang ma yis ཿr+shas bzhin//bsam pa bzang sngo/ rang byas kyang //bod ni 'dzam gling gi khrod du//shin tu 〉la ba 'di ci yin// lan ni las 'bras dang mthun zhing //pha rol dri ba yi 'dod don//212

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/'grub phyir rim pa bzhin 'chad kyis// snyan bug bdag phyogs su skor dang / /tshad med sdug myong gi bod rnams//cesas mthun bsam bzang dag ma ci)na//dge sgrub bsam bzang gi bod dag/gar phyin bde dga' yis khyab sku da//chodas dang mthun pa yi thodad rnams//rgya yis bsad mes dag ma yin//bde thob sdug myong gi bod gnyis//rgyud ni tha dad rang yin no//chodas pa yang rab kyis lam gatho //rnam gsum gsang sngags dang sbrags te//tshe gcig lus gcig gi rten la//sangs rgyas btsan thabs su bsgrubs 11//213

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/'grub phyir rim pa bzhin 'chad kyis// snyan bug bdag phyogs su skor dang / /tshad med sdug myong gi bod rnams//cesas mthun bsam bzang dag ma ci)na//dge sgrub bsam bzang gi bod dag/gar phyin bde dga' yis khyab sku da//chodas dang mthun pa yi thodad rnams//rgya yis bsad mes dag ma yin//bde thob sdug myong gi bod gnyis//rgyud ni tha dad rang yin no//chodas pa yang rab kyis lam gatho //rnam gsum gsang sngags dang sbrags te//tshe gcig lus gcig gi rten la//sangs rgyas btsan thabs su bsgrubs 11//213

kha cig masnga lam nas bskal ba//grangs med du ma ru mgo sogs//phangs med btang pa yi 〉rgags rnams//rdzogs dang lhan du ni 'tshang rgya//'ga' zhig 'kho ra ba las nges 'byung //bather+shas min skyes pa dang mnyam du//bslab gsum gces nor du bzung ste//nyan rang zhi lam du zhugs sku///kha shas chosags bsags dang spyodan lam//zung du 'brel ba yi mthu las//bde can zhing sogs su pasdu'i//ze'u 'brur brdzus skyes su gyur to//la la sdig ltung la 'dzems shing / /bsod nams dge ba la brtson te//214

kha cig masnga lam nas bskal ba//grangs med du ma ru mgo sogs//phangs med btang pa yi 〉rgags rnams//rdzogs dang lhan du ni 'tshang rgya//'ga' zhig 'kho ra ba las nges 'byung //bather+shas min skyes pa dang mnyam du//bslab gsum gces nor du bzung ste//nyan rang zhi lam du zhugs sku///kha shas chosags bsags dang spyodan lam//zung du 'brel ba yi mthu las//bde can zhing sogs su pasdu'i//ze'u 'brur brdzus skyes su gyur to//la la sdig ltung la 'dzems shing / /bsod nams dge ba la brtson te//214

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/'bras bu lha mi yi yul na//bde dga'i 'dod yon la rol to//'ga' re 'dod yon la yid smon//spangs te rtse gcig gi bsam gtan//basbru mas te bsam gzigs kyi gnas su//ting 'dzin dga' bde la g.yengs so//cesas mthun bsam bzang gi 11da rnams//rgya yis bathergan khang du bcug kyang //skyo med sems skyid kyi ngang nas//cad gsum dge ba la 'bad 'dug/batho na du rdung rdeg ni btang yang //sprul sku dge 'dun pa'i chos bzhin//rgya la gcadad sems ni phar zad//byams brtsemadza' ba rang sgom 'dug/215

longs spyod 'dzad med kyi bang mdzod// yod kyang sems skyid rang med par//ma zad sdug bsngal gyi sna 'dren//gyur na longs spyod kyis ci bya//lus la rdung rdeg rang byed na//chodas sems dge ba yi stodabs kyis//sems la sdug bsngal rang med na//bde skyid thor mtshar zhig min nam//cesas mthun bsam bzang gi ༷/da rigs//rgya yis drag 'ded rang byas te//phyi rgyal ༷/la khag tu bskrad kyang //bzhin ras 'dzum mdangs kyis brgyan 'dug/bod yul shor ba yi rkyen ni//rgya gzhung srid thosan la grims shing //216

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/bod gzhung rtsod pa yi dus gnyis// lhan du 'dzoms pa las byung ngo //gzhan yang 11da rigs kyi sha tshugs//'dzin pa'i sems dpa' yi gdul bya// yodad rigs khe na rang ma yin//kun la btang sgoms su 'jug dgos//de bas da lta yi dus 'dir// 'jigs rung rdul mcho na gyi drag chas/ /zhi thabs sku lus kyi bkod pa//sna tshogs 'dzam gling la khyab po//sngon dang da lta yi dus su// 'gal ba ltag ༷ da rang byas pa'i//sa dge bka' rnying gi sprul sku//rgyal sras yin theṭa rang mi bsam//217

da lta mthong snang na yod pa'i//phyi rol mi stegs pa'i chos pas /nyam chung lha/ba lugs la bsam na//rgyal sras min therga rang mi bsam//cesas mthun bsam bzang gi 'bras bzang //myong ba'i rim pa 'di bdag gi/rmongs blor shar stod tsam bshad pa//chodar yang bskyar bshad ni med lags//de 'dra'i bsam bzang gi skyes bu//'dul 'dzin dge slong rang min yang //dad pa dag snang dang bcas te//don gnas yon tan re los brjod//rgyal sras dpa' ༷/ dang rkun ma//gar bzhugs gang sku/da ni mi shes//218

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/ngo log yid ches kyi blo gnyis//rgyun du dogs jo na ni los byed//sku ngas rtsodags rgyal bstan gyi lag len//bslu med las 'bras kyi rnam dbye//bdag la bshad khral ni med kyang //brjed pa dran thabs la los brtson//lang dodar thodan mo ngas pa'i rlabs kyis//casam gsum bcas mtshams kyi rgya las//brgal kyang slob dpon dang chos la//snang chung khyad gasku da ni ma yin//skye thod sems can la gachodad pa'i//sdig pa'i bshags thabs ni theg chen//sems bskyed da lta rang dka' yang //byams dang snying rje re los sgom//219

skyabs yul macor+shag gsum la brten nas//'bad med sdig bsags kyi gnyen por//blo gtad ling skyur gyi skyabs 'gro//dka' yang re ltos shig los byed/ /chodag ma med pa yi dus nas//bsags pa'i sdig pa yi phung bo//mig mchodang lag zin ni med kyang //rim gyis gachodad lugs la 'o/sa 'jigs//gsog byed nyon mongs pa'i rgyun 'di//bcad pa'i rnam cadal gyi rgyal sa//ma zin da dung yang gsag na//chad med sdug bsngal zhig los myong //tshe 'dir phyi mig cig bltas na//tshe stod sdig pa yi las ngan//220

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/chen sngo bsags pa ni mi dran//chung ngu ma bsags pa mi dran//'jig rten grags pa yi sdig pa//mi bsad rta 'phrog ni med mod// snungs khrims bcas 'gal gyi nyes ltung //dbyar gyi char ba la co 'dri//kye ma 'di 'dra la bsam na//mgo zlum btsun gzugs kyi lus su// bsgyur kyang phan pa las phal cher//rang la gnod pa rang min nam//nyis brgya nga gsum gyi 'dul khrims//go rim grangs nges tsam dka' na//bcas 'gal ma byung ba'i gtsang ma//de bas dka' ba zhig min nam//221

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/chen sngo bsags pa ni mi dran//chung ngu ma bsags pa mi dran//'jig rten grags pa yi sdig pa//mi bsad rta 'phrog ni med mod// snungs khrims bcas 'gal gyi nyes ltung //dbyar gyi char ba la co 'dri//kye ma 'di 'dra la bsam na//mgo zlum btsun gzugs kyi lus su// bsgyur kyang phan pa las phal cher//rang la gnod pa rang min nam//nyis brgya nga gsum gyi 'dul khrims//go rim grangs nges tsam dka' na//bcas 'gal ma byung ba'i gtsang ma//de bas dka' ba zhig min nam//221

lus ngag 'dul thabs kyi 11 thar/ /gces srung dka' ba la bsam na//sems nyid 'dul byed kyi gtso bo//byang sngags de bas kyang lhag go/'on kyang mi lus shig thob ste//btsoldan bla ma dang phrad cing //chos sgor bcug pa la bsam na//lnga da pa'i ri shādzi no bzang 'dug/ mchod sa mchod sa la balha sa na//bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren zhig yin sna/da/ / dmang sa dma' sa la ba44sa na//'grig pa'i snang ba zhig shar byung //za 'dod gyon 'dod kyi sred pas/ /nyes med sems can gyi sha lpags//222

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/ len 'dod mtshon dug gi sbyor bas//brtse med dmar gsod ni ma byas//gzhan nor phun chodags kyi 'byor ba//rang la thob 'aro/da kyi bsam pas thabs brgya jus rjodang gi lam nas// 'jab len 'akā ga bathe ma ni ma byas//skra nag so dkar gyi dus su//sha dar khrag rgyas dang lhan du//'dod pa 'bar ba zhig byung yang //nyer mkho'i bag ma ni ma blangs//dmar khyedags chab srid pas bsnub bya//rgyal ba'i bstan pa la byas te//thodad 'ga' btsan thabs kyis bskul kyang //dgon pa gtor dgos ni ma byung //223

chos lugs rmongs dad rang zer nas// gsung rab bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur//rdog brdzis byed dus su nga ni//'o/ chung yin pa ni bzang sngo //ma11nga 11sa dran reg gis bag chags//bzang po 'jog nus pa'i byin ldan//sku 'dra mchod rten gyi rigs la//gnod pa byed dgos ni ma byung //snying rje blo na lam gyi mthu yis//mi yi sha tshugs rang 'aci(na pa'i//bla ma dge bshes kyi gnya' la//rta ltar zhon dgos ni ma byung //gnod sems kun slong gis bskul te//dgra 'dul gnyen lha/nga gi bsam pas//224

chos lugs rmongs dad rang zer nas// gsung rab bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur//rdog brdzis byed dus su nga ni//'o/ chung yin pa ni bzang sngo //ma11nga 11sa dran reg gis bag chags//bzang po 'jog nus pa'i byin ldan//sku 'dra mchod rten gyi rigs la//gnod pa byed dgos ni ma byung //snying rje blo na lam gyi mthu yis//mi yi sha tshugs rang 'aci(na pa'i//bla ma dge bshes kyi gnya' la//rta ltar zhon dgos ni ma byung //gnod sems kun slong gis bskul te//dgra 'dul gnyen lha/nga gi bsam pas//224

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/mchosan khyodar dug rjodar gyi drag las//lag tu len dbo sa ni ma byung //ngag gi rnam bzhi dang yid kyi//rnam gsum mi dge ba'i sdug las//spangs dang ma spang gi rnam dbye//nya nyung bsres ba bzhin gyur lta //rtsa brgyud bla ma dang yi dam//mchog gsum dpa' bo dang dpa' mo//nyan rang bka' sdod dang bcas pas//bdag sdig ma lus pa sbyongs dang //spyi wa'i bde chen gyi 'khor lo//skyabs yul khyed rnams kyi gdan sa// mārgags masnu ga khyed rnams kyi zhabs canag/nyam thag bdag 11gas kyi bsti gnas//225

ye shes 'od snang gi rlabs las//dngas gsal bdud rtsi yi rgyun gyis//mthug wa'i las sgrib kyi khyodan rnams//yongs sbyongs bslu med kyi skyabs gnas//dpag med bsags pa yi las sgrib//lha ga bral chu gtsang gis mi 'dag/drag 'bar me dpung gis mi 'tshig/skyabs yul khyed rnams rang mkhyen no//mtshan nyid rigs smra ba'i dpyad rjodabs//rgyud grwa'i sgom stobs kyi yon tan//gnyis med shi gson gyi dkor gzan//bdag ni skyabs 'og nas ma 'dor//skyabs yul khyed rnams kyi 'phrin las//gcig tu spungs pa yi bdag nyid//226

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/brtsedzon bla ma yis lhag par//byang chub snying bo'i bar skyongs dang // da nas gang zhig tu skye yang //bden bzhi'i 'jug ldog gi rnam gzhag/༄/na pa'i mtshan ldan gyi bla ma'i//'khor du skye ba ru smon no //ltod med bsam sbyor bas bla ma// tshul bzhin bsten pa yis gdams pa//snying gi thig le ru bcangs te//don gnyis lhun grub tu smon no// gangs ljongs mdo smad kyi shar phyogs//mjortad dge smad ma yi 'khyam ༷///sku sger yig tshang gi gasku sa bu// ye shes rgya maces yis bris 11/ /phyi 61 1997 8 10 la bris/227

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/brtsedzon bla ma yis lhag par//byang chub snying bo'i bar skyongs dang // da nas gang zhig tu skye yang //bden bzhi'i 'jug ldog gi rnam gzhag/༄/na pa'i mtshan ldan gyi bla ma'i//'khor du skye ba ru smon no //ltod med bsam sbyor bas bla ma// tshul bzhin bsten pa yis gdams pa//snying gi thig le ru bcangs te//don gnyis lhun grub tu smon no// gangs ljongs mdo smad kyi shar phyogs//mjortad dge smad ma yi 'khyam ༷///sku sger yig tshang gi gasku sa bu// ye shes rgya maces yis bris 11/ /phyi 61 1997 8 10 la bris/227

ra༅༅// dus rabs gsar ba'i skong rdzas 'bul tshul lha brgya bzhad pa'i dzanyi ga zhes bya ba/gangs ljongs skad yig klog la goms pa yi//rgan gachodan kun kyis khyodan tshad ma chodas pa'i//gtam gsar gad mo 1/nga ba'i chod ga zhig / ma bskul na yang 'bri ba'i 'dun pa 'phel//mthon wa'i ri dang zab mo'i mtsho sogs la//gnyug mar gnas pa'i lha klu mthu bo che//gangs ljongs snod bcud skyong bar khas 'ches pa'i//rdzu 'phrul yid ldan thams cad nga la nyon//sngon gyi bzhon pa rta dang glang bo dang //phyag mtshan ral gri mda' mdung zhags pa 11gas//228

ra༅༅// dus rabs gsar ba'i skong rdzas 'bul tshul lha brgya bzhad pa'i dzanyi ga zhes bya ba/gangs ljongs skad yig klog la goms pa yi//rgan gachodan kun kyis khyodan tshad ma chodas pa'i//gtam gsar gad mo 1/nga ba'i chod ga zhig / ma bskul na yang 'bri ba'i 'dun pa 'phel//mthon wa'i ri dang zab mo'i mtsho sogs la//gnyug mar gnas pa'i lha klu mthu bo che//gangs ljongs snod bcud skyong bar khas 'ches pa'i//rdzu 'phrul yid ldan thams cad nga la nyon//sngon gyi bzhon pa rta dang glang bo dang //phyag mtshan ral gri mda' mdung zhags pa 11gas//228

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/dgra gnyen 'dul khyodang las la mthu med na//mo byad gsar pa 'bul 'o/ bzhes su gasku la//deng 'dir 'dzam gling go la'i phyogs kun na/ /mkhas blun dbang med 'gug pa'i phun co gas the/ra//a ri'i dmangs sgor dkon mchog ḍo lor sogs//gang bzang yo byad ma lus dbul bar bya/ /las bzhi'i 'phrin las swā/ga ltar 'gyu ba yi//mthu ldan lha klu gang na mchis sku thodag/sngo na med ngo mtshar skong rdzas bzhes phyir du//thogs pa med paraganas 'odor gshegs su sasol//skru sa ldan kha ba dkar wa'i zhing khams su//'phral phugs phan bde'i rtsa ba rgyal ba'i bstan//mi nub slar gso'i bo gas mdzad lha klu rnams//sngon med sgong rdzas bzhes phyir gshegs su gsol//229

mthu stobs dpung gis chos ldan gangs ri'i gling //drag wa'i srid kyis bcings pa'i chen sngo rgya'i//sa skyong dge la bskul phyir lha klu rnams/ /skong rdzas gsar bas mchod do gshegs su gsol//gangs khyodangs coms kyi rlabs rgyun mi nyams shing //chen thod rgya yi srid lugs gathodar min par//dbu ma'i lam gyi zhi gros 'grub slad du//skong gsar rdzas kyis mchod do gshegs su gsol//phyi dgra mthong tshe wa mo'i spyod pa can//nang khul phu mdang dkrug pa'i ngan dgu'i gter//gang na su mo da cham la 'bebs pa'i phyir//sngon med skong rdzas bzhes phyir gshegs su gsol//phyi dgra thabs kyis 'dul ba'i lho bo sa can/ /nang 'bangs brtse bas skyong ba'i drin po cher//230

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/g.yel med rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las cadags mdzad phyir//sngon med stong rdzas bzhes phyir gshegs su gsol//khyad 'phags ming gis brgyan pa'i sprul ba'i sku//'ga' zhig lugs gnyis lam las g.yel ma11nga tshe//ma bzod lha la 'bod do legs lam du//'jug phyir spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gasku la// phun tshogs mthong na dgra tho'i slu phogs kyang //'dzem med len pa'i dpon wa'i skyon thos tshe//ma bzod lha la 'bod do log lam las//bkā ga phyir spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol//gachodan nu rig pa sbyong ba'i slob bu 'gas//chang dang du nag longs su spyod mthong tshe//ma bzod lha la 'bod do spyod bzang la//myur du 'bo da phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gasku la//231

'dzam gling yul kun 'thor ba'i gangs ljongs pa//lugs gnyis rgyal dar mjo na wa'i srid casdog tu//slar 'dzom bde skyid nyi ma 'od po che//myur du 'char ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na//rdzu 'phrul lha bas kyis gnas 'dir gshegs su gasku la//nyi ma'i cadad lam brgyud nas gshegs su gasku la//11ga gi rba rlabs 'grim nas gshegs su ga11la//sbru nga gsar rdzas la gzigs nas gshegs su gasnu la//srid lugs dbang gi rtags kyis mtshan pa yi//sna tshogs nyer mkho yo byad kun kyi tshab//ma lus rgyal khab kun kyi dmangs lhunar dang //khyad par a sgor dkon mchog ḍo lor 'dis//'jig rten nor lha rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //khyad par mthu ldan rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //232

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/yang ༄/sa thodad khyodang rnams kyi thugs dam bskang / /thugs dam bskangs shing bcol ba'i 'phrin las mjortad//bka' dang bstan bajo sa gzhung lugs du ma dang //ston 'phri sgyur bgo rtsis kyi rig pa sogs//phra rdzas steng du cig car sdud pa dang // rim gyis ston par nus pa'i grog klad 'dis//'phrin las rgyas pa'i lha yi thugs dam bskang //khyad par mthu ldan rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //yang sgos bod skyong rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //thugs dam bskangs shing bajo la ba'i 'phrin las malnga da//bcu phrag khang chen 'brel ba'i 'phrul 'kho ra che//chu rlangs khyodabs las 'khe ra zho'i 'then shugs kyis//skyel 'dren las la myur zhing stobs ldan pa//sa gzhi yom yom khyodad pa'i me 'khor 'dis//233

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/yang ༄/sa thodad khyodang rnams kyi thugs dam bskang / /thugs dam bskangs shing bcol ba'i 'phrin las mjortad//bka' dang bstan bajo sa gzhung lugs du ma dang //ston 'phri sgyur bgo rtsis kyi rig pa sogs//phra rdzas steng du cig car sdud pa dang // rim gyis ston par nus pa'i grog klad 'dis//'phrin las rgyas pa'i lha yi thugs dam bskang //khyad par mthu ldan rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //yang sgos bod skyong rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //thugs dam bskangs shing bajo la ba'i 'phrin las malnga da//bcu phrag khang chen 'brel ba'i 'phrul 'kho ra che//chu rlangs khyodabs las 'khe ra zho'i 'then shugs kyis//skyel 'dren las la myur zhing stobs ldan pa//sa gzhi yom yom khyodad pa'i me 'khor 'dis//233

'kho ra chosags rgyas pa'i lha yi thugs dam bskang //khyad par mthu ldan rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //yang sgos bod skyong rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //thugs dam bskangs shing ba༄dzil ba'i 'phrin las macad//gyen du 'phen na nyi zla'i bo nga la bsnyeg/thad du gtong na go la'i phyi la bsleb//'og tu snun na sa gzhi brtol bar nges /zla skar gling du bgrong pa'i 'phur mdang 'dis//rgyang khyodad lha klu rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //khyad par mthu ldan rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //yang sgong bod skyong rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //thugs dam bskangs shing ba3)la ba'i 'phrin las ma1dud//spyi le brgya stong du mas chod pa yi// srid lugs bzo tshong grong khyer phan tshun bar//234

'kho ra chosags rgyas pa'i lha yi thugs dam bskang //khyad par mthu ldan rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //yang sgos bod skyong rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //thugs dam bskangs shing ba༄dzil ba'i 'phrin las macad//gyen du 'phen na nyi zla'i bo nga la bsnyeg/thad du gtong na go la'i phyi la bsleb//'og tu snun na sa gzhi brtol bar nges /zla skar gling du bgrong pa'i 'phur mdang 'dis//rgyang khyodad lha klu rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //khyad par mthu ldan rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //yang sgong bod skyong rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //thugs dam bskangs shing ba3)la ba'i 'phrin las ma1dud//spyi le brgya stong du mas chod pa yi// srid lugs bzo tshong grong khyer phan tshun bar//234

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/bde 'jam yangs shing drang ba'i gzhung lam du//sna tshogs rlangs 'khor bu yug 'tshub pa 'dis//gasku ga mang lha klu rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //khyad par mthu ldan rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //yang sgos bod skyong rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //thugs dam bskangs shing bathe la ba'i 'phrin las mcho da//'dzam gling go la zlum wa'i phyogs kun tu//nam mkha'i mdangs 'aci(na chu gter rgya ma66) khar//chal chil rba rlabs gasku/ ba'i masnu lam na//rnam mang dngos zog 'dren pa'i gru gzings 'dis//rlan gsher chu lha rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //khyad par mthu ldan rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //yang sgos bod skyong rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //thugs dam bskangs shing bathodal ba'i 'phrin las malnga da//235

sgo nga'i sbubs las ma skyes nam mkha' lding //a mas rgum bus ma galhanas 'phur rtsal rgyas//mi sbya/ra mkha' nas 'dren pa'i byed las can//sgra yis bar snang 'gengs pa'i gnam gru 'dis//mkha' khyodad rlung lha rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //khyad par mthu ldan rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //yang sgos bod skyong rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //thugs dam bskangs shing bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//me lce drag tu mched kyang du ba med//'bar ba'i rjes su thal ba'i snyigs ro med//bza' btung g.yo skol las la bde blag tu//'jug par nus pa'i rdzas rlangs 'phrul thab 'dis//sreg byed me lha rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //khyad par mthu ldan rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //236

sgo nga'i sbubs las ma skyes nam mkha' lding //a mas rgum bus ma galhanas 'phur rtsal rgyas//mi sbya/ra mkha' nas 'dren pa'i byed las can//sgra yis bar snang 'gengs pa'i gnam gru 'dis//mkha' khyodad rlung lha rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //khyad par mthu ldan rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //yang sgos bod skyong rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //thugs dam bskangs shing bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//me lce drag tu mched kyang du ba med//'bar ba'i rjes su thal ba'i snyigs ro med//bza' btung g.yo skol las la bde blag tu//'jug par nus pa'i rdzas rlangs 'phrul thab 'dis//sreg byed me lha rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //khyad par mthu ldan rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //236

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/yang cadas bod skyong rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //thugs dam bskangs shing bathe la ba'i 'phrin las malhurtad//sna chosags gzugs la blta ba'i bo 'aX ga pa'i//mun pa'i bang rim stug lnga brtsegs pa na//skad cig nyid la sel ba'i byed las can//snang ba'i dkar cha sbyin pa'i grog sgron 'dis/ /mtshan khyodad mun nag lha yi thugs dam bskang //khyad par mthu ldan rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //yang sgos bod skyong rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //thugs dam bskangs shing bajo la ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//sna cho gas gzugs kyi dbyibs dang kha lha ga kun//lhur mtshar rdzas kyi nus pa'i byed las kyis//dalnga sa kun cho na mdangs bkra ba'i ri mo'i gzugs//'god pa'i ngo mtshar ldan pa'i dpar chas 'dis//237

yul sa ra lha klu rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //khyad par mthu ldan rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //yang cadas sngo da khyodang rnams kyis thugs dam bskang //thugs dam bskangs shing bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'dzod//snga da 'jam dri ma zhim pa'i mal chas dang //snang byed slog dang bsil sbyin rlung 'khor dang //khrus kyi khang bzang la lha/gas ldan pa yi//codid chags phyi nang gsal ba'i mabo na khang 'dis//gzim dgyes lha klu rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //khyad par mthu ldan rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //yang sgos bod skyong rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //thugs dam bskangs shing bathe la ba'i 'phrin las mchosad//cadam na zhim zhing lta na mdzes pa dang //ro bcud ldan zhing lto la 'phrod pa dang //238

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/gtsang ma'i snod du byur bur gtams pa yi//sna chortags bza' bca' 'alhurtams pa'i za khang 'dis//zas 'phel g.yang lha rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //khyad par mthu ldan rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //yang sgos bod skyong rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //thugs dam bskangs shing bathodal ba'i 'phrin las mjo da//rgyang ring yul gyi mi yi bya byed kun//rjodang ba'i mkha' la lho ga gi rtar lha na nas//'dzam gling yul gru kun tu khyab pa'i gzugs//bzung ste ston par byed pa'i klog brnyan 'dis//rgyang gzugs dgyes pa'i lha yi thugs dam bskang //khyad par mthu ldan rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //yang sgos bod skyong rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //thugs dam bskangs shing bathe la ba'i 'phrin las macad//239

yid 'ong rol mo dbyangs dang sna tshogs gtam//kun khyab lho ga gi rlabs dang lhan cig tu//'dzam gling 〈gegs kun khyab pa'i sgra rnams ni//bzung ste sgrog par byed pa'i rlung 'phrin 'dis/ /gtam gsar gsan 'asnga da lha yi thugs dam bskang //khyad par mthu ldan rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //yang sgos bod skyong rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //thugs dam bskangs shing bsnyu la ba'i 'phrin las ma17da //dbyar la bsil zhing dgun la snga ba yi//srab 'jam yang ba'i ras bzang bo sa masnu ga dang //mkho dgu'i sku byad ma tshang med pa yi//'dzad med zog gis gtams pa'i stong khang 'dis//nor ldan stong lha rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //khyad par mthu ldan rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //240

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/yang sgos bod skyong rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //thugs dam bskangs shing bajo la ba'i 'phrin las mjortad//pha snga la yul gyis bskal ba'i gnyen sku gas kyi//rnam 'gyur gdong gi ri mo ma mthong yang //bde sdug gtam gyi khyodar ba ci mchis pa//rna ba'i sgo drung 'dren pa'i kha par 'dis//gnyen thag ring ba'i lha yi thugs dam bskang //khyad par mthu ldan rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //yang sgos bod skyong rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //thugs dam bskangs shing bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod // mdor na 'dzam gling go la'i phyogs kun na//'acadar ldan rnam da17da dar mas nyin mtshan kun//bar mtshams med par 11ga gi 'phrul thabs kyis//sna tshogs nyer mkho skrun pa'i bzo grwa 'dis//241

'dzam gling lha klu rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //khyad par mthu ldan rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //yang sgos bod skyong rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //thugs dam bskangs shing bathodal ba'i 'phrin las ma17da//'dzam gling thod la zlum wa'i sa gsum na//snyigs lnga'i rang mdangs drag wa'i dpung dmag dang //rdul mtshon la sogs mi bzad 'jigs rung mtshon//myur zhi 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam la rje ra// khyad par shar gling yul du dmar phyogs kyi//srid dbang chig sdud rgyal thabs drag wa'i co/ga/dbang med sdug bsngal du mas mnar ba rnams//mang gtso'i bde dga' rgyas pa'i dpal la khyodar//yang 〈(sa bsil ldan kha ba'i zhing khams kyi//sprel rgan brag srin 'dus pa'i phru gu rnams//242

'dzam gling lha klu rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //khyad par mthu ldan rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //yang sgos bod skyong rnams kyi thugs dam bskang //thugs dam bskangs shing bathodal ba'i 'phrin las ma17da//'dzam gling thod la zlum wa'i sa gsum na//snyigs lnga'i rang mdangs drag wa'i dpung dmag dang //rdul mtshon la sogs mi bzad 'jigs rung mtshon//myur zhi 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam la rje ra// khyad par shar gling yul du dmar phyogs kyi//srid dbang chig sdud rgyal thabs drag wa'i co/ga/dbang med sdug bsngal du mas mnar ba rnams//mang gtso'i bde dga' rgyas pa'i dpal la khyodar//yang 〈(sa bsil ldan kha ba'i zhing khams kyi//sprel rgan brag srin 'dus pa'i phru gu rnams//242

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/ dmar khyodags rgyal dar 'og nas myur grol te//lugs gnyis rang dbang bde ba'i dpal la sbyor//gzugs med sems kyi tshan rig byang chub sems//yang dag lta ba ston pa'i rgyal ba'i bstan//ji srid 'dzam gling gnas pa de srid du //name yang mi nub gnas pa'i thabs la ྅rtor//gangs sgyurangs mkhas gco/na 'ga' yis rgyal ba'i bstan//tshan rig lugs dang 'dres pa ma malnga nga nas//chos 'di deng dus ran pa min no zhes//smra ba rnams ni rigs pa'i lam la khyodar// dgra bo'i bslu rngo gas 'josgob pa'i thabs ngan gyis// cor+shas dang srid kyi las la kha g.yar nas//nang khul phu mdang dkrug pa'i ya nga rnams//ya rabs spyod pa bzang wa'i tshul la sbyor//243

masngager na mkha' dbyings dbus kyi zlum wa'i gzugs//'dzam gling bo lar 'tham pa'i skye 'gro rnams//lhu gas kun zhi ba'i lam du 'khrid mdzad pa//zhi bde'i mkhan po 'khor bcas sku tshe srings// dga' sdug khyad par mi shes gtum wa'i gasnga nga //tshe gang 'dzum gyi so 'phreng ma mthong yang //stong gsar rdzas kyi tshig sbyor 'di mthong nas//khong dgod rlung shugs kha nas 'chor bar shog/rtag tu dgod byed rtsed mo chung ngu la'ang //gad mo chen po dgod pa de dag gis//skong gsar rdzas kyi tshig sbyor 'di mthong nas//hab cha'i sgra yis khang ba gang bar sna ga/rgan gachodan kun gyis skor gsar tshig sbyor 'di//mthong ste gad mo khong la ma shong nas//244

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/kha mthatsware pags pa kun tu 'then byas nas//rnyil dang so yi rang mdangs gsal bar shog/bla ma mchog dang bcom ldan dbyangs lha mos//skye ba'i 'phreng bar mnyes bzhin rjes bzung ste//gangs ljongs brda sprod rig pa'i gzhung lugs sku/gas//tshigs med gang sbyangs kun la phan par thodag/gangs dkar 'dab ma 'phur ba'i zhing khams kyi//lugs gnyis blang dor 'byed pa'i yi ge'i gzugs//'dris phyir yang yang sbyong ba'i goms stobs kyis//mi brjed bskal ba'i bar du 'dzin nus shog/rdul phran masnuran chas mtshan pa'i 'phur mda' dang // mkha' lnga ga galtasner 〉tel gnam gru la sku gas pa//stong gsar rdzas su 'os mod rang gi srid//'tshe med zhi ba yin phyir ngas ma phul//245

rta nag g.yag 1dug la 11gas lha srung la//phul na sdongs r+sha gas 'phrin las mdzad na ni//dpag yas ngo mtshar 'phrul 'khor 'di 'bul na//g.yel med srung skyob mdzad pa smos ci dgos//ting 'dzin sngagasu dang phyag rgya mi ldan zhing // 'alnga da sku na mchodad sprin babo da pa ma mchis par// chu brdzis gtor ma bu chung lo brgyad tsam//phul ba las ni nga'i 'di mdzar+shag min nam//gzugs can mi la rtsed mo rtse ba'i phyir//gzugs med lha la 'bod pa'i bstan bcos 'di//snyan ngag dbang wa'i thugs la mi 'bab kyang // spyodag tsam shes pa'i mi la ran tsam sku da// ka lte bo/gas dag nga yi snying kha na//me shes ho/ngas pa'i mun pa 'thibs na yang //246

rta nag g.yag 1dug la 11gas lha srung la//phul na sdongs r+sha gas 'phrin las mdzad na ni//dpag yas ngo mtshar 'phrul 'khor 'di 'bul na//g.yel med srung skyob mdzad pa smos ci dgos//ting 'dzin sngagasu dang phyag rgya mi ldan zhing // 'alnga da sku na mchodad sprin babo da pa ma mchis par// chu brdzis gtor ma bu chung lo brgyad tsam//phul ba las ni nga'i 'di mdzar+shag min nam//gzugs can mi la rtsed mo rtse ba'i phyir//gzugs med lha la 'bod pa'i bstan bcos 'di//snyan ngag dbang wa'i thugs la mi 'bab kyang // spyodag tsam shes pa'i mi la ran tsam sku da// ka lte bo/gas dag nga yi snying kha na//me shes ho/ngas pa'i mun pa 'thibs na yang //246
dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/྅ped ñju bde ba'i thabs la dus rtag tu//'o marto lta bu dkar ba'i smon lam yod//'di ni phyi lo 1995 lor bris mod/rjes nas 'phri ston cung zad byas yod//

༄༅༅// dad ldan 'das gson gyi gces nor longs su spyad pa'i dathodar lan bun bsags la dngangs pa'i snying gi 'phar lding zhes bya ba/ lha mabo na 1/ 'phags mchodag spyan ras gzigs//dus snyigs lnga bsnga ba'i sems can la//thugs brtse bas gzigs te dge slong gi/ skur bzhengs pa'i gangs can gtso la 'dud//rje khyed kyi bka' bzhin sgrub pa yi//chos gsar rnying 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dang //mi ya rabs gang na su mchis pa//de thams cad gtsug gi rgyan du 'dzin//khyim sku/ nam bar nas lha chodas dran//ཿnyis lag tu gtad na le 61sa mnar//248

༄༅༅// dad ldan 'das gson gyi gces nor longs su spyad pa'i dathodar lan bun bsags la dngangs pa'i snying gi 'phar lding zhes bya ba/ lha mabo na 1/ 'phags mchodag spyan ras gzigs//dus snyigs lnga bsnga ba'i sems can la//thugs brtse bas gzigs te dge slong gi/ skur bzhengs pa'i gangs can gtso la 'dud//rje khyed kyi bka' bzhin sgrub pa yi//chos gsar rnying 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dang //mi ya rabs gang na su mchis pa//de thams cad gtsug gi rgyan du 'dzin//khyim sku/ nam bar nas lha chodas dran//ཿnyis lag tu gtad na le 61sa mnar//248

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/ci byed kyang shi gasku/na dkor zas kyis//lus 'aces ba bdag la thugs rjes gzigs//mi cesas dad can gyi pha ma sku gas//tshe 'das so yer nas bsngo ba'i rten//mgo btud de phul tshe bdag la ni//thabs ci yang med pas ngu re bro//rang ngan song gnas su mi 'gro ba'i//gdeng ci yang med par 'das gson gyi//rgyu ba〉 rten 'dzem med len pa bdag/phyags legs su 'dod kyang dka' bar snang //las ྅/na sna/ngas rgyud ldan tha mal ba//bdag lta bus btsun gzugs bzung ba la//:pe ba11da nams can shri)sa phyag 'a25la na//sngon las bzang bsags pa zad par dogs//249

dug rma byas zas na 'dab gasna ga mdangs//'ja' lta bu'i tshon mdangs ngang gis rgyas//dathodar nyams len can gyis 'o/ngas spyad na//byams snying rje'i nyams rtogs gong du 'phel//dug khā tas zas na gces pa'i srog/mthar mi phyin tshe srog gcod pa'i gshed//daspo ra tshul 'chal dag gis 'o/ngas spyad na //nyams swā gas pa phar zad de yi gegs//dus nam zhig 'chi ba'i snga ltas kyi//rtags rim par shar tshe gasku na pa'i skabs//dkor zas pa'i bu lon ma 'jal bas//yid 'a〈snad pas mnar na da ci bya// sdig che mang bsags pa'i skye wa'i gnas//yul dmyal ba'i lcags thang me gling du//250

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/dkor zas pa'i bu lon lus kyi sha/gris bcad de 'jal tshe da ci bya//lus dud 'gro che ba'i gzugs grub ste//dbo ra bu 'o/na len pa'i sems can rnams//mchu mche ba swā ba'i lus gyur te// dus rtag tu za na da ci bya//dus da lta macadan sum mthong bzhin du//lus chen sngo/sa chung ba za ba dang //mchu swā na sngo sa chen sngo 'thigs la lha/gas//sngon bu yon yod pa'i rtags su snang //der ma zad rang cag mi rnams kyis//sha za zhing lpags pa gyon pa'i ra//lug la sku gas nyes med cangagazan rnams//lus sha pags 'a'o/ga pa bu 'o/na nyid//251

mi le lo'i dbang gyur bdag lta bus//dkor za ba sla yang sbyong ba dka'// de bsam zhing bsam zhing mi tshe 'di'i//phyed yol bar gyur to mchog gsum mkhyen//gos ngur smrig gyon pa sla na yang //sdom dam tshig srog ltar srung ba dka'//de bsam zhing bsam zhing khas blangs rnams//cha tshang ba dka' cad mchodag gsum mkhyen//ri'i rtse nas 'dug pa sla na yang //sems chodas la 17gas pa shin tu dka'//de bsam na cesas pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam//ngas bzung cad bla ma macodag gsum mkhyen//lus 'du 'dzi spong ba sla na yang // sems 'du 'dzi'i g.yeng ba gcod dka' phyir//252

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/nang ting 'dzin zer ba'i skad po cher//thag ring cad bla ma mchodag gsum mkhyen//de yin yang da lta'i rten 'di la//yul gnyan po do je slob dpon mchog/thugs skyo ba'i log sgrub ma byas phyir//lus 'tsho ba'i dkor tsam rung ngam snyam//spyir mchog gsum sems can sku1ngas kyi drin// lha sa bla ma sbyin pa'i bdag wa'i drin//cesas chab srid mi rigs mi gcig pa'i//sa 'di nas zas bo/sa bstabs pa mtshar//zhes spyir dkor zas dkor chu longs spyad na nyams dang rtogs pa skye ba la bar du gcod pa'i gegs su 'gyur bar gsungs yod la/ chos la gsar du 'jug pa'i las dang po ba la de ltar yin yang byams snying rje rtsa ba can gyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i nyams len bo|mas 'dris sku1da pa'i gang zag 253
gis longs spyad na nyams rtogs 'phel byed kyi rdzas su 'gyur ba lta bu mngon no//zhes pa 'di ni phyi lo 1996zla 5 tshes 8 la/rda sa'i ri nyal ba ye shes rgya masnu'i ming can gyis bris 11//
gis longs spyad na nyams rtogs 'phel byed kyi rdzas su 'gyur ba lta bu mngon no//zhes pa 'di ni phyi lo 1996zla 5 tshes 8 la/rda sa'i ri nyal ba ye shes rgya masnu'i ming can gyis bris 11//

༄༅༅//byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i dmigs skor stodacadagyi mgur dbyangs ngan na dam pa'i lad mo shes bya ba/sku ngur sdig 'bying ba'i brtabye zhugasacan//gsung bkan pa /byangs ris skya da/ 'gug/thugs brtsa ༷sa 'a kun gnya/rga du 'an//skyabs bslu mad gangs can ga la 'dud //skyabs /da kyi bka' sbyang rdo rje'i zlog/sbyal ban du marnyi/ sheng sgrub pa //rnamasadangalhastochags(yang //yid dang bas bad cing gal ba 'debs//rdza mthonapo /ngas kyi rtsergyan////'inagasastug gcanagaX/ sbyar ba'adabs//

gnas dben pa 'dzin pa'i nyam chung nga'i//rgyud spyan ras gzigs kyis byin gyis swār+shabs//dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi//khur bsnams pa'i byed po bla ma yis//ci mdzad pa kun kyang sku na tan gyi//gter 'ba' zhig mthong bar byin gyis rlobs//rdzas mi gtsang 'dus pa'i gong bu nyid//gcin phyi sa baX ba'i 'phrul 'kho ra bzhin//lus 'di ni dal 'byor rten sgyur te//chos rnal ma 'grub par byin gyis slobs//tshe ring mtha' lo ngo dgu bcu 'am//brgya thub paci) mi ni srid mtha' tsam//de zin la rkyen ngan ches mang phyir//tshe mi rtag dran par byin gyis swā bas//256

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/tshe 'phos pa'i 'og tu rnam shes kyi//rgyun chad par mi 'gyur dge sdig gi/rjes 'brang nas bde sdug myong dgos pas//gnas ngan skusgong dran par byin gyis swār+shabs//rang ngan 'gro'i gnas la 'jigs pa dang //gnas de las khyodab pa'i bslu med skyabs//mabo na bla ma mchodag gsum kho na las //skyabs gnyis 'dzin med par byin gyis swā bas//skyabs macor+shag gsum bsten nas bslab bya'i gzhi//las rgyu 'bras blang sngasar bcas mtshams las//bag med pa sku/gas kyi nyes byung na//41bas bzhi yis 'dag par byin gyis swār+shabs// skyid yang dag thar ba'i go 'phang zhig/sgrub ma thub srid pa'i phun snumags cater//257

'phral phan yang phyags su bslu ba'i phyir//don thar ba gnyer bar byin gyis rlobs//rang skye ba thog ma med pa'i phyir//sa 'di dang 'gro ba 'di dag gi/ris ma skyes bya ba gcig med pas//ma rnams la phan par byin gyis swār+shabs//nam skyes tshe mngal du 'khur ba dang //dus kun tu rang gi bde ba dag/khyad bsad nas gces par bskyangs pa'i ma'i//drin mtha' med dran par byin gyis swār+shabs//ma rang la tshangs dbang brgya byin gyi//dpal thob kyang phyags skyid ma byung phyir/ /da rang la bab pa'i ma yi drin //chodas lta nas gaXsgo bar byin gyis 〉〉bas//258

dge stong bse ru'i kher gtam/khams gsum gyis bsdus pa'i sems can rnams//gnyen mthar thug drin canaphag ma dang //pha la 11gas lan mang gyur pa yis//yid byams pas khyab par byin gyis swār+shabs//'phral sems can bde 'aX'i dpal josgob kyang //phugs nges legs bde dga' brgya phrag gis//yid tshim pa'i gtan bde med pa rnams// sems snying rjes 'gengs par byin gyis rlobs//ma sems can sdug bsngal sna snungags kyis//mnar mthong tshe ma yi bu gcig pu//me dong du lhung ltar mi bzod pa'i//rgyud lhag bsam 'khyong bar byin gyis rlobs//gzhan sdug bsngal kun las skyodab phyir du//rang byang chub chen 11 'josgob pa'i sems 259

sngags phar phyin gnyis ma'i gzhung shing bzhin//sems 'di nyid 'khyong bar byin gyis rlobs//sems 'di yis zin pa'i lus longs spyod//dus gsum gyi dge chosags 'bras bu bcas//dmigs med du btang ste sbyin pa'i tshogs// ring min du rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs//sngags byang sems so sor thar ba yi//gnang bkag gi khyad par legs thegegs nas//bcas rang gi kha na ma 11 bas//rgyud balha ga pa med par byin gyis 〉〉bas//sems khengs pa'i skye bo gzhan dag gis//skyon sna dgu brjod nas smod pa dang //dod dbyug pa so/gas kyis brdeg na yang //sems khro ba med par byin gyis rlobs//260

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/chodas yang dag rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang //ma 'bos ba'i dosnan du dka' ba brgyas//'bad dgos kyang brtson pa mi 'dor zhing //sems khyod bas 'jug par byin gyis 〉〉bas//sems bying rgod g.yeng ba kun bral ba'i//〈(ma ting 'dzin phyi nang thun 31nga gi/〈snas sgrub pa kun kyi gces cadar zhes//sgo 'di la 'jug par byin gyis rlobs//yul yul can tha snyad tshad grub 'di//gcig du bral 11gas kyis dpyad na ni// yid gtad sku thams cad 'jig byed pa'i//lha nga rten 'byung ho gas par byin gyis swā bas//rang smin byed pha rol phyin drug dang //gzhan gdul bya smin byed bsdu dacadas bzhi//261

chos tshang la ma nor 'di lta bur/ /dus rtag tu 'phrad par byin gyis rlobs//lam 'di la brten nas sangs rgyas kyi//sar bgrod pa bskal chen grangs med pa//gsum sogs su 'bad pa bsring dgos kyang //yid sgyid lug med par byin gyis rlobs/ /dus bskal chen du mar snungags gnyis kyi//lam zhugs tshe rang nyid skyo min yang //ma'i sdug bsngal bsal la ches brel na// sngags myur lam 'asnumal bar byin gyis swār+shabs//skyabs mthar thug lda je slob dpon gyis// rgyud smin byed dbang bzhi bskur ba nas//〈snam dam tshig 1/ga gi khams las lhag/ bsrung nus par bla mas byin gyis swār+shabs//262

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/dus lnga bdo'i tshe thung nad mang 'dir//mi tha mal bdag 'dras mdo sngags kyi//cesas zab mo nas pa'i skal ba 'di//gser g.yag tsam rnyed las lhag tu dga'//shar mdo khams yul gyi sprang 'khyam pa//ming ye shes rgya mtsho dges bya ba'i//lag mi dal sems kyi rnam rtog kun//gzugs sgrub ste gzhan la bstan pa lags//rgan rnams la nyams thesgogs phul ba min//gzhon rnams la blo bskyed sprad pa min//rang khro ni lam la goms phyir dang //sngon sbyangs pa mi brjed slad du lags//phyi 21 1998 4 4 la

༄༅༅//rang gi gnyen la gdams pa'i bslab bya tshigs su bcad pa ya rabs bgrod pa'i gyen lam dkar sngon nas bya ba/rgyal ba kun gyi brtse ba'i gter//gcig bsdus gangs ri'i zhing gi dpal//bla ma yongs kyi sprul ba'i gzhi//gangs can mgon wa'i zhabs la 'dud//khyed kyi bka' lung rdo rje'i tshig/'dzin skyong spel la snod rung gi//dul bya dam pa'i tshogs rnamasasku la// gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal //du/ gsum rlabs lazlobyungabayi// di'agasarungardulam/6tswas rabasa'ar//

༄༅༅//rang gi gnyen la gdams pa'i bslab bya tshigs su bcad pa ya rabs bgrod pa'i gyen lam dkar sngon nas bya ba/rgyal ba kun gyi brtse ba'i gter//gcig bsdus gangs ri'i zhing gi dpal//bla ma yongs kyi sprul ba'i gzhi//gangs can mgon wa'i zhabs la 'dud//khyed kyi bka' lung rdo rje'i tshig/'dzin skyong spel la snod rung gi//dul bya dam pa'i tshogs rnamasasku la// gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal //du/ gsum rlabs lazlobyungabayi// di'agasarungardulam/6tswas rabasa'ar//

dge skyong bse ru'i kher gtam/gzhan phan chos la rtag gzhol ba'i//skye bo rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//bkra shis tshig gis mdun bsus te//rang dang rang gi gnyen sogs kyis//chos shig bsgrub pa'i re ba'i ngang //thosgo sla'i ngag gis cadas shig 'debs//ma gcig lus kyi khang bzang du//'grim pas tshe 'di'i gnyen gyi gtso//cesas kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa ces//dam cor+shas masnur snum nga la ga〈snan//rgya gar chor+shas kyis bkug min zhing //rgya nag khrims kyis bskrad min par//rgyal ba'i dbang bor mjal 'dod kyi//'dun pas bsgyur te sa 'dir 'byor//265

'phags yul 'byor nas da bar du//mngon lkog kun na chos dang nor//bsgrubs skud ges bya ma mchis par//lo ngo bco lnga phal cher thal /da ni de 'dra'i g.yeng ba'i ngang /lo 'ga' thal na 'chi ba zhes//shog twa rnyod 44gas rung zhinagashin rje yong ba gdon mi za//thal skya rlung gis balha/da pa'i gnas//gzhob dri 'thul ba'i dur khyod du//rang phung sreg pa'i du ba'i sprin / /mkha' la 'phyur tshe tshar ba nyid//yang ra ngasam d+ku ri wa'i yang ri kyibya thend ltogs pa'i kha 'thab kyis//266

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/pags bshus lhu tshigs gtor ba'i tshe/bosangs skud ges pa'i bkur tshig tsam//'das po de yi yo byad ces//bkram pa kun gyis 〈snar zhing 'dems/ /dmang ba'i rin thothong 'bebs pa na//rang nyid ming gi lhag mar gyur//skad cig mi sdod 'chi bdag gi/phyogs su bskyod pa'i lus po 'di//rtag 'acirngon bsam pa brtan na yang // rang 'dod yin gyi gnas lugs min//de 'dra'i rkyen ngan ma byung sngon/ /tshe lhag ci yod 'jig rten gzhan//phan pa'i cesas shig bsgrub pa'i thabs//ngas kyang bsam la khyed kyang 11mas//267

'phral phugs kun tu bde ba'i thabs//'ba' zhig lhadan pa'i bla ma rnams// spangs 〉tegs snyu gas pa'i sangs rgyas su//ngas kyang ba〈snam la khyed kyang lhurtoms//rnyed par dka' zhing rnyed gyur na//'phral phyags phan bde sgrub pa'i lus//ma shor sngon la snying bo zhig/ngas kyang len la khyed kyang longs// stobs chen 'bum gyis mi ldog pa'i//'jigs rung 'chi ba ma byung sngon//tshe rabs phyi mar phan pa'i cesas//ngas kyang bsgrub la khyed kyang sgrubs//tsha grang bkres 〈snam glen lkugs kyi//sdug bsngal 'bar ba'i bdag nyid can//268

'phral phugs kun tu bde ba'i thabs//'ba' zhig lhadan pa'i bla ma rnams// spangs 〉tegs snyu gas pa'i sangs rgyas su//ngas kyang ba〈snam la khyed kyang lhurtoms//rnyed par dka' zhing rnyed gyur na//'phral phyags phan bde sgrub pa'i lus//ma shor sngon la snying bo zhig/ngas kyang len la khyed kyang longs// stobs chen 'bum gyis mi ldog pa'i//'jigs rung 'chi ba ma byung sngon//tshe rabs phyi mar phan pa'i cesas//ngas kyang bsgrub la khyed kyang sgrubs//tsha grang bkres 〈snam glen lkugs kyi//sdug bsngal 'bar ba'i bdag nyid can//268

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/ngan 11nga gsum gyi ngang tshul rnams//ngas kyang bsam la khyed kyang lhasams//bde ba ma lus sgrub pa dang // sdug bsdal mtha' dag sel ba'i mabo na//rtag tu skyabs gsum spyi gtsug tu//ngas kyang bkur la khyed kyang bkur//skyabs bsten pa yi bslab pa'i gzhi//11 1sna ba dang man ngag las//byung ba ji snyed mchis pa kun//ngas kyang bslab la khyed kyang 〉tebs//khyad par nang ba'i lta ba'i gtso//dge sdig 'bras bu bde sdug gi/ tshor ba myong phyir blang dor la//ngas kyang gzab la khyed kyang gaXthobs//269

gzhan phan dam 〉sgros sgrub pa'i rten//rnam smin yon tan brgyad ldan lus//sgrub byed thabs bzang ba11da nams chosags//ngas kyang gsag la khyed kyang 11ga/྅ton smadangs dbang sku(nga bag med pas// nyes ltung sngar bsags 'khyod pa dang //phyis 'byung rab tu sdom sems ngang //ngas kyang bshag la khyed kyang sku(gas//rab tu byung nas 'chor ba'i thabs//nad pa nad ma'i skyabs rten dang //shi bo shi mo'i bsngo rten dkor//ngas kyang sbyang la khyed kyang sbyongs//de ltar rgyun du blang dor gyi//'jug ldog thabs la brtson gyur na//270

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/phyi mar bde 'gro'i 'jig rten du/ /nga rang skye la khyed rang yang //cadan kyang malnga ris 'jig rten gyi//phun snumags 'phen pa zad gyur na//slar yang ngan snu nga gnas dag tu//nga rang lhung la khyed rang yang //de bas khams gsum sdug bsdal dang //kun 'byung ma lus zad pa'i cha//rang bde thar ba'i rgyal sa cher//ngas kyang sgyu na la khyed kyang lhugan//drin can mtha' dag yal 11ra te/ /rang nyid zhi g.yeng 'os min phyir//gzhan phan 'ba' zhig bya dka' yang //ngas kyang sgyu na la khyed kyang spyodan//271

byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de//phyin drug bsdu bzhi'i bslab chen 17da//bgrang yas bskal bar bsgrub bya'i cesas//ngas kyang smon la khyed kyang smon//mdo lugs bde gshegs sgrub pa'i yun//sems can mnar la brtse gzigs na//tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i sngags//ngas kyang smon la khyed kyang smon//'bras bu sku bzhi'i bdag nyid can//lhun grub rgyun mi chad pa yi//'phrin las 'bo1 khams khyab pa'i mabosan//ngas kyang smon la khyed kyang smon//gsar rnying chos dang g.yung drung bon//lta grub ming 'dogs tha dad kyang // 272

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/'tshe med zhi ba nyid yin pas//ngas kyang brtsil khyed kyang rtsis//gangs ljongs khyon kun khyab pa'i bod//〈snal gsum gces 'bangs sa ya drug/sha rus khrag rgyun gcig yin pas// ngas kyang bkur la khyed kyang bkur//rang gi mi la brtseb dang //gzhan gyi mi la bkur ba gnyis//rang gzhan bde ba'i rgyu yin pas//ngas kyang bya la khyed kyang byos//dge ba phra rags gang bsgrubs kun//rgyal dbang 'a〈snar bcas zhabs brtan dang // bzhed don rgya zhi bod 'grig phyir//ngas kyang bsngo la khyed kyang sngos//273

a ma 'das nas 'o( mang sku1nga //a pha bosangs nas sbas 'ga' thal//gar skyes bde dang 'phrad pa'i phyir//ngas kyang bsngo la khyed kyang sngos//rang dang rang la 'brel thogs kun//dal ba'i rten thob bla ma dang //'phrad cing chos dang mjal ba'i phyir//ngas kyang bsngo la khyed kyang sngos//gzhan yang sa 'dir 'byor ba'i gnyen//'phags pa 'chos dang tshe brtan 11gas/ / skye ba gzhan du phan pa yi//chos kyi nyams len gong bzhin mjo da//mi che'i mdun lam 'aces ba'i thabs//rang phan kho na'i byed thabs kyis//274

dge spyong bsoru'i kher gtam/gzhan maboto 〈(ra ba ma yin par//rang gzhan mnyam pa ba1(ma par mjodi//mjo la phrag sngagag bsam pa 〈snangs//mnyam la 'gran pa'i kun slong dor// dman la brnyas bcos zur za spongs//kun la btang stoms bsgom par mdzod//rang nyid gnas pa'i khor yug gi/g.yas gasku1na rgyab mdun gnas dag tu//skye thotho gang zhig gnas 'cha' ba// kun la bsam rjesnar gus par mjo da/ /'on kyang snyigs lnga'i dus mtha' 'dir//rgyus med mi dang 'a〈snags pa na//bzang bzang lta bus bslu 'gyur bas//rtag tu de la bag zon mdzod//275

dge spyong bsoru'i kher gtam/gzhan maboto 〈(ra ba ma yin par//rang gzhan mnyam pa ba1(ma par mjodi//mjo la phrag sngagag bsam pa 〈snangs//mnyam la 'gran pa'i kun slong dor// dman la brnyas bcos zur za spongs//kun la btang stoms bsgom par mdzod//rang nyid gnas pa'i khor yug gi/g.yas gasku1na rgyab mdun gnas dag tu//skye thotho gang zhig gnas 'cha' ba// kun la bsam rjesnar gus par mjo da/ /'on kyang snyigs lnga'i dus mtha' 'dir//rgyus med mi dang 'a〈snags pa na//bzang bzang lta bus bslu 'gyur bas//rtag tu de la bag zon mdzod//275

sdig grogs zhes pa re sde dang //to / swār+shan 〈snan pa ma mchis te//'bo gas na dge 'grib sdig 'phel gang //sdig cadags yin pas spang par ma17da//gces shing phangs pa'i 'dzum dkar gyis//rtsed dga'i grogs byed phugs su rang //lugs gnyis lam bzang 'bonag byed gang //sdig grogs yin pas spang bar mdzod//masngasar na rtag tu lugs gnyis las//legs pa'i lam du 'jug pa dang //nyes 'byung lam las phyir sdog ste/ /ya rabs rjes su 'brang bar mdzod//rab byed 'di ni rang nyid kyi//nye du dag la gdams pa las//276

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/gzhan dag chothos la bskul ba'i phyir//man ngag tshigs su bcad pa min//'phags yul 'a〈snar ba'i gnyen nye lags//bdag gi brang ga'i sgo phyes ste// snying gi gur khang phyir bslags kyang //'di las lhag pa'i bslab bya dkon//bdag sogs deng nas tshe rabs kun//spyan ras gzigs kyi mdun sa ru//theg chen thosnes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun//rtag tu longs su spyod gyur cig/mkhas pa'i gral du ma tshud cing //blun wa'i khrod du ma bsdad par//mkhan min blun min bya bral ba//mdzod dge ye shes rgya mtshos bris//277
zhes pa 'di ni sring mo dam chos mtsho mos bskul te/ phyi lo 2003 zla 12 tshes 10 nas mabosgo btsugs te tshes 13 nyin mjug bsdus so//
zhes pa 'di ni sring mo dam chos mtsho mos bskul te/ phyi lo 2003 zla 12 tshes 10 nas mabosgo btsugs te tshes 13 nyin mjug bsdus so//

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/༄༅༅// bod chen po'i mi rigs dang rgyal rabs rig gzhung dang 'brel ba'i smon lam spun zla ngo sprod kyi mdzub ston zhes bya ba/brtsechen gter gyur 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs//lhun grub 'phrin las mnga' brnyes 'phags ma'i zhabs//kha ba can pa'i rigs kyi myu gu'i rgyud//thog ma'i byed po mchog la phyag 'tshal lo sa 'dzin kha bas g.yogs pa'i 'jig rten du// smra shes don go thod kyi 'gro ba'i rgyud//thog mar byung ba'i khungs btsun lo rgyus ltar//smon lam tshig gis brgyan te bajodi par bya//spyan ras gzigs dang rgyal yum sgrol ma yi//sprul ba bye ba phrag brgyas 'jig rten kun//279

khyab pa dag las bod yul rtsed thang du//bod kyi pha ma'i 'byung khungs bcad kyis nyon//ljon shing yal gar rtsen pa'i spre'u dang //ri wa'i gseb na yib pa'i brag srin gnyis//dga' 'dus gzhu gu med pa'i phru gu rnams//rang dbang chos 'byor rgyas pa'i dpal 'thob shog/spre'u brag srin rgyud las mched pa yi//sha rus gcig pa'i spun zla ngo ma dang //bho kha rtsed thang gzhi yi rtsed grogs kyi//brtsesems nam yang ltod pa med par shog/spre'u'i bu rnams 'tsho bas phongs gyur nas//lha la ga11la bas sa 11na btab pa las//ma ltosas 'bras smin rjod pa'i 'asnu bosags kyi//brtse dung nam yang stod pa med par shog/280

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/ma rgan brag cigen brang gi nu ma las//'tsho bcud cad ma 'thung ba'i sha rus rgyun//gcig pa'i sa ya drug gi 1snad 'bangs rnams//phan tshun spyan bcenganyams pa med par lhasnag/spu dang mjug ma yal ba'i sprel phrug rnams//gangs ༄/ngas cadan kun khyab pas rim bzhin du//'bru rnams ba〉da zhing rtsam pa 'thag pa yi//rtsam gzan spun zla'i brtsedung 'phel bar shog/ drang wa'i mda' dang 'khyog pa'i gzhu sdeb ste//ri thang nags la 'cha' ba'i casag chags khyu//bsad de sha khrag khyod cing lpags thodas can//gdong dmar rnams la rang sa dbang bar shog/rta 〉ted btsan gyis thul te bsnyasnan pa dang //'thegeng khyu dbang gis bsdus nas 1sgo phyugs byas//281

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/ma rgan brag cigen brang gi nu ma las//'tsho bcud cad ma 'thung ba'i sha rus rgyun//gcig pa'i sa ya drug gi 1snad 'bangs rnams//phan tshun spyan bcenganyams pa med par lhasnag/spu dang mjug ma yal ba'i sprel phrug rnams//gangs ༄/ngas cadan kun khyab pas rim bzhin du//'bru rnams ba〉da zhing rtsam pa 'thag pa yi//rtsam gzan spun zla'i brtsedung 'phel bar shog/ drang wa'i mda' dang 'khyog pa'i gzhu sdeb ste//ri thang nags la 'cha' ba'i casag chags khyu//bsad de sha khrag khyod cing lpags thodas can//gdong dmar rnams la rang sa dbang bar shog/rta 〉ted btsan gyis thul te bsnyasnan pa dang //'thegeng khyu dbang gis bsdus nas 1sgo phyugs byas//281

'brog sde chen wa'i rgyud las byung ba yi//bod la 'brog sa myur du 'thob par shog/dmar mchothod zas la rtag tu blosal ba yi//bdud po khyab pa lag ring la sogs par//skyabs 'dzin byed wa'i rgyud las byung ba'i wad//bdud las rgyal ba'i dpa' mdzangs 'alnga ba par thodag/gshen rab 〈snan pas bdud khyab lag ring btul//bdud tshogs dga' ba'i sha khrag galta ra ma'i tshab//dkar zas zan gyis mchodi pa'i g.yung 1snan las// brgyud pa'i bod la bde dga'i dpal 'thob shog/g.yung drung nam mkha' snang ba'i maro/ga can gyis//gshen rab 11na gyi bstan pas dbang bskur te//bon lugs kho nar 'dzin pa'i rgyud pa las//byung ba'i bod la bde dga'i dpal thob shog/282

dge spyong ba ru'i kher gtam/gnya 'a khri btsan nas josna ri snyan btsan bar//g.yung bon kho nas thod khams skyong ba na//gzungs sngags 'khor lo g.yon du sgor ba las//brgyud pa'i thod la bde dga'i dpal 'thob shog/rgyal bstan dar ba'i snga ltas rtags byung nas//rgyal rabs lnga la gzungs sngags 'khor lo rnams//g.yas g.yon gang bskor rung ba'i chos bon lugs//'dres ma'i rgyud 'dzin bod la bde 'thob shog/chor+shas rgyal dbu gnyis can nas rwa can bar//rgyal bstan dar zhing mtha' bzhi'i rgyal khab kun//bka' tshig phra sna1sa 'dar ba'i rigs rgyud las//byung ba'i thod 'bangs bde dga'i dpal 'thob shog/btsan por thod mda' sprad nas sa skya'i bar//chor+shas nyams chab srid rgyud nas wade 'bangs rnams// 283

skyabs med maboton med mi rabs brgyud pa las//byung ba'i thod 'bangs bde dga'i dpal 'thob shog/wad mthosnen sa skya'i srid nas gtsang pa'i bar//rgyal pham 11ba sku(ra 'dres pas wade 'bangs rnams//bde sdug res snunas myangs pa'i rgyud pa las//bod 'bangs dga' ston bde bas 'tsho bar shog/dga' ldan 'o/ brang 〈snags las rnam rgyal gzhung //btsugs te rang dbang yun ring spyad pa'i mthar//dmar dmag dpung gis gtor ba'i gtso gzhung dmangs //slar yang gangs ri'i ljongs su 'dzom par shog/ston pa gcig gi bstan pa'i rjes 'jug pa//rgya wad ce sa mthun shosags kyi 'du shes kyis//'dzam gling zhi bde'i dmigs dpe bzang tho'i lam//ston pa'i byed po mchog tu 'gyur bar shog/284

skyabs med maboton med mi rabs brgyud pa las//byung ba'i thod 'bangs bde dga'i dpal 'thob shog/wad mthosnen sa skya'i srid nas gtsang pa'i bar//rgyal pham 11ba sku(ra 'dres pas wade 'bangs rnams//bde sdug res snunas myangs pa'i rgyud pa las//bod 'bangs dga' ston bde bas 'tsho bar shog/dga' ldan 'o/ brang 〈snags las rnam rgyal gzhung //btsugs te rang dbang yun ring spyad pa'i mthar//dmar dmag dpung gis gtor ba'i gtso gzhung dmangs //slar yang gangs ri'i ljongs su 'dzom par shog/ston pa gcig gi bstan pa'i rjes 'jug pa//rgya wad ce sa mthun shosags kyi 'du shes kyis//'dzam gling zhi bde'i dmigs dpe bzang tho'i lam//ston pa'i byed po mchog tu 'gyur bar shog/284

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/g.yung drung bon dang gsar rnying bstan 'dzin gyis//byung zin cadags ris ngan pa'i 'od rgyus gtam//snga lhu nga mi byed ma cadangs mdun lam bzang //'chodal ba'i cadas kha gcig tu gleng bar swā ga/cesas dang rig pa'i gnas la mkhas pa dang //nor dang dpa' ngar ldan pa re re la//gangs ljongs khyod bcud skyob pa'i mthu med pas//kun gyis rang gzhung dpung rogs 'dzin par shog/'di brtsams dge bas 11da rigs thams cad kyis//rang rigs phan tshun sha rus gcig pa'i spun//'khrul med mthong ste sngon chad ma 'dris kyang //phrad pa'i mode la bcengabs 'tham gyur cig/11da sngaṭan bsgrub pa'i bsam pa 'phel na yang //rjodar bas ma ༄ gas dha sa'i ri gseb nas//285

smon pa'i tshig gi ri mo bris pa 'di/ /gangs ljongs gzhon nu'i thugs la 'jags par shog/'jam wa'i spu yis lus la ma g.yogs shing //mjug ma ring bo 'a'o/ngas la ma mchis par//pha rgyud nags kyi gar mkhan las byung ba'i//spre'u'i yang tsha ye shes rgya mtshos bris//phyi so1 2003 9 8 la/

ra༅༅// phyogs ris med pa'i skyes chen rnams la ched du brtsod pa byams brtsegangs ljongs kun khyab ces bya ba/ lung rtogs yon tan gter gyis rab lci ba//do snga'i sa gzhis theg par dka' na yang //bdag khra'i pad+ma'i 'dab 'phreng ma ldem par//ge sar gdan bzhugs phyag na pad+mor 'dud//khyed kyi bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i skyes 'phags rnams//mabeshan khyodi bzhugs pa'i bdag khra'i chu skyes kyi//'dab ma'i gdan du spyan drangs de dag kun//'chi med tshe yi sgrub par ci'i mi brtson/ /bstan la phyogs ris med pa'i bstan 'dzin dang //chol kha'i 'then 'khyer med pa'i 'go 'dzin dpon//287

ra༅༅// phyogs ris med pa'i skyes chen rnams la ched du brtsod pa byams brtsegangs ljongs kun khyab ces bya ba/ lung rtogs yon tan gter gyis rab lci ba//do snga'i sa gzhis theg par dka' na yang //bdag khra'i pad+ma'i 'dab 'phreng ma ldem par//ge sar gdan bzhugs phyag na pad+mor 'dud//khyed kyi bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i skyes 'phags rnams//mabeshan khyodi bzhugs pa'i bdag khra'i chu skyes kyi//'dab ma'i gdan du spyan drangs de dag kun//'chi med tshe yi sgrub par ci'i mi brtson/ /bstan la phyogs ris med pa'i bstan 'dzin dang //chol kha'i 'then 'khyer med pa'i 'go 'dzin dpon//287

sngon dang da ltar gang na su bzhugs la//bsngags brjod me tog sna tshogs spel la spro//'phags pa'i yul nas lha gcig jo bo je//spyan drangs wade 'bangs spyi la phan pa'i cesas//zhu mdzad mnga' ris sa skyong byang chub cad//rjes su dran te bsngags pa'i me tog 'bul//shar gling dbang sgyur hor rgyal bka' lung gis//cesas lugs sa skya 〈sna na legs bsgrags kyang // ris med rgyal bstan bkur ba'i mār+shas rgyal 'phags//rjes su dran te bsngags pa'i metog 'bul//g.yung 11na bstan las grub pa brnyes na yang //zhi byed man ngag bzhes te tshe gcig la//zung 'jug sku brnyes khro tshang 'brug lha rje//rjes su dran te bsngags pa'i me tog 'bul/ /288

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/gangs can 1snangs kyi gsar rnying mkhas chen kun//bsam khyodar dag pas bsten te maro/ rgyud gzhung / /ma lus sbyangs pa mthar phyin thosang kha ba//rjes su dran te bsngags pa'i me tog 'bul//babosad dka' chu wa'i 'jigs las lha/ba pa'i thabs//lcags zam gru gzings bskrun pas drin po che// zla bral grub dbang thang lha/nga rgyal wa'i zhabs//rjes su dran te bsngags pa'i me tog 'bul//'jam mabo|na rgyal ba gnyis pa'i sras kyi gathem/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang ngur smrig gar mdzad pa//ris med bstan 'dzin dge 'dun grub pa'i zhabs//rjes su dran te bsngags pa'i me tog 'bul//dge ldan bstan pa'i khur chen bzhes dang lhan//phyag rdzogs zhi byed gsal stong 'dzin med gzhung //289

lung rigs nyams sgyu1nga lhur bzhes cesas rgyan zhabs// rjes su dran te bsngags pa'i me tog 'bul//gangs lhu ngas ma lus rgyal dar gcig gi 'og /'jug pa'i byed po ris med bstan pa'i bdag/brtse chen gter gyur gong sa 7lnga ba'i zhabs//rjes su dran te bsngags pa'i me tog 'bul//gsang chen snga 'gyur bstan pa'i mnga' bdag che//sa dge bka' brgyud bstan la gus pa can//mkhas grub zhabs dkar snumags drug ra nga bosal rje// rjes su dran te bsngags pa'i me tog 'bul//dmar phyogs me lce 'bar ba gzigs pa na//gangs ljongs lugs gnyis nyams la nyen mthong ste// sna tshogs thabs mdzad gong sa 7bcu gsum pa//rjes su dran te bsngags pa'i me tog 'bul//290

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/dge ldan bstan dang gsang chen snga 'gyur lugs//cig car 'dzin pa bkra shis g.yas 'khyil gyi//skyabs mabedan lnga pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhabs//rjes su dran te bsngags pa'i me tog 'bul//gangs swā/ngas lugs gnyis nyams la ma baX da nas// rgyal ba'i dbang wa'i zhabs brtan 11na pa'i mthu//bdar ba'i spyan yangs mkhyen brtse dbang wa'i zhabs//rjes su dran te bsngags pa'i me tog 'bul//bod spyi'i sdug bsngal sel phyir yig 'bru khri//bdun gyi snyan zhus nyes te batho na bcug kyang //gangs ljongs bde ster paṇa chen bcu ba'i zhabs//rjes du dran te bsngags pa'i me tog 'bul//rgyal ba'i bstan dang mu stegs gzhung lugs kun//gling 'dir zhi bde 'dren pa'i grogs sgyur bas//291

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/dge ldan bstan dang gsang chen snga 'gyur lugs//cig car 'dzin pa bkra shis g.yas 'khyil gyi//skyabs mabedan lnga pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhabs//rjes su dran te bsngags pa'i me tog 'bul//gangs swā/ngas lugs gnyis nyams la ma baX da nas// rgyal ba'i dbang wa'i zhabs brtan 11na pa'i mthu//bdar ba'i spyan yangs mkhyen brtse dbang wa'i zhabs//rjes su dran te bsngags pa'i me tog 'bul//bod spyi'i sdug bsngal sel phyir yig 'bru khri//bdun gyi snyan zhus nyes te batho na bcug kyang //gangs ljongs bde ster paṇa chen bcu ba'i zhabs//rjes du dran te bsngags pa'i me tog 'bul//rgyal ba'i bstan dang mu stegs gzhung lugs kun//gling 'dir zhi bde 'dren pa'i grogs sgyur bas//291

zhi bde'i ded dasngo na mtshan snyan khyab pa'i mabo na//dngos su gus te bsngags pa'i me tog 'bul//skyabs mabo|na rgyal bas gnang ba'i mang gatho'i lam//bo/ma pa dang lnga ra mang gis spyi mo sa dawa na// mang bkur mi dbang bka' khri zam gasnga nga zhabs//dngos su gus te bsngags pa'i me tog 'bul//drag wa'i srid lugs ser rlung 'tshub pa'i khrod//ris med bstan pa'i lo 'bras skyong mdzad pa//kun khyab 'phrin las mnga' brnyes lha ri ba/ /rgyang nas gus te bsngags pa'i me do/ga 'bul//skyabs mabo na rgyal ba'i bka' lung lhur bzhes te//gces srog 'dzem med dpa' bo dge ldan pa'i//khri rabs brgya ba sdus bzang nyi ma'i zhabs//rgyang nas gus te bsngags pa'i me lta ga 'bul/ / 292

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/gangs can mabo na wa'i rjes su mthodan lhu gas shing //gsar rnying bstan pa'i yang snying byang chub pa//shākya'i dge bsnyen mkhas mchodzig bdag khri'i zhabs//rgyang nas gus te bsngags pa'i me tog 'bul//gsang chen snga 'gyur bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog/rgyal ba'i dbang dang ris med bstan la gus// grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma chodar bu'i zhabs//rgyang nas gus te bsngags pa'i me tog 'bul//gangs ljongs snod bcud legs su sgrub pa'i thabs//chig sgril gzhung lam skrun la macadan cadags pa'i//mkhyen rab zla med macesag sprul rkarma'i zhabs//rgyang nas gus te bsngags pa'i me tog 'bul//mdor nu sa dge bka' rnying g.yung bon gyi//mace ga sprul gahoston nu nyi ma'i cadad rlabs kyis//293

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/gangs can mabo na wa'i rjes su mthodan lhu gas shing //gsar rnying bstan pa'i yang snying byang chub pa//shākya'i dge bsnyen mkhas mchodzig bdag khri'i zhabs//rgyang nas gus te bsngags pa'i me tog 'bul//gsang chen snga 'gyur bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog/rgyal ba'i dbang dang ris med bstan la gus// grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma chodar bu'i zhabs//rgyang nas gus te bsngags pa'i me tog 'bul//gangs ljongs snod bcud legs su sgrub pa'i thabs//chig sgril gzhung lam skrun la macadan cadags pa'i//mkhyen rab zla med macesag sprul rkarma'i zhabs//rgyang nas gus te bsngags pa'i me tog 'bul//mdor nu sa dge bka' rnying g.yung bon gyi//mace ga sprul gahoston nu nyi ma'i cadad rlabs kyis//293

bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i pad tshal rgyas byed na//gcadan sprul mo ngas la bsngags pa'i melta ga 'bul//rgyal srid 'a〈snar sku(sa sgyur pa'i cetes rgyal ches//ris med dpar khang sde dge'i yul dbus su//skrun pa'i bstan pa tshe ring mtshan can malcesgrog/rjes su dran te bsngags pa'i me tog 'bul/ /cesas rgyal sku1 paṇa kun kyis dka' ba brgyas//bsgrubs pa'i bka' dang bstan bather+shas ma lus pa//dpar du bskrun pa'i mdzad rje rlabs sngo che//rjes su dran te bsngags pa'i me tog 'bul//sa dge bka' rnying g.yung drung bon sogs kyi//mkhas dgus mdzad pa'i gsung rab yod do cog/ dpar du skrun tshe phyogs ris med pa de// rjes su dran te bsngags pa'i metog 'bul//294

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/dbus gtsang mdo stod mdo smad gangs ljongs spyi'i//mkhas sku thodag gi gsung rab dpar skrun tshe//chol kha'i 'then 'khyer med pa'i spyi snyoms de//rjes su dran te bsngags pa'i me tog 'bul//dpar shing mi rabs mang du brtan pa'i phyir//yig mig zab tu ci bathertes gser phye yis//gzhal te yon du phul ba'i gtong phod de//rjes su dran te bsngags pa'i me tog 'bul//drag spyod dmar wa'i gzhung gi khrims 'og nas//rang dbang 'thob tu gces lus mer sbar te//snyungad len dpa' ྅pe thub bstan dacadas grub masnu ga /rjes su dran te bsngags pa'i me tog 'bul//cadad kyi rang dbang rigs lam khe na yis//brtsad kyang tang gis drag chas lag bstar te// 295

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/dbus gtsang mdo stod mdo smad gangs ljongs spyi'i//mkhas sku thodag gi gsung rab dpar skrun tshe//chol kha'i 'then 'khyer med pa'i spyi snyoms de//rjes su dran te bsngags pa'i me tog 'bul//dpar shing mi rabs mang du brtan pa'i phyir//yig mig zab tu ci bathertes gser phye yis//gzhal te yon du phul ba'i gtong phod de//rjes su dran te bsngags pa'i me tog 'bul//drag spyod dmar wa'i gzhung gi khrims 'og nas//rang dbang 'thob tu gces lus mer sbar te//snyungad len dpa' ྅pe thub bstan dacadas grub masnu ga /rjes su dran te bsngags pa'i me tog 'bul//cadad kyi rang dbang rigs lam khe na yis//brtsad kyang tang gis drag chas lag bstar te// 295

klad pa gtor ba'i blo bzang don 'grub mchog/rjes su dran te mya ngan mig chu 'alnga ra/ /rang btsan mang du bsgrags kyang thod 'bangs la//bo ba ma chodab phyi rabs bskul ba'i phyir//rang srog gcod pa'i dpa' bo don 'grub rgyal//rjes su dran te dga' skyo zung du 'brel//mdodar na phyogs ris med pa'i chos pa dang //'then 'khyer med pa'i dpon dang dpa' bo rnams//bstod tshig 'di la ming khyodar ma mchis kyang //don gyi bsngags brjod me tog yang yang 'bul//phyogs ris med pa'i chos pa bya 'dod na// gsar rnying gsung rab kun kyi rtsa ba'i khungs//〈snan pa thub pa'i dbang 11ra thug skusgod pa//brgyud rim 'o/ rgyus gzhung la gzigs dbo/sa lags//296

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/'then 'khyer med pa'i dpon po bya 'dod na//rang gi 'byung khungs 'o/ rgyus las byung ba'i//bod 'bangs yongs la snying rje sgom pa rab//de min mi rigs ring lugs cis kyang dbo sa//g.yas gasku1na rgyab mdun kun la mi mthun par//chags sdang ngang nas bstan pa 'dzin pa las// dkar 'jam lus phra'i rjes su snyeg dang lhan//'asnga da pa 'phel ba'i chang gis bzi na legs/ /klad rnying ri bo nam mkha'i dbyings su bsnyegs//mkhreg bzung brag gi zur kha phyi la thon//bde skyid gzhung lam gtor ba'i rbab rdo can//gang sku da gnas der gdod nas 'dzem na legs//'dzam gling go la zlum po 'di'i steng na//sku/ngas sgyu gas thub bstan 'dzin pa wad las med//297

21da la rigs mthun rgyal khab gcig las med//gcig wa'i bstan 'dzin sku ngas bkur nga las daspo na//phyi yi dpal 'byor spel ba'i tshan rig pa//zla med ngo mtshar yul du 'dzin byed na//nang gi sems khams bde ba'i 11ba ༄rten pa// ris med bstan 'dzin bsngags pa smos ci dgos//chos shig sgrub par 'dod pa gang zhig gis//phyogs ris 'byed pa'i dus skabs yol ba dang //phan tshun mthun pa sgrub pa'i dus 'bo ru//bslebs pa macor+shag dman kun kyis mkhyen dbotos lags//gangs ljongs phung la sbyor ba'i dgra gcig pu//༷(gas ris gasngagen gyis thugs rgyud ma sbags par/ /thodad 'bangs spyi la brtse ba'i dam pa rnams//bsngags pa'i go skabs rnyed pa bdag yid dga'//298

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/skyabs mthosnan rgyal ba'i thugs rje nyin byed las//ris med bstan pa'i sod stong spros pa'i mod//cadags ris mun pa sangs te snu sa kun gyi//khor yug cung mjo nga ye shes rgya mtshos bris//phyi 61 2003 9 20 la bris/

༄༅//bod kyi sod bcud ma mthong ba'i byes 'khrungs gzhon na nu rnams la gangs ljongs ngo sprod gangs dkar 'phreng mdzes zhes bya ba/gnas rdo je gdan gyi byang phyogs na//mtha' gangs ris lha/ra ba'i zhing khams kyi// mgon spyan ras gzigs dbang ngur smrig can//rje gangs can mgon wa'i zhabs la 'dud//rje khyed kyis gnang ba'i mang gtso'i lam//gom dang po bgrod pa mang mos kyi//bod spyi yongs mtshon pa mang gtso'i dpon//rje mkhas mchog zam gdong zhabs la'ang gus//bod rang dbang bde ba slar gso'i phyir//rtsalayodagubaton te /sdu srid kyi//

༄༅//bod kyi sod bcud ma mthong ba'i byes 'khrungs gzhon na nu rnams la gangs ljongs ngo sprod gangs dkar 'phreng mdzes zhes bya ba/gnas rdo je gdan gyi byang phyogs na//mtha' gangs ris lha/ra ba'i zhing khams kyi// mgon spyan ras gzigs dbang ngur smrig can//rje gangs can mgon wa'i zhabs la 'dud//rje khyed kyis gnang ba'i mang gtso'i lam//gom dang po bgrod pa mang mos kyi//bod spyi yongs mtshon pa mang gtso'i dpon//rje mkhas mchog zam gdong zhabs la'ang gus//bod rang dbang bde ba slar gso'i phyir//rtsalayodagubaton te /sdu srid kyi//

dge sbyong bse nu'i kher gtam/las rnam mang sgrub pa'i ser skya kun//drin yang yang dran cad lhag bsam can//don de ltar yin yang deng gi dus/11da gcodan nu 'ga' yis rang gi skad//gatho ra mi 'dzin phyi skad 'ba' zhig la//dbu 'khor ba re zhig bzlog pa'i phyir//bod rang gi snod bcud khor yug kun//bu gzhon byis rnams la ngo sprad de//de blangs te skyong ba'i nyin mo nas//bod rang skad bzang ba gdam par bya// dbyibs 'jong zlum can gyi 'dzam gling gi/gling bdun gyi ya gyal e sha ya'i//yul dbus su gnas pa'i gangs can par// sa rgya khyodan ci yod 'chad kyis nyon// 301

shar e sha ya yi sa cha las//khyon brgya cho drug tsam rang cag gi/sa yin par bshad pa'i mdzes ljongs de//lnga da gachodan nu rnams kyi rten gzhi yin//bod rang gi khor yug yongs kyi khyon//dbyibs gru bzhi can gyi spyi le grangs//'bum nyi shu rtsalnga yod pa rnams/ /bod gzhon nu rnams kyi 'khor sa yin//bod chen wa'i yul gyi brgya cha yi//grangs bdun cu rtswa sa'i studan kun na/ /phyugs rta nor lug sogs yongs kyi grangs//bsgyuthoms sa ya bdun cu skusnad par bshad//bod sa chen khor yug 'di yi mtha'/yul rgyal khab gzhan dang 'brel ba'i mtshams//302

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/dus kun tu kha bas gasku1gas pa yi//gangs lhun 11 bzhi yis mtshan nas sku1da/ /thosned rgya nag gnyis kyi sa mtshams su//dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i pho brang che/ /gnas rong btsan kha ba dkar po zhes//shel mchod rten gsar du bzhengs 'dra yod// 11da 'brug pa gnyis kyi sa mtshams su// lha mkha' 'gro sprin ltar 'khor ba'i gnas//lto phag ri'i jo mo lha ri zhes//seng dkar mo gnam la mchong 'dra yod//11da bal 11 gnyis kyi sa mtshams su//lha tshe ring mched lnga'i pho brang che//gangs ma༄1na 11 mjosnan mthing rgyal snu/ zhes//dar dkar po gyen la bslangs 'dra yod//303

11da shin cang gnyis kyi sa mtshams su//lha 'khor 'das kun gyi 'khor sa che//gangs dkar sngo lhu gas las rnam rgyal zhes//dngul dkar wa'i maṇ+ḍal phul 'dra yod//gangs chen 11 bzhi yi bar mtshams na/ /mtha' gzhan dang 'brel ba'i gangs ri dang //rdza ma11na lnga'i sa rtags mang na yang //sa rgya khyon che bas ngas ma rtogs//sngon chos rgyal rnams kyis dbang ba'i sa//mtha' gang yin 'o/ rgyus smra ba 'ga'i//zhal bsngogs kyang sa mtshams 'di 'o zhes//thag chodad pa'i mi la nga ma thug/gangs lhun wa'i 'phreng bas bskor ba'i yul//11da kha ba can gyi zhing khams kyi//304

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/sa'i dbyibs dang chu tho'i bzhur phyogs dang // lam ci sku da sa khra'i ri 〈snar gzigs// rgya dmar khyedags gzhung gis babo|sa pa yi//khul nyer gcig ljangang khag brgya drug cu//yul rjodad smad gang na chags pa'i tshul//shes 'dod na sa khra'i yi ger gzigs// mi 'bum phrag bcu gnyis bkums pa dang //dgon drug stong rdul du brlags pa dang //gter sngog 'don nags tshal gcod 'breg sogs//shes 'awa da na dril bsgrags yig char gzigs/ /〉tebs che bas chung ba drag 'ded kyis//yul gzhan du btsan gyis phud pa'i bod//sems lha bas shugs ldan yang gcaten byis 'gar//bod rang sa'i khyad chos brjod na bzang //305

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/sa'i dbyibs dang chu tho'i bzhur phyogs dang // lam ci sku da sa khra'i ri 〈snar gzigs// rgya dmar khyedags gzhung gis babo|sa pa yi//khul nyer gcig ljangang khag brgya drug cu//yul rjodad smad gang na chags pa'i tshul//shes 'dod na sa khra'i yi ger gzigs// mi 'bum phrag bcu gnyis bkums pa dang //dgon drug stong rdul du brlags pa dang //gter sngog 'don nags tshal gcod 'breg sogs//shes 'awa da na dril bsgrags yig char gzigs/ /〉tebs che bas chung ba drag 'ded kyis//yul gzhan du btsan gyis phud pa'i bod//sems lha bas shugs ldan yang gcaten byis 'gar//bod rang sa'i khyad chos brjod na bzang //305
