yul la la gangs kyis bas ra nas sku da//yul la la gangs kyis mtshan nas sku1da//yul mdzes ljongs 'dzam gling yang thog de//bod gzhon nu rnams kyi 'tsho yul yin//chu la la rgya gar yul du 'bab// chu la la rgya nag yul du bzhur//chu rnyog bral yan lag brgyad ldan de//thodad gachodan nu rnams kyi 'asnung chu yin//mchorta la la rin chen bye ma 'phyur//mtsho la la 'dzad med tshwa yi mdzod //mtsho phyug mo gter gyi bang mdzod de//bod gzhon nu'i nor gyi 'byung khungs yin//ri la la sna tshogs gter gyis gang //ri la la nags tshal stug 11sa khyab//306

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/ ri gter brgya 'dzin pa'i bang mdzod de//thodad gcadan nu rnams kyi phyag cadar yin// thang la la rta cadar lug gis gang //thang la la ri dwags sna tshogs rtsen//thang yangs sngo/ pha mtha' mi macadan pa//11da gcasan nu rnams kyi 'thosag thang yin//zhing la la 'bru rigs sna lnga smin//zhing la la tshod ma sna tshogs skye//zhing ci btab smin pa'i gshong sa de//ngo da gcadan nu rnams kyi 'bru zhing yin// nags la la khang brtsegs ka gdung rung //nags la la g.yo skol bud shing 'os/ /nags ri lung brgyan pa'i ljon pa de//〈snad gachodan nu rnams kyi khyodad shing yin//307

11da la la sna cesags thabs la mkhas//thod la la snying lha bas stag la 'gran//thodad la la rig pa klog las myur// bod gzhon nu'i gnyug ma'i spun sring yin//snum mtsho mo 'khyil ba'i lung gshong yod//gser bye mar 'dres pa'i byang thang yod//sman nad brgya 'joms pa'i spang ri yod//bod gzhon nu'i rang byung nyer mkho yin//sngon chos rgyal 'bangs bcas gser gyi rin//ngo da skad gnyis smra ba'i srog gi rin// chos mdo rgyud bstan la 'jug 'dod na//11da gcadan nus thodad yig sbyang dbosnas lags//bod snga rabs mang wa'i gces no ra chos//phyi'i tshan rig smra mkhas mang the/sa kyang //308

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/nang tshan rig nang chodas legs bsngags na//bod gzhon nus bod yig sbyang dgos lags//phyi lus kyi 'asnum bas ho/ngas gyur nas// zas slong mo'i 'tsho bar rol da gos kyang //sems bde ba'i glu dbyangs len 'dod na//bod gzhon nus bod yig sbyang dgos lags//shar rgya nag skam sa chen wa'i 'bangs//phal che ba rgyal ba'i bstan la dad//rgya dad ldan grogs su bsgrig 'dod na//bod gzhon nus nang chos sbyang dgos lags//ngas bskul yul gcadan nu 1/da yig las//skad gzhan pa lhur len 'ga' yin gyi//sna kun la mkhas pa'i gce(na nu rnams//lag thal mo sbyar te yi rang zhu//309

sa 'di na nye du ma mchis shing //zas ster ba'i sbyin bdag ma rnyed par//gzhung rang gis gasnu skyodang med pa rnams//skad gzhan pa mi bsnyungan ga med lags//byams snying rje'i gzhung lugs rgyal ba'i bstan//bod gzhon nus yongs sbyangs rang gi sems//dgra lha nga gis dkrug par mi nus pa'i//gtan bde skyid stong gis 'tsho gyur cig/bod rang dbang rtsod pa'i thabs lam 'di//cadad lta nar bde thabs ga la yin//rgya dmar sngo ra gcasnad thabs ci la yin//rgya dkar nag skyid pa'i thabs kyang yin//mtho 'dzam gling go la'i yang thog gi/lha/da rang dbang josnab pa'i nyin mo nas//310

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/spyir gling 'di'i 'gro ba kun la phan//〈snas dkar nag rgya la lhag par phan// thichodas theg chen nyams su len pa yi//11da kun gyis gzhan la phan 'ba' zhig/lnga gas dka' yang gcasnad pa mi byed pas//rgya dkar nag gnyis kyi srid la phan//yul stodabs chen dkar nag rgyal khab gnyis//mtha' 'brel nas bsdad na nam zhig tshe//dmag drag chas bskul ba'i nyen che rbes//bod rang dbang rtsod pa gzhan don yin//rgya dkar nag yul du 'bab pa yi /chu gtsang bo kun gyi mgo phug tu//mi mang 11sa 'tshangs ka ma byas na//rgya dkar nag gnyis kyi chu la phan//311

chosastobasarinaspyamid༄gdapungagis//gangase ma11na mthing rgyal ces) g.yas gaskusan du//rgyang bskyod pa'i 'phur mda' btsugs nas bzung //rgya dkar wa'i blon tshogs 'o re brgyal//sa mthon wa bod kyi khor yug kun/ /dmag drag chas rten gzhi gyur nas bzung // bod lta ci dma' sa'i rgyal khab kyi//srid ga)rter ba'i cha rkyen tshang min nam//don de la dgongs te 'phags gzhung gi/dbang bo/ gnas mchod ba'i sdu/na chen gyis//rang nyid kyi gzhung dmangs phan phyir du/ /11da rang btsan lha ga na mi legs sam//sngon srid blon ne+e rus nga bzhi'i lor//bod rgya khongs bcug pa'i nyer len gyis//312

chosastobasarinaspyamid༄gdapungagis//gangase ma11na mthing rgyal ces) g.yas gaskusan du//rgyang bskyod pa'i 'phur mda' btsugs nas bzung //rgya dkar wa'i blon tshogs 'o re brgyal//sa mthon wa bod kyi khor yug kun/ /dmag drag chas rten gzhi gyur nas bzung // bod lta ci dma' sa'i rgyal khab kyi//srid ga)rter ba'i cha rkyen tshang min nam//don de la dgongs te 'phags gzhung gi/dbang bo/ gnas mchod ba'i sdu/na chen gyis//rang nyid kyi gzhung dmangs phan phyir du/ /11da rang btsan lha ga na mi legs sam//sngon srid blon ne+e rus nga bzhi'i lor//bod rgya khongs bcug pa'i nyer len gyis//312

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/dus da lta 'phags gzhung nywa/na chen rnams//thugs bag yangs bzhugs la nyen zhig gda'//lag mi dal 'bri ba'i dmigs yul ni//spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba dang //lhu sa 'bo/ la bde skyid 'byung ba yi /yid smon pa ri mo'i gzugs su bkod//rje blon gyis 'bangs la brtseb dang //'bangs rnams kyis rje sdudan bkur ba dang //dmangs phan tshun ྅ ga calagacig sgril na//bod rang dbang dka' yang ci'i mi 'thob//sa 'di ru gtan sdod khang brtsegs dang // yul 'di ga'i lag khyer ldan pa yis// rang yul la bsnyeg 'dod med na yang //bod rang dbang rtsod pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod//313

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/dus da lta 'phags gzhung nywa/na chen rnams//thugs bag yangs bzhugs la nyen zhig gda'//lag mi dal 'bri ba'i dmigs yul ni//spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba dang //lhu sa 'bo/ la bde skyid 'byung ba yi /yid smon pa ri mo'i gzugs su bkod//rje blon gyis 'bangs la brtseb dang //'bangs rnams kyis rje sdudan bkur ba dang //dmangs phan tshun ྅ ga calagacig sgril na//bod rang dbang dka' yang ci'i mi 'thob//sa 'di ru gtan sdod khang brtsegs dang // yul 'di ga'i lag khyer ldan pa yis// rang yul la bsnyeg 'dod med na yang //bod rang dbang rtsod pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod//313

cesas zab mo'i sna gas pa ma skyes shing //srid gnyan po'i kha gtad mi lcogs par//ri dben pa'i gnas su mtshams pa yi//ming 'dzin pa ye shes rgya macesas bris//phyi lo 2003 zla 10 tshes 16 la bris/ le tshan 'di ni brjod bya ha cang zhan pas/ gzigs pa po rnams kyis khrel dgod dang 'phya smod byed srid do//

༄༅༅/ /chodal gsum mnyam gzhas/'di nas byang gi tso gas su bltas tsa na//sprin dkar bang rim brtsegs pa'i gong rol du//shel gyi maceted rten dar gyis phyis 'dra ba//gangs dkar malnga na mthing rgyal mo'i dge mtshan mchodang //de mthong skyabs mgon 7rgyal ba'i dbang bo dang //ris med bstan 'dzin skyes bu thams cad kyi// sku brjid lhun po bzhin du che bar smon//sku tshe ri bo bzhin du brtan parasmon//'di nas byang gi phyogs su bltas tsa na//ljon shing kho lag rgyas pa'i mdzes ljongs su//g.yu 'brug dar ma lto la chas 'dra ba//yan lag brgyad ldan 'bri chu'i dge mtshan malnga nga //315

de mthong skyabs mgon 7rgyal ba'i dbang bo dang //ris med bstan 'dzin skyes bu thams cad kyi//sku tshe chu bo bzhin du ring bar smon//mdzad 'phrin rlabs 'phreng bzhin du rgyas par spyodan//'di nas byang gi phyogs su bltas tsa na// mdzes sdug g.yu mdangs 'dzin pa'i khor yug tu//g.yang dag ༄/na gnam sa la bting 'dra ba//mtsho sngon khri bshor rgyal mo'i dge mtshan mthong //de mthong skyabs mgon 7rgyal ba'i dbang bo dang //ris med bstan 'dzin skyes bu thams cad kyi//sku balha/da rgya mchorta bzhin du 'khyil bar spyodan//sku khams chu gter bzhin du dngas par blo na//phyi 61 2003 10 20 la bris/

de mthong skyabs mgon 7rgyal ba'i dbang bo dang //ris med bstan 'dzin skyes bu thams cad kyi//sku tshe chu bo bzhin du ring bar smon//mdzad 'phrin rlabs 'phreng bzhin du rgyas par spyodan//'di nas byang gi phyogs su bltas tsa na// mdzes sdug g.yu mdangs 'dzin pa'i khor yug tu//g.yang dag ༄/na gnam sa la bting 'dra ba//mtsho sngon khri bshor rgyal mo'i dge mtshan mthong //de mthong skyabs mgon 7rgyal ba'i dbang bo dang //ris med bstan 'dzin skyes bu thams cad kyi//sku balha/da rgya mchorta bzhin du 'khyil bar spyodan//sku khams chu gter bzhin du dngas par blo na//phyi 61 2003 10 20 la bris/

dge spyong bse ru'i kher gtam/༄༅༅// rang gi lo rgyus myong tshor sems kyi ri mo zhes bya ba/dpag med bskal ba'i sngon nas stobs bcu'i sar//phyin kyang snyigs lngas mnar ba'i nyam thag can//bdag sku/gas lhamab tu mi yi rnam 1dul pa//brtse gter gangs can mgon wa'i zhabs la 'dud//bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs kyi shar mtha' ru//theg gsum sngags dang rig pa'i gnas rnams kyi//brgyud pa ma lus nyi ltar gsal mdzad pa//kun mkhyen yab sras brgyud par bcas la'ang 'dud//tha mal bdag la mkhas pa mgu ba dang //blun po ngo mtshar skyed pa ma mchis kyang //deng dus rang rtsom mjug tu rang gi rabs//'bri srol yod pa dang du blang bar bya//317

de la 'dir deng dus kyi lugs srol ltar deb che chung ci 'dra zhig bris pa yin na/ de'i ༄/ga mtha' gang rung du 'bri mkhan rang gi sku rgyus mdor bsdus dang 'dra par zhig 'thodad srol yod pa bzhin ngas kyang de ltar bya yi/de la mang che bas rang gi so1 rgyus tshang ma gzhan pa zhig la bshad nas des tshig khyodar sdeb pa'i lo rgyus dang / yang rang gi lo rgyus rang gis 'bri ba'i lugs srol gnyis yod pa las 'di ni phyi ma ltar bya'o//de la dang po nga rang skyes yul gyi khor yug bshad pa/ gnyis pa/ nga rang skyes nas 'phags yul du ma 'khyodar bar gyi gnas stangs bshad pa/gsum pa/ 'phags yul du 'asdudar nas da lta'i bar gyi gnas stangs bshad pa/ bzhi pa/ zhar byung du gnas skor du song ba bcas so// dang po/ nga rang skyes yul mdzod dge ni/ mdo smad phyogs na mdzod dge zer ba'i yul lung kha shas yod pa las 'di ni mdzod dge smad ma btsun padabo na mchog bstan pa'i lha na me'i 'khrungs yul yin/ yang mjoḍad dge lha da nas nang dme byas te ru yong yin pas mdzod dge dme bo yang zer/ dbus lha ldan nas lam tshad spyi le 2270 yas mas dang / bkra shis 'khyil gyi shar 〈snags spyi le bdun cu'i mtshams na skusnad/ sa cha'i phyed ka 'thodag pa kho na dang phyed ka zhing phyugs 'dres ma'i sa cha zhig yin/ shar khyodags na rdza ri mthon wa ༄nir bu dbang 318

de la 'dir deng dus kyi lugs srol ltar deb che chung ci 'dra zhig bris pa yin na/ de'i ༄/ga mtha' gang rung du 'bri mkhan rang gi sku rgyus mdor bsdus dang 'dra par zhig 'thodad srol yod pa bzhin ngas kyang de ltar bya yi/de la mang che bas rang gi so1 rgyus tshang ma gzhan pa zhig la bshad nas des tshig khyodar sdeb pa'i lo rgyus dang / yang rang gi lo rgyus rang gis 'bri ba'i lugs srol gnyis yod pa las 'di ni phyi ma ltar bya'o//de la dang po nga rang skyes yul gyi khor yug bshad pa/ gnyis pa/ nga rang skyes nas 'phags yul du ma 'khyodar bar gyi gnas stangs bshad pa/gsum pa/ 'phags yul du 'asdudar nas da lta'i bar gyi gnas stangs bshad pa/ bzhi pa/ zhar byung du gnas skor du song ba bcas so// dang po/ nga rang skyes yul mdzod dge ni/ mdo smad phyogs na mdzod dge zer ba'i yul lung kha shas yod pa las 'di ni mdzod dge smad ma btsun padabo na mchog bstan pa'i lha na me'i 'khrungs yul yin/ yang mjoḍad dge lha da nas nang dme byas te ru yong yin pas mdzod dge dme bo yang zer/ dbus lha ldan nas lam tshad spyi le 2270 yas mas dang / bkra shis 'khyil gyi shar 〈snags spyi le bdun cu'i mtshams na skusnad/ sa cha'i phyed ka 'thodag pa kho na dang phyed ka zhing phyugs 'dres ma'i sa cha zhig yin/ shar khyodags na rdza ri mthon wa ༄nir bu dbang 318

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/rgyal dang / a myes dkyil 'kho ra/ mar khu'i be'u rdung phyug mo sku gas gzi brjid ldan pa'i ri bo du mas mdzes par bskor yod/ ri bo de dag gi khong gseng du gna' ba dang gla ba la sku/gas pa'i ri dwags sna cho gas pa bag phebs su 'tsho zhing gnas yod/ bho phyogs su tho re yongs 'du'i rgyal khab chen po zhes yongs su grags pa de nyid yod la/ 'di la sngon bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur sogs gsung rab mang wa'i dpar shing yod kyang kha che dang ca zhe phan tshun dmag 'thab byas te kha ches dpar khang chen snu/ mer bsregs/ 'di'i skabs su sdomis rams pa bsam 'grub rgya maskrun dgung grangs drug yin par gsungs lha// /nub dang byang na khyodan g.yu tsha dmag dathodan gyi gdung rgyud las mched pa'i kha gya tsho drug gi yul lung chen pos bsgor yod/ mdo smad bkra shis 'khyil ba dang / gtsos sras mkhar dgu thog gnyan chen sngo la g.yu rtse bcas bod gangs can na grags pa yod pa de dag kyang khor yug 'di na gnas so// mchod dge ni sngon mnga' bdag khri ral ba can gyi phyag mjod dga' ye shes dar rgyas dge khyodang gi cha byad byas nas gling yul du khral len du mngags pa'i rgyud pa yin zhing / 'di la shog ka lnga dang / tsho ba brgyad/ dgon pa bzhi/ ri khrod bcu dang bcas zhing 'brog khyon bsdoms grong tsho lnga bcu lnga bdun rgya sde gsum 319

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/rgyal dang / a myes dkyil 'kho ra/ mar khu'i be'u rdung phyug mo sku gas gzi brjid ldan pa'i ri bo du mas mdzes par bskor yod/ ri bo de dag gi khong gseng du gna' ba dang gla ba la sku/gas pa'i ri dwags sna cho gas pa bag phebs su 'tsho zhing gnas yod/ bho phyogs su tho re yongs 'du'i rgyal khab chen po zhes yongs su grags pa de nyid yod la/ 'di la sngon bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur sogs gsung rab mang wa'i dpar shing yod kyang kha che dang ca zhe phan tshun dmag 'thab byas te kha ches dpar khang chen snu/ mer bsregs/ 'di'i skabs su sdomis rams pa bsam 'grub rgya maskrun dgung grangs drug yin par gsungs lha// /nub dang byang na khyodan g.yu tsha dmag dathodan gyi gdung rgyud las mched pa'i kha gya tsho drug gi yul lung chen pos bsgor yod/ mdo smad bkra shis 'khyil ba dang / gtsos sras mkhar dgu thog gnyan chen sngo la g.yu rtse bcas bod gangs can na grags pa yod pa de dag kyang khor yug 'di na gnas so// mchod dge ni sngon mnga' bdag khri ral ba can gyi phyag mjod dga' ye shes dar rgyas dge khyodang gi cha byad byas nas gling yul du khral len du mngags pa'i rgyud pa yin zhing / 'di la shog ka lnga dang / tsho ba brgyad/ dgon pa bzhi/ ri khrod bcu dang bcas zhing 'brog khyon bsdoms grong tsho lnga bcu lnga bdun rgya sde gsum 319

dang drug cu yod/ deng sang kun su'u zhing chen/ gan bho bod rigs rang lhamang khul gyi khe ngas su gdodags sku //nga'i skyes yul mdzod dge rkang tsha ni/ sngar mtsho sngon khri lnga'i rkang tsha nas chad pa yin par bshad/ 'di nas chad pa'i maces sgyudan 16) rkang tsha dang / rgan rgya'i rkang tsha/ bsang kho ga rkang tsha/ de ma yin pa'i grong tsho dang khyim tshang re la rkang tsha zer ba mdo smad kyi phyogs mtha' dag na mang du yod par snang ngo // nga'i skyes yul rkang tsha 'di la zhing phyugs 'dres ma'i grong tsho bcu gcig dang / dgon pa gcig ri khrod gsum bcas yod/ dgon pa'i phu nacani rgyan pad+mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i shag ral gnas khang zer ba'i grub gnas bo nga cadig gnyis mo da cing / grub gnas bo nga ma bde malnga ga gi gnas ri yin zhing brag ri sngo skya mtho la gzar ba shug pa spa ma sogs ljon shing sna cho gas kyis brgyan pa zhig sku da/ gnas mjal zhu yul phyag pa chen ྅rngo gag yod pa de nyid rgan gya'i brag dkar dang 'brel yod par bshad srol yod/grub gnas codig ma sna je phag sna'i gnas ri yin zhing / brag ridamar po rngam zhing 'jigs pa 'bru shug dang tswasman sna tshogs kyis dri zhim 'thul le yod/ gnas 'di la sngon dge ldan bstan pa'i gsal byed skyabs rje kirti rin po che dang kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku 'phreng rim byon/ bya bral 320

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/grub pa'i dbang phyug shar skal ldan rgya mtsho sogs mdo smad kyi che dgu rnams kyi zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas ri khyad par ba zhig yin ྅rte//dgon pa'i mda' na/ yul lha gzhi bdag dor sems sems dpa' dkar wa'i gnas yulas myes rdor sems zhes pa'i brag ri dmar po mtho zhing gzar la rtse mo rim pa gsum dang / brag rdzong gong 'og gnyis dang g.yas thang shing dang gasku1na shug pa'i nags tshal gyis brgyan pa'i ri ro/ brjid chags pa zhig yod do//gong du bshad pa'i rkang tsha la grong tsho bcu gcig yod pa'i nang tshan shug yag mdo'i khri pa tshang ni nga rang gi skyes khyim yin/ 'di dang chos sa'i josnag ma tshang gnyis dang 11 khyim babo sa yin zhing rkang che'i sa 'dzin mkhan gyi 1—ga ma yin par rgan rabs 'ga'i ngag nas chodas/ nga'i skyes khyim khri ba tshang 'di la sngon bod dang sog wa'i bla ma bzhi tsam 'khrungs/ de la mdzod dge dge legs rin po che ni kun mkhyen sku 'phreng bzhi ba'i skabs yin zhing / mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas par mkhyen rgya che bas kun mkhyen rang nyid kyi sku/ngas 'dzin du bsten pa red ces grwa pa rgan pa rnams kyi zhal nas lnga/sa snu da/nga rang la lo rgyus yig cha khungs btsun brjod du med lags/ kho tshe rin po 321

che dang rgyal sras rin 14 che rnam pa gnyis 'khrungs pa'i dus skabs gcig yin zhing / gnyis ka smad sku ga mkhar sngon wa'i yul gyi bla ma go gnas mtho shos gnyis yin par bshad/ nga'i pha myos nye shu tham pa'i skabs su rnga cesang mang sngo/ra khal bkal nas pha yul du zhabs sku/ra basposad byung zer/ rgya gung khran ma skusnang bo nga nga'i nang la smad sku ga nas chodan pa'i ca lag 'khar zangs/ 'khar ba'i me thab/ dngul dem/ dngul skyogs sogs gzhan la med pa'i yo byad mang po yod pa rig gsar skabs su tshang ma bsdu len byas so//a lags snang lugs ni/ bkra shis 'khyil gyi bla ma bo gnas mchodan po rang min la/ dpe gzigs gnang ste rjes su mdzod dge dgon gsar dang rkang che'i dbo na pa'i khri par bzhugs/ nga brgyad 'o/ra gasnyu sa khrims khang dmar wa'i nang nas dbo ngas pa rtsodags so// nga'i pha'i ming la mabo na sngo rnam rgyal dang ma la khrang te zer/ pha nga brgyad lor dmar dmag sngon 'gog gi dmag 'khrug nang du zhugs te rgya dmag gis bzung / phyin chad ngo log byed mi chog pa'i btsan bka' btang nas mngags/ rjes su slar rta dang me mda' sgrig nas ca da'o/ga zing 'khrug nang zhugs kyang ring cad ma thogs par khyodan yongs su dmar dmag gis dbang bsgyur byas/ yin na yang / nga'i pha la dung rdeg btson 'jug phar zad/ mdzug 'phar tsam yang rgyag myong med/ de gang yin 322

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/zhe na/ dmar dmag la snying rje dang nga'i pha la stobs shugs che ba ga la yin/pha rang nyid la khyim nor nywa phyugs gang 'tsham yod stabs/ rang gi grong tsho dang yas mas kyi thosneng tsho'i nang gi 'a〈snar med khyim tshang la gsar brje ma byas pa'i gong du lo mang rogs ram byas yod/ de la mi su 'dra zhig gis bskyi g.yar cwa(nga gsum byed na rnam 'gyur yag wa'i 〈sna nas rta gasku ra ba la sga srab 'grig ma/ g.yag gasku1ra ba la sga thag 'grig ma/ phar gasku1ra tshur skyel gyi skabs su mar phyur cadi 6te sogs bza' bca' gya swā ma pa byin pas/ gsar brje'i skabs su rogs ram byas mi phal che ba gsar brje'i 'go khrid kyi nang du tshud yod cing / khong tshos nga'i pha la gsar brje ngo log pa'i nag nyes dang /khyim gyi dpal 'byor tshang ma khyer yod kyang phyugs bdag gral rim gyi nag nyes btsugs te gzhung bzhes btang pa'i nag tho'i nang bathod med par bshad/de bas nga'i pha lus srog la gcad pa ma byung bar rang lo brgyad cu'i thog rang khyim nas tshe 'aho/sa pa dang / a ma nga rang so/ bzhi yin pa'i skabs su tshe las 'das 11//gnyis pa/ nga rang spyi lo 1958 lor skyes/ lo bcu grangs shig la bslebs skabs gzhi rim jo ba grwar sku/ gsum tsam la sku/nga / 'di'i skabs su rgya yig kho na ma galta gas phra da yig mi 'dug de'i rjes nas rang 323

khyim du bu rdzi byed dgos byung bas rgya yig slob pa'i go skabs shor/ nga la spun sring gsum yod pa de dag gis bod yig klog thub tsam 'dug ngas ni bod yig la yid sgyu na gyi ngang nas 'o/ bcu drug la 11na/ de nas zhing las ta krer slob sbyong dang rtomadzod ra ba skor ba'i las rigs la zhugs nas rang lo bco brgyad la bslebs/ nam rgyun las byed re zung gis nga'i pha la lta tshul ngan pa zhig sku/da la/ de bas de la sku/la du chu tshan la 'bo/ ce)ga pa'i chogag mchan zhus te mtsho sngon wa'i rkang tsha rdzong dang / mtsho 'khyil zhang dang / nywa nag so ma'i 'aro/ga sde la skyabs bajo la nas bsdad pa yin/ macad mi tung tshe 'phos ma thag tu 'grig lam je btsan du sku nga ste re zhig 'gul sa 'phag sa med pa lta bu zhig tu gyur/ de nas rim gyis gu yangs su sku nga ba na phyir pha yul du yong ba yin/ de nas nga lo 3 shu rtsa gnyis la phyin 'dug nga rang gi bsam par mi tshe 'di la cadad yig khyodag thub pa zhig ma byas na g.yag rgan yu sngo zhig dang khyad par mi 'dug go snyam ste/ rang gi phu bo skal bzang don 'grub la bod yig 'dzin grwa dang wa'i dpe deb kyi dbu nas dbyangs gsal so bzhi slob tu bcug ste/ chu chortad gnyis dang byed ka tsam gyi ring la legs par shes/ zla gcig yun la 'dzin grwa dang wa'i slob deb yongs rdzogs sbyor klog thub tsam byung / de'i mtshams nas gling rje ge sar rgyal bo'i sgrung / hor gling g.yul 324

khyim du bu rdzi byed dgos byung bas rgya yig slob pa'i go skabs shor/ nga la spun sring gsum yod pa de dag gis bod yig klog thub tsam 'dug ngas ni bod yig la yid sgyu na gyi ngang nas 'o/ bcu drug la 11na/ de nas zhing las ta krer slob sbyong dang rtomadzod ra ba skor ba'i las rigs la zhugs nas rang lo bco brgyad la bslebs/ nam rgyun las byed re zung gis nga'i pha la lta tshul ngan pa zhig sku/da la/ de bas de la sku/la du chu tshan la 'bo/ ce)ga pa'i chogag mchan zhus te mtsho sngon wa'i rkang tsha rdzong dang / mtsho 'khyil zhang dang / nywa nag so ma'i 'aro/ga sde la skyabs bajo la nas bsdad pa yin/ macad mi tung tshe 'phos ma thag tu 'grig lam je btsan du sku nga ste re zhig 'gul sa 'phag sa med pa lta bu zhig tu gyur/ de nas rim gyis gu yangs su sku nga ba na phyir pha yul du yong ba yin/ de nas nga lo 3 shu rtsa gnyis la phyin 'dug nga rang gi bsam par mi tshe 'di la cadad yig khyodag thub pa zhig ma byas na g.yag rgan yu sngo zhig dang khyad par mi 'dug go snyam ste/ rang gi phu bo skal bzang don 'grub la bod yig 'dzin grwa dang wa'i dpe deb kyi dbu nas dbyangs gsal so bzhi slob tu bcug ste/ chu chortad gnyis dang byed ka tsam gyi ring la legs par shes/ zla gcig yun la 'dzin grwa dang wa'i slob deb yongs rdzogs sbyor klog thub tsam byung / de'i mtshams nas gling rje ge sar rgyal bo'i sgrung / hor gling g.yul 324

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/'gyed kyi rnyedad cha'i dpe deb zla shas su bklags/ yig byang gang 'tsham sku nga ba na thar masnga dang sman masnga bklags pa yin/ 'di dus su nga'i phas nga la mi che'i mdun lam bde thabs su bza' zla bzang snu/ zhig la bsam swā/ gdo/nga bzhin 'dug nga rang gi bsam par mi tshe 'di la gar sdod gar bzhud rang dbang sku da pa zhig bya dbo sa bsam skusnad/ 'di'i skabs su rgya nag gzhung gi srid jus gu yangs su phyin te chos lugs dad snu sa byed chodag pas mi tshang mas grwa ba byed thub na tshe 'di skyid phyi skyid yin lugs kyi snyan gtam yid du 'ong ba zhig brjod byung / de la nga'i sring mo dam chos mtsho mos kyang / khyed rang grwa ba byas te smon lam sde lnga dang / sman mdo zhig shes song na/ nga rang gi 'dodad pa 'grub pa yin zer/ nga'i bsam par grwa pa'i gnas stangs 'di ni ha cang stabs bde bo zhig yin pa mthong byung / de bas mo rang gis zer ba nyan nas bkra shis 'khyil gyi dge bshes tshul khrims nyi ma'i spyan snga nas ming brjes lus bsgyur byas te ming la ye shes rgya masnu ges btags sku/// snga ma'i skya ming kun dga' rdo rje zer/ de'i rjes tsam nas bzung ste rang lo sum cu sku gnyis bar 'o na bdun brgyad tsam gyi ring la bkra shis 'khyil gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho'i spyan sngar bsdus grwa nas dbu ma'i bar gyi dpe khrid dang / slob dpon dmu dge bsam gtan gyi spyan snga nas sgrub 325

thabs rin 'byung dang sum rtags snyan ngag zhus/ rtsis rams pa bsam 'grub rgya mtsho'i spyan snga nas khyod 'jug zhus/ dam pa 'di dang lhan du gong du bshad pa'i shag ral grub gnas gong 'og dang de'u bur sgom khang bcas su song ste bslab bya sna tshogs nyan pa'i skal ba byung / dge ba'i bshes gnyen zangasadakar chos 'byor spyan sngar yang bsdus grwa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun rgya maco'i tshe ba'i spyan sngar lam rim mchan bzhi ma 11gas lung mang ྅/ zhus/ la mo'i zhabs drung yongs 'dzin rin po ce'i spyan sngar bde gsang 'jigs gsum sogs dbang rjes mang du zhus/ gling rin po che'i spyan sngar rigs gsum spyi sgrub dang dbyangs can ma'i rjes gnang zhus/ skyabs rje gung thang rin po che'i spyan snga nas mi tra brgya rtsa'i dbu nas dbang nyi shu rtsalnga dang dus 'khor dbang chen sku/gas zhus/ paṇa chen rin 〈sna che'i spyan snga nas sku/na tan gzhir gyur ma'i gsung snu sa dang sems bskyed masnu da pa sdu/gas zhus/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'jam dbyangs nyi ma'i spyan snga nas sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor le'i tshe dbang zhus/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnga ba sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i spyan snga nas bsnyen snyungags kyi cadam pa zhus pa bcas dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil gyi bka' drin gyis cesas dang rig gnas kyi skal ba 1snab pa 'di tsam lags/ yin na yang / nga grwa tshang gi chodags su tshud med la/ de la tshad bkag sku da pas 'o/ 326

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/rer grwa ba nyi shu ma gtogs 'jug mi thub/ de yang rgyugs sprod byas te blo rgyugs dang rtsod rgyugs gnyis ka ma 'phrod na tshogs su mi 'jug de la dbang rnon kherdzo na ma gdor+shags nga lta bus sku nga sa mi 'dug snyam ste sems zhum nas rgyugs khyodad tre gas su thodam kha tsam yang sgyur med/ brgyad cu rgya bdun 'o/ra shag gi rgan bkra shis rgya mcho lags kyis rgyugs rjod sar btsan 'ded byas/ 'jam dbyangs lha khang gi lcags ri'i nang logs na rnga ba dang mtsho sngon sogs phyogs kyi grwa ba brgya dang lnga bcu yas mas shig la rgyugs len grabs 'dug nga yang de dag dang mnyam du bsdad/ rgyugs len mkhan dge bshes kha shas dang phyag mdzod khang gi rgan pa kha shas 'dug de nas bdag gi dge rgan rin po che dge 'jam da byangs rgya mtho'i zhal nas/ grub mtha' calab lhagar mkhan skude na mdun du phebs swā ga gsungs/ nga mnyam du grwa pa gsum 'dug nged cag gis mnyam skyor byed chog pas rgyugs legs po byung / de mtshungs spyod 'jug chen mo yod na shog gsungs/ nga gcig pu ma gtogs mi 'dug de la le'u re re'i dbu nas dum bu re dang mjug nas dum re ma gtogs cha tshang skyor dgos ma byung / rgyan 'jug gnyis ka spyir btang gi gzhung rgyugs yin pas 'di'i skabs su rgyugs sprod byed mi chog nga'i blo rgyugs 'di la phyag mdzod khang gis grwa tshang gi mdun nas bsngags bswā da dang kun mkhyen rin nyu nga'i'i spyan sngar zhus 327

te rtsod rgyugs ma sprad kyang tshogs chos grwar 'gro chog pa'i bka' gnang ngo //yin na yang / thabs skyod nga zhig la nga rang gi mig shin tu lha/ zhing so/nga 'khrid mi dbotos tsam zhig yin pas chorags su zhugs ma 21da lags/ 〈snab gnyer skabs su 'tsho sbyor gatho rwaku sring mo.a ne+e dam chos mtsho mo dang rang khyim yin zhing sdod shag khang mig gnyis dam chos mtsho mos bskrun/ nga rgya gar la ma yong bar du phal cher dgung bcad dang dkar zas kho na la bsten pa yin no//brgyad cu gya dgu'i le'i bod zla gnyis pa'i nang nga'i sring mo dam chos mtsho mos nga ma shi bo nga du 7rgyal ba rin sngo/ che la ma mjal thabs med yin zhes snu rang gi ca lag 'phral tshong byas nas rgya sgor bzhi stong lhag cig tshags su tshud 'dug pa lam bo na byas te thodad zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig nyin bkra shis 'khyil nas lan kru'u grong khyer du 'byor/ de nas lcags lam dang snum lam brgyud nas lha sar 'byor/ 'phral du yong ma thub par bho kha'i phyogs su zla gnyis tsam ring gnas mjal du song / ston khar phyir lha sar yong ste re zhig sdod dgos byung / bod zla bcu ba'i gnam gang nyin mdzod dge'i tshong pa gdugs dkar bkra shis kyis kho rang nyid kyi skyel 'dren rlangs 'khor nang du gsang stabs su rma chu'i sgrol lo dang rdo dkar stag lha gnyis kyis rogs ram byas te bal 11da mtha' mtshams 'gram bar du bskyal/ 〈sna gnyis kyis yid ches 328

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/'pher ba'i lam mkhan gsum gra sgrig byas shing 'bo/ ran pa na/ bkra shis 'khyil nas chodas bo gas yin pa sa dkar cad zer rgya mtshor thug ste nged cag mnyam du lam la chas/ mtshan snu/ gsum la smyug ri brag lam brgyud nas khyodi pa'i skabs su sa dkar 'od zer rgya mtshos rogs ram hur thag mdzad pa'i bka' drin yang yang dran bzhin sku/da/ mtshan snu/ tha ma de la nga'i sring ces dam chos mtsho mo g.yas skyor g.yon skyor ci tsam byas kyang 'gro ma thub par dkan gzar ri bo zhig gi gdong zur du sdod dgos byung / phyi nyin ri gsham du mar babs te nyi ma shar mtshams su bal tho'i jag dmag la thug nasadam cesas maces mo'i sked par bal sgor bzhi stong yod pa tshang ma 'phrogs/ gzhan ca lag cha nge chung nge yod pa tshang ma khyer/ yin na yang / nged cag bal yul bod gzhung sku tshab don gcod khang du bde bar 'byor ro// de nas bzung ste dha ram sa la'i sne len khang bar du skyabs mgon rgyal ba'i dbang tho'i thugs rje dang btsan sdudal gzhung gi bka' drin la brten nas gsar 'aX7ra spyi mtshungs kyi mthun rjodar tshang ma 1snab pa lags 1///gsum pa/ 'di'i skabs su sne len khang du spyi thab med pas gsar 'byor tshang ma gangs can skyid gshong gi gzhung zhabs spyi thab tu 'gro dgos 'dug bal yul nas nyin mtshan med par sku nga dathodas byung shing lam bar 329

nas bzang btung 'thode pa cirgams pa ma reg pas/ spyi thab kyi bzhes lag zhim po de dang phrad pa na ngo tsha med pa'i ltogs bza' zhig byed dgos byung / de nas nyin bcu drug gi mtshams nas nga'i sring ces dam cesas maces ces skyabs mthon rgyal ba'i pho brang gi byang ngos su btsun dgon dga' ldan chos gling zhes chos dang rig gnas kyi slob gnyer sku da pa'i a ne'i dathodan pa yag lnga zhig mo da pa de'i nang du tshud de da lta'i bar du gnas so// nga rang dgu bcu tham pa'i le'i dpyid chos chen mo grol rjes su 'bras sgo mang gi dge 'dun pa kha shas dang lhan du grwa sar 'gro khul byas/ der song yang gong du bshad pa ltar grwa tshang gi las khur dang / 'dzin skyor sbyong / rgyugs rtsi bzhag tshogs chos grwa/ dpe khrid dpe blta sogs gang sa gang nas bltas na nga lta bu'i smon pa'i yul tsam ma galta gas lag bstar thub pa ga la srid/ cadan kyang dge 'dun rigs pa smra ba rnams dang lhan du smon lam 'debs phyir 'bras spungs sgo mang bya bral khang tshan du gnas bcas te zla 'gar chogags cesas grwar sku(nga ba yin/de nas rgya gar tā cadags nas tsha ba ma 'a'od par tsha sku la du rgya gar byang 17gas bkra shis 'khyil du song / der re zhig bsdad pa yin/ rjes nas dgu bcu bo gsum 'o/ yin pa 'dra dam snu sa masnum lnga rgyu lhag gis gzir te bde legs sman khang du gshags bathodas byas sku da/ myur du ro/ga ces smin gling yig tshang 330

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/du kha par 'khyodar 'dug a lags skusnangs 'dzin rin sngo che la 'phral ma nyid du dbo ngas pa zhus te dha sa'i bde legs sman khang du 'drodar skabs gshags ba3r+shas byas nas nyin gnyis 11nga 'dug la dbus the1 kha btsun ma rgyal mtshan lha 'dzoms dang nga'i pha yul dang khad nye ba'i kha gya'i khams gtsang bu mo nga 'dzin skyid gnyis kyis nad gaskurdzog byed bzhin 'dug rgyal mtshan lha 'jo mas lags kyis yun ring du nad gasku gas byas/ gzhan ru ngar dge 'dun rgya masnu dang nyis tshang skal bzang dam snumis sku/gas kyis nyogags ram gang 'tsham byas/ sman khang du nyal bzhin pa'i skabs su btsun dgon mkhan po ser smad dge bshes thar ba lags phebs te khong gi zhal nas/ spyi pa'i snga gas skyodab ci yang mi 'dug 'di ni nga rang sger gyi yin zhes gsungs nas lhan sgor brgya tham pa gnang byung / nga rang lag na lhan sbru ra chig rjodang bdun brgya tsam las med pas sman rin 'dang sa ma red bsam ste sems khral gyi ngang nas 'a༄sgrod bsten las khungs la zhus na ci drag ces gzhan la dris pa yin cesad/ la las car lhasner yi ge skudad na reg srid zer/ kha shas kyis gzhis chags gnad yod mi sna 'am las byed ngo shes pa yod na reg par nges so zer yang de 'dra med pas zhu thabs ma 'grig〉〈na kyang sman rin zas rin dang bcas pa gzhan la skad 'thod zhu ma dgos par nged gnyis ma'i sgor mo bsdoms sprod byas te 331

'dang tsam byung / sman rin sprod pa'i skabs su dam chos mtsho mo rang nyid kyi dge rgan ther+shad gnya' lam nas yin pa btsun ma ngag dbang macos 31 lags kyis sman rin tshang ma gnang grabs byed kyin 'dug pa nged gnyis kyis thugs rje che zhes blangs med/ dge rgan 'di lags kyis 'phrod bsten gyi phyogs su thugs khur che bzhes gnang byung cad / de nas bdun phrag gcig gi mtshams nas dbo na par sku nga / phyi rgyalas ne+e zhig gis lhan khyodar sum brgya dang / mtsho sngon sangs rgyas lags kyis lhan sgor brgya sprad byung / da rung nad mjug sangs drag min zhing lta rtog byed mkhan dathodas pas nga la zla gcig gi 'tsho ba spyi pas gnang / gshags bcos kyi zug rngu cung drag kyang gzugs gzhi gso ba'i 'tsho bcud kyis ma yong bar gzugs po skyo 'dug pas mdo smad dbus spyi khyab rgyun las khungs kyi 'gan 'dzin lags su mo rang 'phrod brten gyi thebs rtsa cung zhig slong du phyin kyang / zhu 'bras la dpog na gsar 'byor nad pa zhig dang mdo smad gzhung gnyis ka dpal 'byor gyi cha nas dbul phyug gcig mtshungs yin pa 'dra/ skabs 'dir sku sgor yig tshang gi mtshams pa'i khongs su tshud na ci ma rung snyam pa byung / ngo shes pa zhig gis rogs ram byas te sku sger yig tshang gi mtshams pa'i khosgongs su bcug ri'i sgang nas mtshams khang ma 11ba 332

'dang tsam byung / sman rin sprod pa'i skabs su dam chos mtsho mo rang nyid kyi dge rgan ther+shad gnya' lam nas yin pa btsun ma ngag dbang macos 31 lags kyis sman rin tshang ma gnang grabs byed kyin 'dug pa nged gnyis kyis thugs rje che zhes blangs med/ dge rgan 'di lags kyis 'phrod bsten gyi phyogs su thugs khur che bzhes gnang byung cad / de nas bdun phrag gcig gi mtshams nas dbo na par sku nga / phyi rgyalas ne+e zhig gis lhan khyodar sum brgya dang / mtsho sngon sangs rgyas lags kyis lhan sgor brgya sprad byung / da rung nad mjug sangs drag min zhing lta rtog byed mkhan dathodas pas nga la zla gcig gi 'tsho ba spyi pas gnang / gshags bcos kyi zug rngu cung drag kyang gzugs gzhi gso ba'i 'tsho bcud kyis ma yong bar gzugs po skyo 'dug pas mdo smad dbus spyi khyab rgyun las khungs kyi 'gan 'dzin lags su mo rang 'phrod brten gyi thebs rtsa cung zhig slong du phyin kyang / zhu 'bras la dpog na gsar 'byor nad pa zhig dang mdo smad gzhung gnyis ka dpal 'byor gyi cha nas dbul phyug gcig mtshungs yin pa 'dra/ skabs 'dir sku sgor yig tshang gi mtshams pa'i khongs su tshud na ci ma rung snyam pa byung / ngo shes pa zhig gis rogs ram byas te sku sger yig tshang gi mtshams pa'i khosgongs su bcug ri'i sgang nas mtshams khang ma 11ba 332

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/pa'i bar zla ba gnyis tsam ring la rjodad ding ri'i sku na tan rgya mtsho'i khyim tshang gis khang gla ma blangs par rjod du bcug sku nga / rjes nas sku kha shas la gasku la ras kyang sprad byung / der sdod bzhin pa'i skabs su tre+e hor ba rgan dbang phyug phun 〉rgags lags kyis khyed la mtshams khang 11ba byung gdan khri thab chas dang bcas pa 'dug go gsungs/ de nas bzung ste ri'i spang nas da bar du 'tsho ba bskyal ba yin/ mtshams khang skusad sa'i gnas ni/ skyabs mabe|na rgyal ba'i dbang tho'i pho brang nye 'khor ri brgyud na yod/ spyir btang mtshams pa'i grangs drug cu nas brgyad cu'i bar bri gang can yin pas grangs la nges pa ma mchis/ de'i nang na bod pa'i spyi tshogs kyi khrod na mtshan mthong chen po yod pa'i bla ma dge bshes kha shas kyang yod/ de ni/ sku shogs spang nang rin po che/ sku shogs gyang dmar rin po che/ kirta'i mtshan zhabs rin po che/ dge bshes grub thob rin po che/ dge bshes skal bzang stobs rgyas/ rgan blo bzang bstan 'dzin sku gas sku // 'di rnam pa mang che ba 'dzam gling shar nub kun du ༷7na nas dbang bka' chodas gnang thub pa sku/gas kyi sku na tan rang gi mdzad rnam brtsams dang brtsam nges yin pas de las shes par byacad//rgan sdud bzang bstan 'dzin lags ni/ dbus lha ldan 'phan phra nas yin zhing / khe nga btsan cadal la phebs nas dus yun gang 'tsham zhig la dmag 333

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/pa'i bar zla ba gnyis tsam ring la rjodad ding ri'i sku na tan rgya mtsho'i khyim tshang gis khang gla ma blangs par rjod du bcug sku nga / rjes nas sku kha shas la gasku la ras kyang sprad byung / der sdod bzhin pa'i skabs su tre+e hor ba rgan dbang phyug phun 〉rgags lags kyis khyed la mtshams khang 11ba byung gdan khri thab chas dang bcas pa 'dug go gsungs/ de nas bzung ste ri'i spang nas da bar du 'tsho ba bskyal ba yin/ mtshams khang skusad sa'i gnas ni/ skyabs mabe|na rgyal ba'i dbang tho'i pho brang nye 'khor ri brgyud na yod/ spyir btang mtshams pa'i grangs drug cu nas brgyad cu'i bar bri gang can yin pas grangs la nges pa ma mchis/ de'i nang na bod pa'i spyi tshogs kyi khrod na mtshan mthong chen po yod pa'i bla ma dge bshes kha shas kyang yod/ de ni/ sku shogs spang nang rin po che/ sku shogs gyang dmar rin po che/ kirta'i mtshan zhabs rin po che/ dge bshes grub thob rin po che/ dge bshes skal bzang stobs rgyas/ rgan blo bzang bstan 'dzin sku gas sku // 'di rnam pa mang che ba 'dzam gling shar nub kun du ༷7na nas dbang bka' chodas gnang thub pa sku/gas kyi sku na tan rang gi mdzad rnam brtsams dang brtsam nges yin pas de las shes par byacad//rgan sdud bzang bstan 'dzin lags ni/ dbus lha ldan 'phan phra nas yin zhing / khe nga btsan cadal la phebs nas dus yun gang 'tsham zhig la dmag 333

nang du zhugs par bshad/ rjes nas rab tu byung ste ga40 du nā sna'i chodas drug gi nang tshan gtum snu/ sbru/ma nas me snga da rgyas pa na tshan rig pas brtag dpyad byed du a me ri shar gdan drangs/ kho tshos drod sman zos med dam dogs nas khrag bton te brtag dpyad byas/ der ma zad/ lus la drod rdzas 'dra min bcug yod par dogs nas lus kyi bu ga tshang ma sngog gsher byas shing sman rdzas gang yang med par thag chod pa na/ grang tshad mtho shos kyi 'khyag sgam zhig tu bcug ste chu 〉rgad bzhi tsam la bzhag de nas phyir bltasan pa na khong gi zhal nas/ kho tshos ngas me drod dmigs rnam ma skyong gong grang klog btang song zhes gsungs/ khrag blangs pa dang grang grog gtong snga ba'i rkyen gang yin nam bzhin mdangs cung zad 'gyur 'dug pa ma gdo1gas gzhan lus srog la gnod skyon gang yang byung med par bshad / nga 'byor skabs khong bo/ngas nas 'o/ ྅ra gnyis gsum tsam song 'dug mtshams pa rnams ri lung kha shas la bzhugs 'dug cing / nga cadad sa'i gnas de na grangs nyi shu sku/da pa tshang ma skyabs mabo na yid bzhin cadar bu'i sku che'i tshe sgrub mdzad mkhan sha stag red/ de'i gtso bo dge bshes grub thob rin po che dang dge bshes skal bzang tshubabs rgyas gnyis yin zhing /dge bshes grub thob rin po che ni/ spyi lo 1926 lor dbus bho 334

nang du zhugs par bshad/ rjes nas rab tu byung ste ga40 du nā sna'i chodas drug gi nang tshan gtum snu/ sbru/ma nas me snga da rgyas pa na tshan rig pas brtag dpyad byed du a me ri shar gdan drangs/ kho tshos drod sman zos med dam dogs nas khrag bton te brtag dpyad byas/ der ma zad/ lus la drod rdzas 'dra min bcug yod par dogs nas lus kyi bu ga tshang ma sngog gsher byas shing sman rdzas gang yang med par thag chod pa na/ grang tshad mtho shos kyi 'khyag sgam zhig tu bcug ste chu 〉rgad bzhi tsam la bzhag de nas phyir bltasan pa na khong gi zhal nas/ kho tshos ngas me drod dmigs rnam ma skyong gong grang klog btang song zhes gsungs/ khrag blangs pa dang grang grog gtong snga ba'i rkyen gang yin nam bzhin mdangs cung zad 'gyur 'dug pa ma gdo1gas gzhan lus srog la gnod skyon gang yang byung med par bshad / nga 'byor skabs khong bo/ngas nas 'o/ ྅ra gnyis gsum tsam song 'dug mtshams pa rnams ri lung kha shas la bzhugs 'dug cing / nga cadad sa'i gnas de na grangs nyi shu sku/da pa tshang ma skyabs mabo na yid bzhin cadar bu'i sku che'i tshe sgrub mdzad mkhan sha stag red/ de'i gtso bo dge bshes grub thob rin po che dang dge bshes skal bzang tshubabs rgyas gnyis yin zhing /dge bshes grub thob rin po che ni/ spyi lo 1926 lor dbus bho 334

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/kha bsam yas dang nye ba'i sbrag rnga sgra grong tshor yab skal bzang tshe 'ingadang yum g.yang 'jodums bu khrid gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/ nar sku/na pa na yab kyis dmag nang du galta nga 'dodad smadad/ yum gyis bla ma zhig la bu'i ma 'ongs pa'i mdun lam la thugs ther+shag zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ khyim dang dmag nang du phyin yang tshe ring du 'chod dka' zhing / de bas rab tu byung ba yin na bstan 'gro'i don rgya cher 'grub par lung bstan/ de nas se ra smad gzhung pa chu bzang rin sngo sku/gas bsten nas gzhung chen lnga'i gsan bzhes mdzad de dus 'gyur skabs lha rams dge bshesadam bca' 'jog mtshams su slebs/khong khrims khang nas thengs gsum bros te tha mar thar te spyi lo 1961 lor rgya gar shar phyogs sbag sa chos sgar du 'byor/ der dge bshes chen po gser gyi ri bo lta bu'i khrod nas lha rams pa'i dam bca' bzhag ste ang dang wa'i mtshan rtags bzhes/ gdan sa de dang bor ṇa mchod rim cesab grwa'i dge rgan 'o/ shas mdzad pa'i mthar/ skyabs mthodan yid bzhin chodar bu'i spyan sngar bya bral du phebs 'asnga da kyi 'dun pa snyan zhu phul/ khong thugs shin tu mnyes te zhal nas/ khyed rang ri khrod du sgom rgyobs dang ngas sbyin bdag bya yi nged gnyis ka skyid sdug gcig pa yin gdang zhes gsungs sku/// de nas bzung ste lo ngo sum cu'i ring sgom sgrub mdzad pa'i mthar spyi lo 1999 le'i spyi zla 335

7 pa'i tshes 31 nyin dathodangs pa thodas dbyings su gzims te nyin grangs bcu gsum ring la thugs dam du bzhugs sku // khyodab ma yang mang du sku da de/gatho rwaku skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu'i dgongs pa bzhin nye gnas blo bzang thosan ldan lags kyis zhabs zhu zhus te phyi rgyal yul gru khag tu thengs bcu gnyis su byon te slob ma mang du mchis so// ri khrod du yod pa'i slob ma rnams ni mang che ba se 'bras dge gsum dang rgyud grwa rjod smad nas yin pas mdo sngags gnyis lnga'i bo/ ba dang nyams len yag ྅/ sku/da mkhan sha stag yin/ dam pa'i codas kyi bo gas 'o /'di dag gi bka' drin las gung khran tang gi bu phrug nga yang dam pa 'di'i spyan snga nas chos nor gnyis ma'i bka' drin lo ngo brgyad tsam gyi ring la sku ngas su spyad lags/dge bshes skal bzang stobs rgyas ni/ gtsang nas 'khrungs/ shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor dgon du tshogs zhugs gnang / gzhung chen lnga la dpe gzigs gnang du ser byes grwa tshang du cesags zhugs gnang / 'o/ shas rjes dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen wa ༷ hor skyor dpon rin po che bya bral du byon te smin drug rdza ri sogs na chodas don nyams bzhes mdzad pa'i snyan pa thos te dad pas drangs nas rang dbang med par rjes su 'brang dgos byung / de nas bzung ste bod 'brug rgya gsum nas sotshe ra bcu gnyis kyi ring la lus dang grib ma bzhin 336

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/du 'bo/gas/ deng 'dir skabs bab kyi lhu/ba ma rnams la snumis kyi bka' drin lhadang bzhin pa lags 11//de ltar sgrub pa 11 mtshams pa rnams ༷)sa skyabs mabosan yid bzhin cadar bu'i sku tshe srid mthar brtan pa'i phyir du tshe sgrub byed lugs ci 'dra yin zhe na/ de ni cung zad bshad par bya ste/ lo gcig la tshe rdzas ril bu thengs gsum re 'bul sku la sku da/ 'khrungs skar dus chen skabs su rnam rgyal ma'i sgo nas sgrub pa'i tshe ril/ dgu ba'i nyer gnyis lha babs dus chen du tshe dpag med/ gnam 'o/ gsar ba'i tshes gcig nyin cadal dkar yid bzhin 'kho ra le'i tshe ril bcas sku // 'bul thengs re la tshe sgrub pa bzhi re nges can yin zhing skabs rer 'phar ma re zung dang lhag par du skyabs rje ldan ma blo chos rin wa ཿ nyid kyis 'jigs byed ser snga'i sgo nas sgrub pa'i tshe ril 'bul bzhin yod/ tshe ril sgrub pa'i skabs su bya rgyud kyi lha yin na las rung gi sngon du bla med bsnyen pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs 'bo dbo sa par bshad/ las rung grub pa'i rjes su lha gang yin na'ang de'i mdun bskyed kyi sgo nas skyabs mgon rgyal ba rin po che gtso 'khe ra dang bcas pa'i sku tshe srid mthar brtan pa dang bzhed snga na myur du 'grub pa'i slad du sgom bzlas la bce na dbo sa pa yin/ tshe rdzas sgrub pa'i skabs su dang 'o/ nas tshe ril tshang ma bsgril ba yin na sgrub yun zla 337

ba gnyis tsam song na tshe ril rnying bar 'gyur pas/ thog mar ril bu nyung sku|sa shig la dmigs nas mdun bskyed bsgrub dbo/sa shing 'bul ran pa'i nyin shas khyodan la sngar mdun bskyed kyi ril bu las gnyis gsum tsam 'bul rgyu'i tshe ril gyi phabs lta bu byas nas ril bu rnams stod kyi nang du ma rmos 'od )ga gi snye ma'i dbyibs ltar brtsigs dgos/ rab yin na mdun phyogs su 'khor lo pad+ma sogs dang rtsemor nyi zla nā da dang bcas pa'i mdzes rgyan 'dogs srol yod kyang rgyud grwa stod smad kyi grwa pa med na khag po yin/ ril bu rnams grub pa na sngar ltar mdun bskyed kyi dmigs rnam skyong bzhin pa'i ngang nas 'bul kha ma'i bar du bsgrub dbonas/ mthar tshe ril gdan 'dren zhu ran pa na mdun lha tshe ril gyi rnam par mo sa nas sgyu brang ngam theg chen chodas gling gtsug lag khang gnyis kyi gang na skyabs mabo na rgyal ba rin cad che 'kho ra dang bcas pa bzhugs sku da na/ der gdan 'dren zhu dbenas/ gnam 'o/ gsar tshes kyi nyin theg chen chos gling gtsug lag khang du mdzad sgo yin pa'i dbang du btang na/ chodags pa chu 27da brgyad dang phyed ka tsam la tshe sgrub pa ci yod gtsug lag khang du 'jo mas dgos/ der chodags pa'i zhal 'asnga na brtan bzhugs dang bcas pa grub mtshams su tshe ril 'bul dbo sa/ de yang mjal dar tshe 'o/ra gyis ma mnan pa dang man ḍal rten dod mthe bong dang gung mo gnyis kyi bar du lhod 338

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/'dzin byed dgos/ de min mjal dar dang man ḍal rten dod len pa'i skabs su tshe phor lhung ba'i nyen kha mod/ de nas rang rang tshe phor mthon par btegs te tshe sgrub pa ci yod tshang ma 'phreng sgrig yod pa la sku sger yig tshang gi las byed cig gis sne khrid de g.yas gasku na kun na gzhung zhabs ser skya ho/ snu sa gang mo da pa'i dkyil nas yar 'thod dathodas/ skyabs mabo na rgyal ba'i dbang tho'i bzhugs khri'i g.yas khyodags na mjal dar dang maṇa ḍal rten wa da bzhes mkhan sku1da/ de bzhes ma thag tu kha btags bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi ri ces yod pa re re tshe sgrub pa re re'i mjing par g.yogs/ de nas skyabs mgon rgyal ba'i dbang thod thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen wa'ispyan snga nyid la 'byor yod/ khong gi phyag sen gyis blangs te tshe ril bzhes ma thag tu spyan snga ba zhig gis tshe 〉stor rnams g.yas khyodags kyi stegs zhig la 'alnga ga bo /bzhugs khri'i g.yon phyogs na tshe sgrub pa re re la phyag mdud re re dang / yang kha btags dkar po srid ring zhing zheng che ba re re gnang srol yod/ phyag mdud dang kha btags snga ma sku sgor yin zhing kha btags rjes ma gnang mkhan bod gzhung snu sa don las khungs yin par bshad/ tshe ril 'bul thengs gcig gi las rim maro/ tsam brjod na de ltar lags/ tshe ril gyi rgyu cha 'am grub cha ni/ rang cag kha ba can pa rnams kyi pha zas 'bru rtsam dang mar khu gnyis 339

gatho ngo yin zhing / de dang chabs cig sbrang rtsi dang mngar zhib legs shos kyis bsgril sku da/ tshe ho/ra ni/ dang ngo mang che ba rgya nag gis bkodas pa'i bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi ri sdud sku da pa'i 'o/ra ba legs lha sa de yin yang / gzhon nu lhan snumags kyis rgya dacags bkag pa nas bzung ste rgya gar bas bahwa sa pa'i ho ra ba sha stag yin no// nga rang la tshe ril thengs bcu gnyis tsam 'bul rgyu'i go skabs thob pa ha cang dga' ba byung / de yang rnam rgyal ma'i tshe sgrub gcig ma gdo/gas gzhan tshang ma 〉wal dkar yid bzhin 'kho ra 'o'i ce) ga la brten nas sgrub pa'i tshe ril yin/ dang ngo ra 'jigs byed kyi las rung bsdus pa zhig sngon du btang nas sgrol dkar las rung 'bum bcu dang kha stong 'bum gcig zhi ba'i sbyin sreg dang bcas blugs/ de nas bzung ste lo re re bzhin du bdag mdun gnyis sha'i cad nas sgrub pa yin/ bdag bskyed kyi skabs su bsgrub bya rang gi snying gar gsal 'debs dgos pa dang / mdun bskyed kyi skabs su tshe rdzas lha'i rnam par gsal btab yod pa'i thugs shar bsgrub bya 'god dgos/ cho ga mjug bsdu ba'i skabs su tshe rdzas lha'i rnam can du gsal btab yod pa tshe rdzas ril bu'i rnam pa can du bsgyur dathodas pa snu ga spyi mtshungs ltar yin/ skyabs mabo na rgyal ba rin cad che la sku tshe tshe sgrub bsnyu na dbo sa pa ni cadad spyi ba'i 'phral phugs kyi bde snga na tsam du ma zad/ 'dzam gling 340

dge 11nga bse ruḥ) kher gtam/ — — —— mi mang yongs la 'phral bde phugs skyid yong ba'i thabs su gyur naci ma rung 'gyur bar shog cig snyam pa'i ngang nas bzlas brjod byas pa yin/ gtso bo bod mi sa ya drug gi bde 〈snan yin stabs/ snu'ogs zhing nang du sa dge ba///'a rnying gi tshe 'khrid brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams phan tshun thugs dgyes pa'i tshul gyis nga la bzlas brtsod kyi rogs ram byed bzhin bzhugs yod snyaca/ pa dang / /gas ri rang gi mtha' 'khor gyi nye sar bod mi sa ya drug phan tshun pha ma ming sring shi rnam par dga' ba'i sems dang 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa'i sgo nas nga la bzlas brtsod kyi rogs ram byed bzhin 'khod mod snyam pa'i ngang nas bzlas brjod rgya chen po zhig byas pa'i khul yin/ de yang kun slong gi cas nas rgya pham thod rgyal gyi bsam pas ma bslad par/ gnyis ka bde ba 'dod pa dang /sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa 'dra mtshungs yin pas bdag gzhan mnyam pa'i 'e/cag/sri bskyed kyi kun nas bslangs te rgya zhi bod 'grig yong ba'i smon lam kyang bta ba pa yin/ bod rang dbang 'thob pa'i bya ba bsgrub dgos pa dang smo6/ las/ 'debs dbosas pa ni/ yul zhen sha zhen tsam ma yin par 'dzam thing mi mang yongs la zhi bde bsgrub pa'i cha rkyen zhig yin/ de zhi byams snying rje rtsa ba can gyi rig gzhung sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ni/ rang cag mār+shas pa rnams kyis snums zhen gyis bsngags brjod mdzad pa tsam ma yin par 'dzam gling 'di'i steng gi 341 da wa

dpyad rjo/bas kyi rig pa phul du byung pa'i tshan rig pa rnams kyis kyang bsngags brtsodad gnang dang gnang bzhin mo da pa kun gyis mkhyen gsal red/ der ma zad/ ye shu dang kha che/lhan lha dang dmar phyogs pa blo gzur bor gnas pa rnams kyis kyang sngar ltar ro// de bas rgya nag skam sa chen po rtsaba'i cha nas nang pa'i rgyal khab yin pa tsam du ma zad/ byams snying rje ce ba can gyi theg pa chen pa'i bstan pa 'acirdon pa'i rgyal khab cig yin stabs/ nam zhig gi tshe nged cag gis bod rang dbang phara.u tshugs brgyab nas rtsod ma dgos par tshur bzhes sngagags gnang zhes gsung mi srid pa ma red/ de ni skam sa chen wa'i blon chen rnams blang dor gyi dbye ba mi mkhyen pa'i blun po sha stag ga la yin/ yang khyodags gzhan zhig nas bshad na/ rgya nag skam sa chen 11 deng sang 'dzam gling 'di'i steng gi mi 'boradangadapal 'byor dmag don sogs gang sa nas ha cang rjodabs chen rgyal khab cig yin pa 11sa ma dbo sa pa yin/ de 'dra'i stobs chen zhig gis nged cag 'tshe med zhi ba'i rig gzhung nyams len byed mkhan grangs nyung mi rigs shig drag gaphyogen byas pa ni/ skam sa chen wa'i sdudan chen sku na tan pa rnams cad tsha srid pa dang / yang 〈snabs chen rgyal khab kyis nyams gud du 'bo/ bzhin pa'i mi rigs dang rig gzhung 11gas la srung khyodab mdzad pa yin na/ 'dzam gling nang gi phul byung rgyal khab dang kun 342

dpyad rjo/bas kyi rig pa phul du byung pa'i tshan rig pa rnams kyis kyang bsngags brtsodad gnang dang gnang bzhin mo da pa kun gyis mkhyen gsal red/ der ma zad/ ye shu dang kha che/lhan lha dang dmar phyogs pa blo gzur bor gnas pa rnams kyis kyang sngar ltar ro// de bas rgya nag skam sa chen po rtsaba'i cha nas nang pa'i rgyal khab yin pa tsam du ma zad/ byams snying rje ce ba can gyi theg pa chen pa'i bstan pa 'acirdon pa'i rgyal khab cig yin stabs/ nam zhig gi tshe nged cag gis bod rang dbang phara.u tshugs brgyab nas rtsod ma dgos par tshur bzhes sngagags gnang zhes gsung mi srid pa ma red/ de ni skam sa chen wa'i blon chen rnams blang dor gyi dbye ba mi mkhyen pa'i blun po sha stag ga la yin/ yang khyodags gzhan zhig nas bshad na/ rgya nag skam sa chen 11 deng sang 'dzam gling 'di'i steng gi mi 'boradangadapal 'byor dmag don sogs gang sa nas ha cang rjodabs chen rgyal khab cig yin pa 11sa ma dbo sa pa yin/ de 'dra'i stobs chen zhig gis nged cag 'tshe med zhi ba'i rig gzhung nyams len byed mkhan grangs nyung mi rigs shig drag gaphyogen byas pa ni/ skam sa chen wa'i sdudan chen sku na tan pa rnams cad tsha srid pa dang / yang 〈snabs chen rgyal khab kyis nyams gud du 'bo/ bzhin pa'i mi rigs dang rig gzhung 11gas la srung khyodab mdzad pa yin na/ 'dzam gling nang gi phul byung rgyal khab dang kun 342

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/kyis bcingabakur bya ba'i yul du 'gyur nges pa yin pas/ bod la rang dbang gi gnas babs srid pa zhig red/ de'i phyir rang gis kyang spyodan lam 'debs pa dang gu ru'i mtshan sngags bgrang ba/ gtong len gyi dmigs rnam bskyangs dang skyong ba'i khul yin/de nas ri'i snang la bsdad nas 'o lha'i bcu gsum tsam gyi ring la skyabs mabo na rgyal ba rin 1/ che'i spyan snga nas dpyid snu sa chen snu sa mchotshon pa'i snu sa gang gsung ba rnams rim gyis bka' drin legs par lnga ba/ 'bras sbru/ mang du dge ba'i bshes gnyen sku na chung mdun nas sa lam dang snga na bdun cu/ 'di gar skyabs rje ldan ma blo chos rin po che'i spyan snga nas 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i khrid dang / dpa' gcig gi dbang sogs gsung chos mang du thob/ kirta'i mtshan zhabs rin sngo che'i spyan snga nas tshe dpag med 'chi med lha lnga'i bshad khrid thob/ byang rtse chos rje ri rdzong rin po che'i spyan snga nas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi ljags lung cha tshang ba thob pa lags/ rang gis kyang byang chub lam gyi rim pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs tshar sum cu mgrangs dang bskyed rtsortags rgyas bsdus tshar bcu grangs sku gas gsung rab du ma lha ga pa yin/ bla ma'i gsung dang gsung rab kyi dgongs don la bsam blo gtong khul byas nas da snga yan chad snubs pa'i tshulags zhen yin na yang 'dra baX da pa'i nyams len 343

yin na yang 'dra tshur la mtshang 'bru mkhan byung yang phar la tshig zur tsam gyis kyang lan bslags med/ de bas chos sgor zhugs nas da lta bar du lo ca nyi shu mgrangs kyi ring la sems la zhi bde bag phebs kyi 'tsho ba longs su khyod thub pa byung / de'i stabs kyis nga rang 'grog 'dris yod pa'i mi la nga rang la nang chos kyis dpe mi srid pa'i phan thogs byung song zhes brjod dang rjod kyin yod/ 'on kyang da phan chad lus stobs nyams pa dang rlung stobs rgyas pa gnyis lhan du 'a17mas na thug sa reg sa med pa'i bla rgan rlung sngag ma zhig tu 'gyur mi srid pa ma red/ de'i dus mi tshang mas/sto 'grangs nyi mas dros tshe chos pa'i gzugs//rkyen ngan 11ga tu babs na tha mal ba//zhes brjod rogs gnang / yang / dpal ldan sa skya ba'i grub mtha' dang bla rabs rnam thar/ snga 'gyur ba'i kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung sogs dang / gsang chen bka' rgyud pa'i lam rim thar rgyan dang rje mi la'i rnam mgur sogs bklags pa yin/ de'i snga na la bsam blo zhig gtong na bod gangs can gyi chodas rgyun tshang mas rang rang gi gzhung nas gsung ba ltar nyams bzhes ma/dzad pa yin na rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' mang du bskrun nges pas/ nga yang chos rgyun tshang ma'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin la dag snang sbyong ba'i go skabs 344

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/shig rnyed do// de yang grub dbang skal ldan rgya mtsho'i zhal nas/byang chub sems dpa' gang na sku da mi shes//mthong mthong kun la ma smod ri khrod pa//zhes gsungs 'dug lags/ yang / shar rdza bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i lam rim bka' lung rgya ma〉ya bklags pa yin/ 'di ni g.yung drung sngo na gyi lam rim yin 'ing sgrig rim dang sa bcad tshang ma kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung dang gcig pa yin/ yul dang gang zag dang lung 'dren tshang ma g.yung drung cadan gyi thun mo nga ma yin pa drangs 'dug 'di nyams bzhes mdzad mkhan zhig yin na/ nged cag chodas pa rnams kyi cadas nas rjes su yi rang bya codas pa zhig yin par mthoran chod// de yang bla chen dran pa nam mkha'i zha'/ natra//chos dang bon la phyogs ris byed pa ni//dodan dang mi mthun nga dang rgyang thag ring // zhes gsungs 'dugadon 'di la bsam blo gtong na/ tshur la phyogs ris mi byed par phar la phyogs ris byed na/ rang nyid phyogs ris can gyi mi ngan bkra mi shis pa/ spyi tshogs kyi phung 'dre/ mi rigs kyi rkang 'dren/zhes lta grub kyi lhungags ris 'bo/ga khul byas pa yin/ de la dge lugs pa'i 345

dpe cha kherdzo na ༄/ga nas bsdad na tshig ma gsal ba dang doni ma tshang ba ga la yin/'o na khyed rang mig skyo bo yin bzhin du chos rgyun gzhan gyi dpe cha klog dgos pa ci yin zhe na/ de ni skyabs mabosan rgyal ba'i zhal nas/ chodas rgyun tshang mar rgyus yod byed rgyu gal chen po red ces gsungs pa ltar/ ngas kyang sa bcad ma 〈cong tsam byas pa'i khul lags/ 'di ni thosgos pa kun la sems thag nye ba chags pa'i cha rkyen bzang 11 zhig yin pa gathosan mi zacas// mtshams pa rnams kyi 'tsho shen ni/ tshe sgrub pa grangs nyi shu yod pa la zla rer lhan sgor nyis brgya lnga bcu dang / mtshams pa yongs rdzogs la ba༄ shen lhan sgor mang mtha' chig stong lhag dang nyung mtha' bzhi brgya lnga brgya tsam yin zhing 'phel 'grib che yang nyis stong gcig le'i bar du nges can yin/ nyis stong gcig nas tshe sgrub pa'i gsol phogs sngar ltar yin yang baljo rten cung nyung du phyin te mang mtha' sum brgya dang nyung mtha' brgya dang lnga bcu drug bcu yas mas yin/ nga la gsol phogs dang baljo rten gnyis ka yod pas nyung yang za mkhas 'thung mkhas byas na 'chos ba'i dka' ngal med/ snga ma yin na tshe mchodag gling phyag mdzod skyid grong ba thub bstan snyan grags lags kyis zla rer lhan sgor lnga brgya sprodad mkhan gyi phyi rgyal ba sbyin bdag cig btsal/ 'o/ shas ring sbyin bdag byas te da le'i phyi zla bzhi ba'i nang chad/ yang / rgyud smad mtshams pa thub 346

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/bstan skal bzang lags kyis gzhan dag brgyud nas zla rer lhan sbru/ra nyis brgya khyodad bzhin sku/da pa de yang chad/ bu sku/na tan khyim tshang nas 'o/ gcig gi nang zla gcig gi bza' bca' pho sa nas khyodad bzhin sku da pa de yang chad/yang / a khu dar rgyas brgyud nas bal yul gnye shang cesang pa /rma lags kyis lo lnga'i ring zla rer lhan sgor lnga brgya re sprod nges yin zhes lo gcig gi de sprad byung / bde snga na las khungs kyis zla ba gsum re'i mtshams la snum spyi rgya gang re dang gro chag phor ba lnga drug re sprod kyin yod/ nged cag gi dge rgan ye shes stobs ldan nam dge grub thob rin po che 'tsho bzhugs skabs zur ston zhal 'debs gang 'tsham yod/ sngar bud shing bsgrug tu ri gzar 'phrang dog mang po 'grim dgos pas dka' ngal dang / de'i khar nags bdag la zon bya dgos pa dang yul mi la phog thug 'chor bar dogs pa'i dka' ngal yod/dgu bcu go grangs shig la the bon dge slong zhig gis tshe sgrub pa re la sku sgor yig tshang brgyud nas rdzas rlangs thab ka re gnang / de nas nyis stong 'o/ra nga'i bo gas 'o/ masnu khyodan bstan 'dzin nam mkha' phyi rgyal du phebs thag cesad pas nga khe nga gi mtshams khang du spar ba yin/ 'di gsung codas dang gso sbyong skabs su skyabs mabo na yid bzhin cadar bu'i sgyu brang dang theg chen chos gling gtsug lag khang dang thag nye bo yin/ khang ba 'di'i steng codag kun na khang mig 347

bcu grangs shig sku1da pa'i nang na mtshams pa sha stag bzhugs 'dug khang ba 'di rbod gzhung dpal 'khyodar las khungs kyi yin par ma zad/ nye 'khe ra gyi mjes ༄/ngas gang 'tsham zhig kyang dpal 'acadar las khungs kyi sa cha yin /mtsham/sa pa rnams la khang ba g.yar ba ma galta gas khang bla lhurtor gcig kyang blangs med/ khor yug 'di ni spang ljongs nags tshal gyis bskor ba'i mdze sa lhungangs shig yin pas/ rnam rgyal grwa tshang dang / mtshan nyid grwa tshang / kirti byes pa grwa tshang sogs snurags pa dang / sgor ba gang mang zhig gis bza' bca' sna tshogs dang glu gar rol mo rtsod 'arjo'i dga' ston longs su spyod pa'i gung gseng rjod skyid kyi do ra zhig kyang yin lags/'di ga'i mtshams pa rnams la bzhes chu nye sar med pa'i dka' ngal cung zad skud pa la chuthi nam gyi grwa pa zhig gis chu 'dren lcags sbug gi thebs rtsar hin sgor chig khri sprad de nye 'khris su 'ja' pan gyi khyim tshang zhig yod pa las chu drangs/ khyodar bdun brgyas ma 'dang bar 'ja' pan khyim tshang gis sprad josgo// yang / bang ba'i mtha' na chu rka med pas nang la rlan shugs che ba dang / gsang spyod med pas mdzes ljongs btsog par 'gyur ba la phrad gzhung dpal 'dredar las khungs la li thang mtshams pa rgyal mtshan mthu lhadabs dang ldan ma bsku/da nams ṣ+ṭhatshes 'acadar gnyis kyis snyan zhu phul/ dpal las dang 348

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/'phrod bsten las khungs gnyis ma'i 'gan 'dzin sku ngo bka' blon blo bzang snyan grags lags kyis gzigs zhib gnang rtse 'aho/da bsten las khungs kyis lhan sgor 'bum lhag gi 'gro song btang ste chu rka dang khrus khang gcig gsang spyod gnyis dang bcas te legs par grub lags/ gong du zhus pa'i sku sger yig tshang gi gatherga byas nas gzhung sger tshang ma la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/bzhi ba/ bskal bzang gi dus su gang zag gis gnas byin gyis brlabs pa dang / dus 'dir gnas kyis gang zag byin gyis brlab ces gsu nga rgyun yod pa ltar/ gnas skor zhing mjal ba'i rabs mdo tsam brjod na/nga skyes nas dus yun gang 'tsham zhig la gnas lha ra dang gnas mjal phar zad/ dgon pa dang lha khang mchod rten sku 'bum sogs chos phyogs kyi 'bur 'bur yod tshad tshang ma gtor bzhin pa'i skabs yin/ de dag gtor ba'i rjes su nga rang gi yul dgon rkang che'i dgon dga' ldan bsam 'grub gling gi shar mtha' na rta mgrin yang gsang gi sku 'bum zhig yod pa de'i sgo bcags pa ma gdodags byings legs par bzhugs sku(da pa de la mtshan cesar gsang pa'i sbru/ nas nged nang mi kha shas kyis khyodar phyag byas pa yin/ de mtshungs shag ral grub gnas benang 〉〈ga la gnas mjal du 'bo/ skabs gzhung lam ma 349

brgyud par gsang lam du zhugs nas mjal dbo|sa/ de'i skabs su gnas de na mtshams pa mang 11 deg skung bzhin 1glom sgrub la ba33 kyin skude/ gnas de la gnas skor rgya chen po 'gro na de'u bur sgom khang dang mya med mchod rten sogs kyang skor nang du tshud dgos par bshad/ mya med mchod rten ni kha gya'i a myes zhal dkar gyi mdun thang na mod cing / 'di ༄/na rgya gar gyi codas rgyal mya ngan med kyis dus gcig la mace)da rten bye ba gcig bzhengs pa'i nang gi gcig yin par bshad/ 'di rnams sgor ba'i skabs su nga lo bdun brgyad tsam yin zhing khyodan chas sgyu na po gyon tshad la zhed snang skye ba'i dus shig yin/nga so/ bcu gsum jo ga lha ba rta mgrin rang byung dnga.a ma 'brug mchod bcas la mjal du khrid/ sho ba rta mgrin rten dang brten pa rtsagator byas 'dug mchod dge rang gi dgon pa bstan pa'i sgron mes phyag btab pa'i sgar gsar dgon dga' ldan rab rgyal gling dang khya dge dpon slob rin po ches phyag btab pa'i sgar rnying dgon bkra shis chos 'phel gling gnyis rtsagator byas te/ gzhi de la mdzod dge stod smad zhang gi rten gzhi byas nas rgya khang thog phibs dmar po can mang du yod cing / dad rten gcig kyang med stabs/ der lan mang du song yang mjal rgyu'i snang ba ma shar/ nga lo bco brgyad thog gong du bshad pa ltar pha dang nged gnyis mtsho sngon phyogs su song skabs gnas mjal gang 350

brgyud par gsang lam du zhugs nas mjal dbo|sa/ de'i skabs su gnas de na mtshams pa mang 11 deg skung bzhin 1glom sgrub la ba33 kyin skude/ gnas de la gnas skor rgya chen po 'gro na de'u bur sgom khang dang mya med mchod rten sogs kyang skor nang du tshud dgos par bshad/ mya med mchod rten ni kha gya'i a myes zhal dkar gyi mdun thang na mod cing / 'di ༄/na rgya gar gyi codas rgyal mya ngan med kyis dus gcig la mace)da rten bye ba gcig bzhengs pa'i nang gi gcig yin par bshad/ 'di rnams sgor ba'i skabs su nga lo bdun brgyad tsam yin zhing khyodan chas sgyu na po gyon tshad la zhed snang skye ba'i dus shig yin/nga so/ bcu gsum jo ga lha ba rta mgrin rang byung dnga.a ma 'brug mchod bcas la mjal du khrid/ sho ba rta mgrin rten dang brten pa rtsagator byas 'dug mchod dge rang gi dgon pa bstan pa'i sgron mes phyag btab pa'i sgar gsar dgon dga' ldan rab rgyal gling dang khya dge dpon slob rin po ches phyag btab pa'i sgar rnying dgon bkra shis chos 'phel gling gnyis rtsagator byas te/ gzhi de la mdzod dge stod smad zhang gi rten gzhi byas nas rgya khang thog phibs dmar po can mang du yod cing / dad rten gcig kyang med stabs/ der lan mang du song yang mjal rgyu'i snang ba ma shar/ nga lo bco brgyad thog gong du bshad pa ltar pha dang nged gnyis mtsho sngon phyogs su song skabs gnas mjal gang 350

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/'tsham zhig byed thub lha/nga / de la dang sngo bla brang bkra shis 'khyil la mjal/'di'i skabs su da rung gtso 'dzin ma'o tshe tung gi rlung rta dar zhing rgyas bzhin pa'i dus skabs yin pas ha cang ro/gas ga na dbo sa kyang gsang stabs kyis phyi blo ra gsum dang 'dabs nas yar phyag kha shas 'tshal thub 14nga / de nas mtsho sngon phyogs kyi gnas mjal thog ma snga nga thod dgon chen yin zhing / 'di ljon mar mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum mdzad pa'i gdan sa zhig yin yang / 'di'i skabs su cesags chen 'du khang las gzhan tshang ma ce gdo/ra byas 'dug 'di man chad gnas gang dang gang mjal ba/ de dang de'i khyad chos brjod na tshig mang du 'gyur bas tho tsam 'god par bya'o// reb kong nas khri ma'i bde skyid chu khol du bdun gsum tsam la chu tshan zhugs rjes sku 'bum byams pa gling du gnas mjal la sku nga / 'du khang lha khang kha shas ma gdodags tshang ma galta ra 'dug gsang stabs kyis phyag sbru/ra kha shas byas thub kyang lha mjal macesad mjal gcig kyang zhu dbang mi 'dugayin na yang rjes su srid jus gu yangs skabs su legs par mjal thub sku nga / snga phyi drug tsam mjal/ tha ma'i skabs su mtsho lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi chab cha dang / zi ling na yod pa'i mtsho sngon mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i sgo drung dang / sku 'bum nang bstan slob grwa'i sgo drung bcas la bod don khyab 351

lha/ga rgi yig cha 'dra bshus gcig pa gsum mtshan snu/ gcig la sbyar bas/ de ga'i dge 'dun pa tshang ma 'asnga gas langs 'dug nga yang 'asnga gas nas chu dkar ri khrod du bros nas 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i bdag bskyed blo 'dzin byas pa yin/ 'di rje rin po che'i thog mar ka kha slob sa'i gnas red/de nas snums rje snga na grub rin chen phyag 'kho ra gcan che'i ma ṇir mjal/ bya khyung / rma lung rdo je brag ra/ gnam rdzong / snang ra'i gser khang / this mdo'i dgon pa/ rdo sbis mchod rten/ dan tig shel gyi pho brang / mgar rtse dgon/ a tshogs dgon/ brag dkar sprel rdzong / g.yu lung brag dkar/rgan gya'i brag dkar dang dgon/ gtsos dgon/ kha gya'i dgon gsar rnying gnyis/ rdo dkar dgon/ 'bo ra'i dgon/ lha mo'i gser khri'i dgon/ lha mo'i kirti'i dgon/ chu dkar be shang dgon/ dngul rwa'i gnyan thog dgon/rgya nag ri wa bshalnga'i rtsegasum dang dgon pa dgon chag dang bcas pa nyi shu rtsagrangs shig la legs par mjal/ spyir btang dbenan pa brgya dang brgyad mod par bshad/ shar cengadang byang rtseganyis la mjal ma thub/ yar lam du ming yan h+phan sran zer ba'i brag ri dkar khra rtse mo lnga yod pa zhig 'dug bgrod lam brag shin tu gzar ba la swā skas bskardzos te g.yas gasku/na du lcags thag 'then yod pa de la 'jus nas 'gro 'ong byed dgos/ nga la grogs po 'phrin 352

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/las zer ba zhig yod/ nged gnyis chu tshod lnga'i ring la yar 'dzigs te sa rub mtshams su rtselnga gar 'gro lam mod pa'i lam gyi 'dus mdo zhig la slebs/der mabo na khang zhig tu bsdad de mtshan snu/ra kha ba babs nas rtsegacig kyang 'bos ma thub par phyi nyin mar babs pa yin/ lan kru'u byams pa 11 nyal la mjal/ 'di sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan pa'i sku 'dra zhig yin/ dbus lha ldan du jo shāka rnam gnyis dang pho brang po ta la/ se 'bras dge gsum/ pha thodang kha/ snye thang 〉tel ma lha khang / bsam yas gtsug lag khang / mchims phu/ zangs ri mkhar dmar/ codal kha snu sa lung / chu bzang /rdzing phyis/ rgya sag dang lha'i sdings bcas la gnas mjal legs par grub bo// rgya gar dang bal yul gyi gnas mjal ni/ rdo rje gdan/ lo drug dka' ba/ shā wa ri'i sgrub phug bya rgod phung bo'i ri/ rgyal tho'i khab/ nā lan ḍa/yangs pa can/ rtswa mchog grong / wa ra khā+e si/ lilnga'i gnas/ mchod rten bya rung kha shor/ 'phags pa shing kun/ stag mo lus sbyin/ yong le shod/yang / rgya gar lto phyogs kyi se 'bras dge gsum/ bkra shis lhun po/ rnam cadal gling / rgyud smad grwa tshang / byang khyodags su bkra shis 'khyil/ smin cadal gling / mtsho pad+ma/ chos rgyalas sho ma'i pho brang / skyabs mgon rgyal ba rin po che'i pho brang dang theg chen chos gling gtsug lag khang sogs la mjal dang 353

mjal bzhin pa lags 11// rgya bal gyi gnas chen khag la mjal ba'i skabs su dgu bcu go gsum yin pa 'dra/ sring mo jed gnyis la de 'dra'i gnas mjal du 'gro gron gang yang med mod/ nyi ma gcig grub dbang pad nor rin wa cho'i gtsos dge 'dun pa sum brgya dang lnga bcu lhan du rgya bal gyi gnas chen khag tu gnas mjal phebs pa'i sta bo|na zin mtshams su rlangs 'a〈snar rkub stegs kha shas lhag yod pa la/ de ga'i go sgrig las byed kyis gnas 'khor du 'gro mkhan yod na tho rgyobs dang rin khyod mi dgos zhes sgrog pa thos 'phral nged cag mi kha shas kyis jo brgyabs pa yin/ bal yul nas phyir lam du nged cag mi gsum ma galta gas gzhan tshang ma ma khyer par bal yul du lus/ nged cag gsum wa ra nā si'i bar du bskyal/ nged cag gsum gyis thugs rje che zhu dathodas pa dang gzhan dag la skyabs bajo la lag khyer med pas phyir lam mtha' mtshams nas bkag ste dka' ngal phrad pa dang re zung phyir bal yul rgyal sar khrid de btang / nga rang gi mi tshe nang gi nyes pa thams cad gsang ste legs pa'i cha yig thog tu bkodad na de 'dra zhig yin lags/ 'di la legs pa'i cha zhig mchis na/ spyir rlung khyim gcig gi nang na gnas pa'i 'dzam bu gling gi rjod kyi rgud pa dang bcud kyi sdug bsngal thams cad zhi ba dang / khyad par du skyabs mabo na yid bzhin cadar bu'i gathoḍas ris med skyes chen rnams 354

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/kyi sku tshe zhabs pad brtan cing / kun tu phan pa'i bzhed snga na rgya zhi thod 'grig gi bde skyid nyi ma cad po che myur du 'char ba dang / rgya bod kyi yul gru thams cad chodas 'acadar bde dga' rgyas pa'i zhing khams su 'gyur ba'i rgyur gyur cigasmras pa/theg mchog chos ldan dam pa'i khor yug tu//lte khrag sa la 'a'o/sa pa'i nyer len gyis//dmar wa'i bslab bya stong gis gsos gyur kyang //snu sa min ྅mod ngan lam du zhugs ma gyur//gcadan tshe rang yig lha nga ba ma mchis kyang //dar bab dus la rtag tu bce na pa yis//gangs swā ngas lugs gnyis rtsa ba yi ge rnams//'bri klog bya ba'i las la rmongs ma gyur//dben pa'i ri nas bsnyu na pa'i tshe sgrub rnams//skyabs mgon rgyal ba'i dbang dang ris med kyi//355

skyes chen dam pa'i zhabs pad brtan pa las//rang srog yun ring 'tsho phyir bsngos ma gyur//dge ba gang sgrub 'dzam gling zhi bde dang //kun tu phan pa'i rgya tho/da zhi 'grig gi/mdzad bzang sgo mo 'byed du bsngos pa las//rang nyid 'phral phugs bde phyir dmigs ma gyur/ /gsar rnying chos rgyun bla ma'i rna ma thar dang //byang chub babo da pa'i gsung rab bklags pa yis//bod la gnod pa'i phyogs ris ring lugs kyi//lta ngan zhags pa nag ༄/sa bcings ma gyur//ma3rter na legs byas ci mchis bla ma rnams//sku tshe brtan cing bzhed don 'grub pa dang //sbyin bdag rnams kyang 'phral phyags bde ba dang //'dzam gling zhi ba chen wa'i rgyu ru bsngo //356

dge spyong bse ru'i sher gtam/cadan shing lta lag rgyas pa'i yal ga ru//spre'us gar stabs sgyur ba'i nags klung du//zhi bde bag phebs 'o/ngas su khyodad pa'i bu//mdzod dge ye shes rgya mtshos smyug sne khrid//ces pa 'di ni nyin shas sngon nas mgo btsugs te phyi lo 2003 125 nyin legs par grub lags/

mjug ce ma/ ༄༅// skabs 'dir mang po brjod du med la/ gtso bo rang gi mi tshe 'di'i nang gi snu sa dang rig gzhung gi rmang gzhi 'ding mkhan phu thod skal bzang snga na 'grub nas bzung ste dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma dang / khyad par du lam rim dang blo sbyong / gsang sngags zab mo'i dbang lung khrid gsum gyi rim pa yang dang yang du bka' drin gyis gasku/ bar mdzad pa'i skyabs mabo na rgyal ba'i dbang thod thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen wa'i bar gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/yang / thog mar slob gnyer gyi skabs su 'tsho sbyor ba rang khyim dang sring mo dam chos mtsho mo nas bzung ste zur snon byed mkhan du ma dang / khyad par du mi so/ bcu gnyis kyi ring la cesas sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen chu wa'i rgyun bzhin du gnang ba'i sbyin bdag sku sger yig tshang las rang snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/yang / sngar gyi mdo smad mdzod dge shog ka lnga'i ya nga ba'i lo rgyus kyi snyan chod zhes bya ba'i deb de la snag shog gi rin pa dang / gla cha gang yang 358

dge sbyong bse ru'i kher gtam/med par klog klad dam rig mdzod 'phrul klad du dpar gzhi rtsom sgrig gnang ba dang / thengs 'di'i par skrun thad la'ang slog bcug dang zhu dag dpar cangabadodan pa 11gas la rin chag gis snyu ma sgrig gnang mkhan rode kyi yig sgyur khang gi 'gan 'dzin kun thar snga na grub lags dang las 1rigs sku ngas la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che sdo/ rgyu ci)na/gal che shos shig ni/ bog ma'i gleng brjod kyi skabs su zhus pa ltar/nga la slob gnyer gyi cha rkyen ma 'dzoms pas deb chung 'di'i tshig bcad rnams la chodar 'khrul nges par du mo da srid/ gal te lugs gnyis dang 'gal ba'i rtsom de 'dra yod na gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan sngar bshag par bgyi'o//yang / dathodangs 'char dang bka' jo ba/ yang na bka' baspyodan gnang pa'i dbo ngas pa mchis na gsham gyi kha byang chodag tu 'brel ba gnang chosags gnang / gal srid phyag 'phrin de 'dra bstsal ba yin na'ang dgag sgrub kyi 'phrin lan gang yang 'bul mi thub lags/ phyi 'o( 2003 phyi zla 12 tshes 10nyin 'dzam gling zhi bde'i gzengs rtags dus chen la bris// //dge'o// dge'o//
